exercises.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and curl your head, shoulders and then your back off the floor.
Stop when your torso is about three quarters of the way to upright, before you reach full sitting.
Breathe in and roll back down slowly until your shoulder blades touch the floor, then go again.

exercises.name: 45° Side Bend
instructions: Set yourself sideways on a 45-degree back extension bench, hip on the pad and feet locked under the foot rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or put your hands lightly behind your head.
Keeping your body in a straight line, lower your upper body toward the floor by bending at the side of your waist.
Breathe out and lift your torso sideways as high as you can by squeezing the side of your waist.
Do all your reps on one side, then turn over and work the other side.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel handles with the wheel on the floor under your shoulders.
Tighten your abs and tuck your hips slightly so your lower back stays flat.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, letting your hips and chest move toward the floor as far as you can control.
Stop before your lower back starts to sag, breathing in on the way out.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees using your abs, breathing out as you return.

exercises.name: All Fours Squad Stretch
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and right knee.
Bend your left knee and reach back with your right hand to hold your left foot.
Gently pull the heel toward your glutes until you feel the stretch along the front of the thigh.
Keep your stomach tight so your lower back does not sag, and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: Alternate Heel Touchers
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, a little wider than hip width.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor and let your arms reach long by your sides.
Crunch sideways to tap your right heel with your right hand.
Come back to the middle and crunch to the left to tap your left heel.
Keep your shoulders off the floor the whole set and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Alternate Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Clip a single handle to each high cable, sit facing the machine and lock your thighs under the pads.
Take one handle in each hand with your arms reaching up and your chest tall.
Pull one elbow down to the side of your ribs while the other arm stays long overhead.
Squeeze your back at the bottom, then let that arm rise slowly under control.
Pull the other arm down the same way and keep switching sides.
Breathe out as you pull and breathe in as the handle goes back up.

exercises.name: Alternating Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your thighs.
Breathe out and curl the right dumbbell up, turning your palm to face up as it rises.
Squeeze the biceps at the top with your elbow still at your side.
Breathe in and lower it slowly while turning the palm back in.
Repeat with the left arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Sit on a chair or stand holding a wall, and lift one foot off the floor.
Point your toes and slowly draw a big circle with your foot, moving only at the ankle.
Make 10 circles clockwise.
Reverse and make 10 circles counterclockwise.
Keep your leg still and breathe normally.
Switch to the other foot.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsal Flexion
instructions: Sit on a chair or on the floor with your leg straight and your heel resting on the ground.
Relax your foot so the toes point slightly away.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot up toward your shin as far as you can.
Hold for 2 to 3 seconds and feel the front of your lower leg working.
Lower the foot slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Archer Pull Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a very wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up toward your right hand, bending that arm while the left arm straightens along the bar.
Bring your chin over your right hand and breathe out.
Lower slowly back to the centre hang.
Pull toward the left hand on the next rep and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Archer Push Up
instructions: Set your hands on the floor about twice shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing slightly out, and step back into a push-up position.
Breathe in and bend one elbow to lower your chest toward that hand, keeping the other arm straight.
Shift your weight onto the bent arm while the straight arm only helps with balance.
Breathe out and push back up to the middle.
Alternate sides each rep, or do all reps on one side before switching.
Keep your hips level with your shoulders and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: Arm Slingers Hanging Bent Knee Legs
instructions: Hang a pair of ab slings from a pull-up bar and rest your upper arms in them, elbows bent.
Let your legs hang down and tighten your abs to stop any swinging.
Breathe out and draw your knees up toward your chest, letting your hips curl up slightly at the top.
Pause briefly with your abs squeezed.
Breathe in and lower your legs slowly until they hang straight again.

exercises.name: Arm Slingers Hanging Straight Legs
instructions: Hook a pair of ab slings on a pull-up bar, slide your arms through and rest your upper arms in them with your elbows bent.
Let your legs hang straight and still, and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and lift your straight legs in front of you until they are level with the floor or a little higher.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to do the lift, not momentum.
Breathe in and lower your legs slowly back to a straight hang.

exercises.name: Arms Apart Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with feet a bit wider than hip-width and your arms spread out to the sides.
Breathe out and fold forward from the hips, sweeping your arms down in a wide arc.
Touch your toes or shins with both hands at the bottom.
Breathe in and continue the circle, sweeping the arms out and up as you rise.
Finish with your arms overhead, then flow straight into the next rep, changing the direction of the circle halfway through.

exercises.name: Arms Overhead Full Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat, and your arms straight on the floor above your head.
Tighten your abs and lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Breathe out and swing your arms forward as you curl all the way up until your chest is over your thighs.
Keep your feet on the floor and avoid jerking your head.
Breathe in and roll down slowly, returning your arms overhead.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Keep your elbows in front of your body and your feet flat.
Breathe out and press up while turning your palms forward and moving your elbows out.
Finish with your arms straight above your shoulders.
Breathe in and reverse the turn as you lower back to the start.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
instructions: Set the seat so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Hold the moving handles and pedal, pushing and pulling the handles as your legs drive.
Keep your back tall and breathe steadily.
Raise or lower the effort by pedalling harder; the fan resists more the faster you go.

exercises.name: Assisted Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit or stand tall and place two fingers on the front of your chin.
Use the fingers to press your chin gently straight back while keeping your eyes forward.
Let your neck muscles do most of the work; the fingers only guide.
Hold the tucked position for 3 to 5 seconds and keep breathing.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with your upper arms resting in ab straps and your legs straight down.
Brace your abs and keep your body still.
Breathe out and draw your knees up toward your chest, tilting your pelvis up slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly until they are straight again without swinging.

exercises.name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise With Throw Down
aliases: hanging knee raise with throw down
instructions: Hang from a bar with your upper arms resting in ab straps and a partner standing in front of you.
Brace your abs and pull your knees up toward your chest.
At the top, let your partner push your legs firmly back down and forward.
Fight the push with your abs, stop your legs before they swing behind you, and pull them straight back up.
Keep your body from swinging and breathe out each time you lift.

exercises.name: Assisted Lying Calves Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Hold the ends of the towel and raise that leg as high as it goes while keeping the knee straight.
Pull the towel gently so your toes come down toward your face.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and breathe slowly.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Assisted Lying Glutes Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your right knee, keeping the left leg straight on the floor.
Your partner kneels beside you and places one hand on your right knee and one on your right shin.
Relax and let your partner slowly push the knee toward your chest and slightly across toward your left shoulder.
Tell your partner to stop as soon as you feel a strong but comfortable stretch in the right glute.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Assisted Lying Gluteus And Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back, bend both knees and cross your right ankle over your left knee.
Your partner kneels at your feet and holds your left shin and your right knee.
Your partner slowly pushes your left knee toward your chest, which lifts the crossed leg with it.
They can gently press your right knee outward to deepen the stretch in the right glute.
Keep breathing and hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then change sides.

exercises.name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Lateral Throw Down
aliases: lying leg raise with lateral throw down
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near a standing partner's feet and hold their ankles.
Keeping your legs together and straight, raise them up toward your partner's hands.
Let your partner push your legs down and off to one side.
Brace your abs and obliques, stop your legs before they touch the floor, then lift them straight back up.
Alternate the side your partner pushes toward and keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Throw Down
aliases: lying leg raise with throw down
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near a standing partner's feet and hold their ankles.
Raise your straight legs together until they reach your partner's hands.
Let your partner push your legs straight down toward the floor.
Brace hard, stop your legs a few centimeters above the floor, and bring them back up.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor; if it arches, ask for a lighter push.

exercises.name: Assisted Motion Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, heels down, and a medicine ball held at your chest.
Lean back a little with a long, straight spine until you feel your abs switch on.
Turn your shoulders to the right and bring the ball beside your right hip.
Turn back through the middle and take the ball to your left hip.
Let your shoulders lead the turn, not just your arms, and breathe out on each side.

exercises.name: Assisted Parallel Close Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight, step onto the platform and kneel on the pad.
Hold the close parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Start from straight arms with your shoulders pulled slightly down.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, driving your elbows down beside your body.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Assisted Prone Hamstring
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight and your forehead resting on your hands.
Have your partner kneel at your feet and place their hands on the backs of your ankles.
Bend your knees and pull your heels toward your glutes while your partner pushes back gently.
Keep your hips pressed into the mat the whole time; do not let them lift.
Straighten your legs slowly while your partner keeps a steady, light pressure.
Breathe out as you curl and breathe in as you lower.

exercises.name: Assisted Prone Lying Quads Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead resting on your hands.
Your partner kneels beside you and holds your right ankle.
Your partner slowly bends your right knee, bringing the heel toward your glutes.
Keep your hips pressed into the floor and tell your partner when the stretch feels strong but comfortable.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Assisted Prone Rectus Femoris Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and loop a strap or towel around one ankle, or have a partner hold it.
Bend that knee and gently pull your heel toward your glutes.
Press your hips into the floor and keep your knees close together so the stretch stays in the front of the thigh.
Hold for about 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and relaxing into the stretch.
Release gently and repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: Assisted Seated Pectoralis Major Stretch With Stability Ball
aliases: seated pectoralis major stretch with stability ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with your feet flat and lace your fingers behind your head.
Have a partner stand behind you and hold the inside of your elbows.
Breathe out as your partner slowly draws your elbows back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back upright and your ribs down; tell your partner to stop at a mild, comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then have your partner release gently.

exercises.name: Assisted Side Lying Adductor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with both legs straight, resting your head on your lower arm.
Your partner stands behind you and holds your top leg under the knee and ankle.
Your partner lifts the top leg up and slightly back while you keep your hips stacked.
Relax the leg fully and tell your partner when you feel the stretch along the inner thigh.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with slow breaths, then turn over and repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: Assisted Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet held by a partner or hooked under a fixed pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your ears.
Tighten your abs, breathe out and curl up until your chest is close to your thighs.
Lead with your chest rather than pulling on your head.
Breathe in and roll back down slowly, letting your back touch the floor bit by bit.

exercises.name: Assisted Standing Chin-Up
instructions: Choose the assistance weight; more weight makes it easier.
Step up and kneel or stand on the platform, then grip the handles with palms facing you.
Start with your arms straight and your shoulders pulled down.
Breathe out and pull until your chin is above the handles.
Lower slowly to straight arms before the next rep.

exercises.name: Assisted Standing Pull-Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight to a level that lets you do clean reps.
Step onto the platform and take the handles with your palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down.
Breathe out and pull up until your chin clears the handles.
Lower under control, then reduce the assistance as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Assisted Standing Triceps Extension (with Towel)
instructions: Stand tall and hold one end of a towel in your right hand with that elbow bent and pointing up beside your head.
Reach your left hand behind your lower back and grab the other end of the towel.
Breathe out and straighten your right arm toward the ceiling while your left hand pulls down to resist.
Keep the right elbow close to your ear and stop when the arm is straight.
Let the right hand sink back behind your head under control while the left hand keeps the towel tight.
Finish your reps, then switch the hand positions.

exercises.name: Assisted Wide-Grip Chest Dip (kneeling)
instructions: Choose the assistance weight; more weight means more help.
Grip the wide dip handles and place your knees on the pad one at a time until you are supported on straight arms.
Lean your chest forward slightly and keep your shoulders down.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the handles.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms.
Step off carefully one knee at a time when you finish.

exercises.name: Astride Jumps
instructions: Stand with your feet together and hands on your hips or arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump, landing with your feet wide apart.
Land softly with knees bent and pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Jump again and bring your feet back together.
Keep a steady, bouncy rhythm and breathe evenly.

exercises.name: Back And Forth Step
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Step your right foot forward and shift your weight onto it, bending the knee slightly.
Push off the right foot to bring it back beside the left.
Step the right foot backward, touch down, and bring it back again.
Swing your arms naturally, keep a steady pace, then switch to the left leg.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad so it sits just below your hip bones and lock your heels under the foot rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or lightly touch your ears.
Bend forward at the hips, lowering your upper body with a straight back.
Raise your body until it forms a straight line from head to heels.
Stop there instead of leaning back past straight, then lower slowly.
Breathe in on the way down and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your feet on the platform and the back pad across your upper back.
Fasten the belt if there is one and cross your arms over your chest.
Start leaning forward with a neutral spine.
Push back against the pad until your torso is upright or slightly past.
Return slowly to the forward position.
Breathe out as you push back and in as you return.

exercises.name: Back Extension On Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie face down with your hips and belly on the ball and brace your feet wide on the floor or against a wall.
Cross your arms over your chest and let your upper body round down over the ball.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest until your body is in a straight line.
Breathe out as you rise and stop before you arch past straight.
Lower back down slowly while breathing in.

exercises.name: Back Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings and tuck your knees up so you can roll backward between your arms.
Keep turning until you hang upside down with your arms behind you.
Slowly extend your legs and lower your body until it is straight and level with the floor, facing down.
Squeeze your glutes and stomach and hold, breathing steadily.
Tuck your knees to return the way you came and drop down safely.

exercises.name: Back Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and push them forward, rounding your upper back.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release, then clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms, lift your hands slightly and open your chest.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds, then relax.

exercises.name: Backward Jump
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and make sure the space behind you is clear.
Bend into a quarter squat and bring your arms forward in front of you.
Swing your arms down and back as you jump backward off both feet.
Land on the balls of your feet first, then let your heels come down as your knees bend.
Keep your chest over your knees on landing so you do not fall back, then reset.

exercises.name: Backwards Run
instructions: Pick a flat, clear area and check behind you before starting.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean and arms bent at your sides.
Reach back with one foot and land on the ball of the foot.
Push off and continue with short, quick backward steps, pumping your arms.
Glance over your shoulder often, keep your core tight, and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Balance Board
instructions: Put the board on a flat, non-slip floor next to a wall or rail you can touch if needed.
Step on with both feet, placed evenly either side of the center, and bend your knees a little.
Shift your weight until the board is level and neither edge touches the floor.
Hold that position, keeping your chest up and your core tight, and let your ankles and knees make the small adjustments.
When it gets easy, try holding with your eyes closed or doing slow shallow squats on the board.
Breathe steadily and step off carefully when you finish.

exercises.name: Band Alternating Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your back straight.
Breathe out and curl your right hand up toward your shoulder.
Breathe in and lower it slowly while keeping tension on the band.
Curl the left hand the same way and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Band Alternating V-Up
instructions: Anchor a band low behind your head, lie on your back and hold the band in both hands with your arms straight overhead.
Keep your legs straight on the floor and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and lift your upper body and one straight leg at the same time, reaching your hands toward that foot.
Lower back down slowly with control, breathing in.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating each rep.

exercises.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the pull-up bar and pull it through itself so it is secure.
Grab the bar overhand, then place one knee or foot into the bottom of the band.
Hang with straight arms and your stomach tight.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly, letting the band stretch without bouncing you back up.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Band Assisted Wheel Rollerout
instructions: Anchor a band low in front of you and loop it around the ab wheel handle, then kneel holding the handles with the wheel under your shoulders.
Tighten your abs and keep your lower back flat.
Breathe in and roll the wheel forward slowly, letting the band stretch as your body lowers.
Go only as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Breathe out and pull the wheel back toward your knees with your abs, letting the band help.

exercises.name: Band Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with the band passing under the bench or behind your upper back and a handle or end in each hand.
Start with your hands beside your chest, elbows bent and angled slightly away from your body.
Press both hands straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Lower slowly back to your chest, keeping tension on the band.
Exhale as you press and keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Band Bent-Over Hip Extension
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you, loop it around one foot and step forward until it is lightly stretched.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and rest your hands on your thighs or a support.
Stand on the other leg with a soft knee and brace your core.
Push the banded leg straight back by squeezing your glute until it lines up with your body.
Hold for a second, then let the leg come forward slowly.
Breathe out as you push back; switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Loop a small band around both feet, lie on your back and rest your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and feet off the floor with your knees bent.
Push one leg out straight against the band while turning to bring your opposite elbow toward the bent knee.
Switch sides in a steady pedaling motion, keeping your lower back pressed down.
Breathe out each time you twist and avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Band Close-Grip Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high, above head height, and kneel or sit facing it.
Hold the band with both hands close together and your arms reaching up.
Sit or kneel tall with your stomach tight.
Pull the band down toward your upper chest, keeping your elbows close.
Let your arms rise slowly against the band's pull.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Band Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Hold an end of a resistance band in each hand and wrap it across your upper back.
Get into a push-up position with your hands pinning the band ends to the floor, about shoulder-width or narrower.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor, elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and push up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your body straight and your hips from sagging.

exercises.name: Band Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet wide and step on one end of a resistance band with one foot.
Hold the other end in the hand on the same side and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh.
Breathe out and curl your hand up toward your shoulder against the band.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Band Fixed Back Close Grip Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band securely above you and kneel or sit facing it.
Hold the band with your hands close together, arms straight up.
Sit tall and tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and pull your hands down to your upper chest, elbows driving down and slightly forward.
Return slowly until your arms are straight overhead.

exercises.name: Band Fixed Back Underhand Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band securely above head height, such as over a pull-up bar.
Stand facing the anchor and hold the band with your palms facing you, arms reaching up and forward.
Step back until the band has light tension and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and pull your elbows down to your sides, bringing your hands to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats, then let your arms return up slowly against the band.

exercises.name: Band Front Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand at your sides.
Turn your arms so they point slightly forward, halfway between the front and the side.
Breathe out and raise your arms along that angle to shoulder height, thumbs up.
Hold for a second while keeping your shoulders down.
Breathe in and lower slowly against the band's pull.

exercises.name: Band Front Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Stand tall and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and raise your arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping some tension on the band.

exercises.name: Band Hip Lift
instructions: Place a mini band just above your knees and lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Rest your arms by your sides and press your knees out slightly against the band.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top while keeping your knees pressed out.
Lower your hips slowly to just above the floor.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Band Horizontal Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, far enough away that the band is tight.
Hold the band with both hands at the middle of your chest, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly soft.
Tighten your abs and glutes, then breathe out and press your hands straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without letting your shoulders or hips turn toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest slowly, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Band Jack Knife Sit-Up
instructions: Anchor a band low behind your head, lie flat and hold it with both hands, arms straight overhead.
Keep your legs straight and together, and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and lift your arms, upper body and legs at the same time, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Balance briefly at the top with your body folded into a V.
Breathe in and lower your arms and legs back to the floor slowly.

exercises.name: Band Kneeling One Arm Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band above head height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm reaching up and slightly forward.
Kneel tall with your hips forward and your stomach braced.
Pull your elbow down to your side, bringing your hand to shoulder level.
Return slowly to the stretched position, then switch arms after your set.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Band Kneeling Twisting Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high, kneel facing away from it and hold the ends beside your head.
Keep your hips stacked over your knees and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and curl down, turning your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Squeeze your side for a moment at the bottom.
Breathe in, rise back up slowly, then twist to the other side on the next rep.

exercises.name: Band Lying Hip External Rotation
instructions: Anchor a band at ankle height to the side of the leg you will work and loop it around that ankle.
Lie face down with your forehead on your hands and bend that knee to 90 degrees, so the band pulls the foot outward.
Keep both hips flat on the floor and your thighs still.
Rotate your hip to bring the foot in toward the middle, across toward the other leg, against the band.
Let the foot return out slowly to the start.
Breathe steadily; do slow reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Band Lying Hip Internal Rotation
instructions: Anchor a band at ankle height on the side opposite the leg you will work and loop it around that ankle.
Lie face down and bend that knee to 90 degrees, so the band pulls the foot inward.
Keep both hips pressed into the floor and the knee in place.
Let the foot move out to the side, rotating the hip inward against the band.
Go only as far as your hip allows without your pelvis lifting, then return slowly.
Breathe steadily; finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Band Lying Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Anchor a band low beyond your feet, loop it around both ankles and lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands at your sides or under your lower back and press your lower back down.
Breathe out and lift your straight legs together until they point almost straight up.
Breathe in and lower them slowly against the band's pull.
Stop just above the floor before starting the next lift.

exercises.name: Band One Arm Overhead Biceps Curl
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at about shoulder height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the free end in the hand nearer the anchor and raise that arm out to the side, level with your shoulder, palm facing up.
Breathe out and curl your hand toward the side of your head, keeping the elbow at shoulder height.
Squeeze the biceps for a second.
Breathe in and straighten the arm slowly; switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Band One Arm Single Leg Split Squat
aliases: one arm single leg split squat
instructions: Stand about two steps in front of a bench and place the middle of a band under your front foot.
Hold the band's other end in the hand on the same side as your front foot, at shoulder height.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench and use your free hand on a support if needed.
Lower straight down by bending the front knee until the thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to rise against the band, keeping your torso upright and not leaning toward the band.
Breathe out as you rise; finish all reps, then switch legs and hands.

exercises.name: Band One Arm Standing Low Row
instructions: Anchor a band low, near the floor, and hold it in one hand.
Step back into a split stance and hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Start with your arm straight toward the anchor.
Row your hand to your hip, keeping your elbow close and your shoulders square.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Band One Arm Twisting Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height, stand with your back to the anchor and hold the band in one hand beside your chest.
Step forward until the band is tight and set your feet in a staggered stance.
Press your hand forward and slightly across your body, rotating your torso toward the opposite side as you reach.
Return slowly, letting your torso turn back and your hand come back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch arms; breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Band One Arm Twisting Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your feet, or anchor it in front of you.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm straight and your torso turned slightly toward that arm.
Pull your hand back to your side while rotating your chest away from the anchor.
Keep your back tall and your hips still on the floor.
Turn back and extend your arm slowly, then switch sides after your set.
Breathe out as you pull and turn, and in as you return.

exercises.name: Band Pull Through
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you, face away and hold it with both hands between your legs.
Walk forward until the band is tight and set your feet a little wider than hip-width.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, letting the band draw your hands back through your legs.
Keep your back flat and stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Snap your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall, arms straight.
Breathe in as you hinge and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a light band in front of your chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Stop when the band touches your chest and your shoulder blades are squeezed together.
Let your hands come back together slowly.

exercises.name: Band Push Sit-Up
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you, lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, and hold the ends near your chest.
Tighten your abs and tuck your chin slightly.
Breathe out and sit up, pressing your hands forward against the band until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly at the top with your back tall.
Breathe in, bring your hands back to your chest and roll down slowly to the floor.

exercises.name: Band Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand tall and hold a band in front of your chest with both hands, arms straight and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows soft and your shoulders down.
Breathe out and pull the band apart by moving your arms out to the sides until the band touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Breathe in and let your arms come back together slowly.

exercises.name: Band Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench and step on the middle of a resistance band with one foot.
Hold the other end with your palm facing down and rest that forearm on your thigh, wrist past the knee.
Let the band pull your hand down so the wrist bends toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift the back of your hand as high as you can.
Hold for a second, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Finish the set, then switch hands.

exercises.name: Band Seated Hip External Rotation
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your knees bent to 90 degrees and feet off or lightly on the floor.
Loop a band around one ankle and anchor it to the outside of that leg so it pulls the foot outward.
Hold the bench and keep the thigh still on the seat.
Rotate your hip to swing your foot inward toward the other leg against the band, keeping the knee in place.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Breathe steadily; do slow, controlled reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Band Seated Hip Internal Rotation
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Loop a band around one ankle and anchor it on the inside of that leg so it pulls the foot inward.
Hold the bench and keep your thigh and knee still.
Rotate your hip to move the foot outward, away from the other leg, against the band.
Return slowly to the start, staying within a pain-free range.
Breathe steadily; finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Band Seated Twist
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit on the floor side-on to it, knees slightly bent.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your chest, arms nearly straight.
Sit tall, tighten your abs and breathe out as you turn your shoulders away from the anchor.
Keep your hips still so the turn comes from your trunk.
Return slowly to the middle, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with feet hip-width apart and bring the ends up to your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Brace your stomach and stand tall.
Breathe out and press your hands straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back from arching.
Breathe in and lower your hands slowly to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Band Shrug
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends at your sides with straight arms; shorten your grip on the band for more tension.
Stand tall with your chin level.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold the squeeze briefly, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Band Side Triceps Extension
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the free end in the hand farther from the anchor.
Raise that upper arm out to the side at shoulder height and bend the elbow so your hand sits in front of your chest.
Keep the upper arm still and straighten the elbow, pushing your hand out to the side against the band.
Squeeze the back of your arm when it is fully straight.
Let the band pull your hand back slowly to the start, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Band Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with one foot and hold both ends at your shoulders.
Lift the other foot off the floor and lightly touch a wall if you need balance.
Stand tall with your stomach tight.
Breathe out and rise onto the ball of your standing foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Band Single Leg Reverse Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight in front of you.
Loop a resistance band around the ball of that foot and hold the ends with both hands.
Pull the band snug so your toes start pointing toward you.
Breathe out and press the ball of your foot away, pointing your toes as far as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and let the band slowly pull your foot back.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Band Single Leg Split Squat
instructions: Stand about two steps in front of a bench and place the middle of a band under your front foot.
Bring the band ends up to your shoulders, one in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench and stand tall.
Bend the front knee and lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to stand back up against the band.
Breathe out as you rise; finish all reps on one leg, then switch.

exercises.name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bring the ends up to the front of your shoulders, palms facing forward or toward each other.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat, keeping your chest up and heels flat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to stand against the band, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Band Squat Row
instructions: Anchor a band at about chest height and stand facing it, holding one end in each hand with arms straight.
Step back until the band is slightly tight and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up, keeping your arms reaching forward.
Drive up through your feet and, as you stand, pull your elbows back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, then extend your arms as you lower into the next squat.
Breathe in as you squat and out as you stand and row.

exercises.name: Band Standing Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high, stand facing away from it and hold the ends beside your head.
Set your feet hip-width apart and soften your knees.
Breathe out and round your upper body down toward your hips, squeezing your abs.
Keep your hands fixed by your head and your hips still.
Breathe in and slowly roll back up to standing.

exercises.name: Band Standing Rear Delt Row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand, palms facing down.
Step back until the band is tight and stand with your arms straight in front of you.
Breathe out and pull your hands toward your face, lifting your elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Band Standing Twisting Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high, stand facing away from it and hold the ends beside your head.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your abs tight.
Breathe out and curl down while rotating, bringing one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Squeeze your side at the bottom for a moment.
Breathe in, return to upright slowly and twist the other way on the next rep.

exercises.name: Band Step-Up
instructions: Place a sturdy box or step in front of you and loop the middle of a band under one foot.
Hold the band ends at your shoulders and put that same foot fully on the box.
Lean slightly forward and push through the heel on the box to stand up on it.
Stand tall at the top, bringing the other foot up beside it.
Step back down slowly with the trailing foot, keeping control with the working leg.
Breathe out as you step up; complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Band Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs.
Straighten your legs, leaving only a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and fold forward, lowering your hands toward your shins.
Keep your back flat and stop when your hamstrings are fully stretched.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand up against the band.
Breathe in as you fold and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Band Straight Back Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on a band with your feet hip-width apart, holding the ends at your thighs.
Pull your shoulders back, lift your chest and brace your core so your back is long and flat.
Unlock your knees slightly and push your hips back, sliding your hands down your thighs.
Lower only until you feel your back about to round or your hamstrings are tight, usually around the knees.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward to stand tall.
Breathe in as you hinge and out as you rise.

exercises.name: Band Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with only a slight knee bend.
Push your hips back and lower your hands down your legs with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a strong pull behind your thighs, without rounding your back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Band Twisting Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and keep your hips facing forward.
Breathe out and press one hand up while turning your chest toward the opposite side.
Breathe in and return to the center as you lower your hand.
Press with the other arm while turning the other way, and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Band Two Legs Calf Raise (Band Under Both Feet)
aliases: two legs calf raise band under both feet
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with both feet hip-width apart.
Hold one end in each hand and bring your hands up to your shoulders so the band is taut.
Stand tall with your knees straight but soft.
Breathe out and rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Hold for a second, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Keep your hands still at your shoulders throughout.

exercises.name: Band Underhand Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band above head height and sit or kneel facing it.
Hold the band with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Start with your arms reaching up and your chest tall.
Pull down toward your upper chest, keeping your elbows in front and close.
Let your arms rise slowly against the band.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Band V-Up
instructions: Anchor a band low behind your head, lie flat and hold the band with both hands, arms straight above your head.
Keep your legs straight and together and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and raise both legs and your upper body at once, reaching your hands toward your shins.
At the top, balance on your hips for a moment with your body in a V.
Breathe in and lower your legs and back slowly, stopping before they rest fully on the floor.

exercises.name: Band Vertical Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, stepping out until the band is tight.
Hold the band with both hands at your chest, feet shoulder-width apart and knees soft.
Tighten your abs and glutes, then breathe out and press your hands straight up overhead.
Keep your ribs down and your body square, without leaning or turning toward the anchor.
Lower your hands slowly back to your chest, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Band Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a chair and step on one end of a resistance band.
Hold the band with your palm facing up and rest your forearm on your thigh, wrist past the knee.
Let the band draw your hand down so your wrist bends back.
Breathe out and curl your palm up toward your forearm.
Pause, then breathe in and return slowly.
Switch hands after the set.

exercises.name: Band Y-Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, thumbs up.
Stand tall and pull your shoulders down and back.
Breathe out and raise your arms up and out until they form a Y above your head.
Hold for a second without arching your lower back.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Alternate Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms straight.
Pin your elbows to your sides and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and curl the bar up, letting your right arm drive the lift while the left arm assists.
Lower the bar slowly to full arm extension.
On the next rep let the left arm lead, and keep alternating without swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Front Squat
instructions: Place a bench behind you and set the bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward.
Stand a short step in front of the bench with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace your core and sit down and back until your glutes just touch the bench.
Keep your elbows up and your chest tall so the bar does not roll forward.
Without resting on the bench, drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Breathe out near the top and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and keep that angle fixed for the whole set.
Breathe in and lower the bar back past your head in an arc until you feel a stretch along your sides.
Keep your lower back on the bench and your belly tight.
Breathe out and pull the bar back over your chest using your lats, not by straightening your arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Biceps Curl (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: bb biceps curl with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster and grip a barbell underhand at about shoulder width.
Stand tall with your arms straight and your elbows against the plate.
Breathe out and curl the bar up until your forearms are nearly vertical.
Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Clean And Press
instructions: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, hips back, back flat and hands just outside your knees.
Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, then snap your hips forward to drive it upward.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high and knees bent.
Stand up tall, take a breath and tighten your glutes and core.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out, moving your head back slightly to let it pass.
Lower the bar to your shoulders, then to your thighs and the floor with control, breathing out as you press.

exercises.name: Barbell Clean-Grip Front Squat
instructions: Set the bar on a rack at shoulder height and step in so it touches the front of your shoulders.
Hold it with your fingertips just outside your shoulders and push your elbows up and forward.
Lift the bar off the rack, take two steps back and set your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Breathe in, brace and squat straight down, keeping your torso upright and elbows high.
Go as deep as you can while your heels stay down, then drive up through your feet.
Breathe out as you finish standing.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Bent Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked under the pads and your head at the low end.
Hold a barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width grip and bend your elbows a little.
Keeping that elbow bend fixed, lower the bar back past your head in a wide arc.
Go only as far as your shoulders allow comfortably.
Pull the bar back up over your chest by driving with the lats.
Breathe in as you lower and breathe out as you pull back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Close Grip To Skull Press
aliases: decline close grip to skull press
bb decline close grip to skull press
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with a barbell held at a close grip over your chest.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar in a slight arc toward your forehead, letting your upper arms tilt back a little.
Stop just above your forehead with your elbows pointing toward your feet.
Breathe out and press the bar back up and over your chest, straightening your arms fully.
Move slowly on the way down; use a spotter if the weight is heavy.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Pullover
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding a light barbell with a narrow overhand grip above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Lower the bar in an arc past your head until you feel a strong stretch through your chest and sides.
Pull the bar back along the same arc to above your chest.
Breathe in as the bar goes back and out as it comes up; use a light weight and move slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Press
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back under the bar.
Hold the bar with your hands clearly wider than shoulder width and lift it off the rack.
Lower it with control until it lightly touches your lower chest, elbows flaring naturally out to the sides.
Press back up by squeezing your chest, stopping just short of locking your elbows hard.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Pullover
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back with your head at the low end.
Hold the bar with a grip clearly wider than your shoulders, arms almost straight above your chest.
Lower the bar back beyond your head in a slow arc, keeping your arms long.
Stop at a deep stretch under your arms without arching your back off the bench.
Sweep the bar back to above your chest using your lats.
Breathe in on the way back and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart on flat ground.
Stand tall with your knees straight but soft and your stomach tight.
Breathe out and rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second, keeping your weight over your big toes.
Breathe in and lower your heels until they just touch the floor.
Start the next rep without resting your full weight on your heels.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Chest Squat
instructions: Set the bar on a rack at shoulder height and step in so it sits on the front of your shoulders.
Cross your arms over the bar, placing each hand on the opposite shoulder, and lift your elbows level with the floor.
Lift the bar off, step back and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace and squat down, keeping your chest up and elbows high so the bar stays in place.
Drive up through your whole foot to standing.
Breathe out at the top and keep your elbows up between reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Raise And Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a light barbell with a shoulder-width overhand grip, resting it on your thighs with straight arms.
Keeping your arms almost straight, lift the bar up in an arc until it is over your chest.
Continue the arc past your face and lower the bar behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Pull the bar back along the same path to over your chest, then lower it to your thighs.
Brace your stomach so your lower back does not arch, and breathe in as the bar goes behind your head.

exercises.name: Barbell Full Zercher Squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at about hip height.
Squat down slightly, hook the bar into the crease of your elbows and hold your hands together near your chest.
Stand up with the bar, step back and set your feet a bit wider than shoulder-width.
Breathe in, brace and sit down between your heels as deep as you can with your chest up.
Keep the bar close to your body and your elbows tucked in.
Breathe out and drive up to standing, then rack the bar when done.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench
aliases: glute bridge two legs on bench
bb glute bridge two legs on bench
instructions: Sit on the floor in front of a bench and roll a padded barbell over your legs to rest on your hip crease.
Lie back and place both heels on the bench with knees bent about 90 degrees.
Hold the bar with both hands to keep it steady.
Brace and breathe out as you push your heels into the bench to lift your hips and the bar.
Stop when your body is straight from shoulders to knees and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and lower slowly until the bar nearly touches the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Set up on a flat bench with a wide grip and use a much lighter load than your normal bench press.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your upper chest with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Lower the bar slowly toward the top of your chest, just below the collarbone, keeping your elbows flared.
Stop a few centimetres above your body and press back up along the same path.
Always have a spotter, never bounce the bar, and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Barbell High Bar Squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at upper-chest height and step under it.
Rest the bar on top of your traps, grip it just outside your shoulders and pull your elbows down.
Unrack it, step back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly.
Breathe in, brace, and bend at the knees and hips at the same time, keeping your chest up.
Let your knees move forward over your toes and sink until your hips drop below your knees.
Breathe out and push the floor away to stand up, keeping the bar over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Close Grip Bench Press
aliases: bb incline close grip bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Plant your feet and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest, keeping your elbows tucked near your sides.
Breathe out and press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Press
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with palms facing you at about shoulder width and unrack it with straight arms.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your upper chest with your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Breathe out and press it back up to full arm extension.
Keep your wrists firm and straight; a spotter helps with the unusual grip.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and place a barbell on the floor under its top end.
Lie face down with your chest on the pad and your feet planted.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width and let it hang with straight arms.
Row the bar up toward the bench, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower it slowly to a full stretch without lifting your chest off the pad.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Lie on a bench set to about 45 degrees and hold a barbell straight above your shoulders with a shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows locked for the whole set; the arms do not bend at any point.
Let your shoulder blades sink back toward the bench so the bar drops a few centimetres.
Push the bar toward the ceiling by spreading your shoulder blades and reaching your shoulders forward.
Hold the top for a second, then lower slowly; breathe out as you reach up.

exercises.name: Barbell Jefferson Squat
instructions: Stand over the middle of the bar so it runs between your legs, feet wider than your shoulders and turned out.
Squat down and grip the bar with one hand in front of your body and the other behind it.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and brace your core.
Drive through your feet and stand up, keeping your hips and shoulders square instead of twisting.
Lower back down under control until the bar nearly touches the floor.
Breathe out as you stand; switch which leg is forward and which hand is in front on the next set.

exercises.name: Barbell Jump Squat
instructions: Rest a light bar on your upper back and stand with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hold the bar tightly against your back so it cannot bounce.
Dip into a quarter to half squat, keeping your chest up.
Jump straight up as hard as you can by extending your hips, knees and ankles together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink back into the squat to absorb the landing.
Reset your stance and breathe before each jump.

exercises.name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with your feet together.
Take a big step out to one side, toes pointing forward or slightly out.
Sit your hips back over the stepping leg and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the bent knee in line with your toes.
Push off the bent leg to bring your feet back together.
Breathe out as you push back; alternate sides or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Barbell Leg Twist Press
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor and press a light barbell up over your chest with straight arms, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift your legs with your knees bent at about a right angle over your hips, knees and feet together.
Keeping the bar steady and your shoulders down, slowly lower both knees to one side as far as you can control.
Breathe out and use your abs to bring your legs back to the center.
Lower your legs to the other side, and keep the range small if your lower back lifts or the bar wobbles.

exercises.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at mid-chest height and step under it.
Rest the bar across the back of your shoulders, below the top of the traps, with a fairly wide grip.
Lift the bar off the rack, take two short steps back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in deeply, brace your stomach and push your hips back as your knees bend.
Lean your chest forward enough to keep the bar over the middle of your feet and go down until your hips are just below your knees.
Breathe out and drive up, keeping your back flat until you stand tall.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Back Of The Head Tricep Extension
aliases: lying back of the head tricep extension
bb lying back of the head tricep extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your head near the end and hold a barbell over your chest, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Tilt your arms back a little so the bar sits above your face rather than your chest.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar in an arc behind the top of your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and roughly shoulder-width apart.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to bring the bar back over your face.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Close-Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and take the bar with your hands about a fist's width inside shoulder width.
Hold it straight above your chest with your shoulder blades squeezed together.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your lower chest, brushing your elbows past your ribs.
Breathe out and drive the bar back up, focusing on straightening your elbows.
Keep your hips on the bench and your feet planted.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Close-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with your hands about 15 cm apart.
Tilt your arms back slightly so the bar sits over your eyes.
Breathe in and bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward the top of your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close together rather than flaring out.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to bring the bar back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your head near the end and hold the bar over your chest at shoulder width, palms facing away.
Let your upper arms angle back slightly toward your head and lock them in that position.
Breathe in and bend your elbows so the bar travels down behind the top of your head.
Go as low as you can control while feeling a stretch in the back of your arms.
Breathe out and straighten your elbows to return the bar above your face.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Lifting (on Hip)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and roll a padded bar over your hips.
Bend your knees and plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins will be vertical at the top.
Hold the bar in place with both hands, tuck your chin and brace your core.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips under control, breathing out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Preacher Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a raised flat bench so your shoulders are at the end and your arms hang straight down.
Have the barbell on the floor or handed to you and grip it underhand at shoulder width.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your forehead without lifting your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight again.

exercises.name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press a barbell up over your chest with a shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling and your upper arms fixed.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward the top of your head.
Stop when your forearms are about level with the bench.
Breathe out and extend your elbows to bring the bar back to the start.

exercises.name: Barbell Narrow Stance Squat
instructions: Take the bar on your upper back from a rack and step out.
Set your feet about hip-width apart or slightly closer, toes pointing forward.
Breathe in, brace and bend your knees, letting them travel forward over your toes.
Keep your chest up and your heels down as you lower as far as you can control.
Push up through your whole foot to standing.
Breathe out at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell One Arm Bent Over Row
aliases: bb one arm bent over row
instructions: Stand beside a loaded barbell and grip it in the exact middle with one hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and rest your free hand on your thigh or a bench.
Let the bar hang below your shoulder, keeping it level.
Pull it toward your hip, keeping your elbow close and your shoulders square.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then finish your reps and switch sides.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Barbell One Arm Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and hold a barbell in one hand at its center, arm straight above your chest.
Use your free hand on the floor or on the bar's end to keep it level at first.
Breathe in and lower the bar until the back of your upper arm rests on the floor.
Breathe out and press the bar back up until your arm is straight.
Keep the bar level and your wrist straight; switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Barbell One Arm Side Deadlift
instructions: Place the bar beside one foot, running front to back, and stand next to its middle.
Squat down and grip the bar exactly at its center so it balances front to back.
Flatten your back, square your shoulders and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your feet, keeping your torso straight and not tilting toward the bar.
Lower it the same way, hips back and knees bent, until it nearly touches the floor.
Breathe out as you stand; finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Barbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart over a light barbell and grip it in the middle with one hand.
Squat down with a flat back, chest up and your free arm out for balance.
Drive hard through your legs and extend your hips to send the bar upward close to your body.
Pull your elbow high, then punch your arm straight overhead as you drop into a quarter squat under the bar.
Stand up tall with the bar locked out and balanced over your shoulder.
Lower it under control to your shoulder, then to the floor, and switch hands after your set.

exercises.name: Barbell One Leg Squat
instructions: Set a bench behind you and rest a light bar on your upper back.
Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the other foot just off the floor in front of you.
Brace your core and slowly sit back and down on the standing leg until you touch the bench.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes and your chest up.
Drive through the heel of the standing leg to rise without pushing off with the free foot.
Breathe out as you stand; finish one side before switching.

exercises.name: Barbell Palms Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench
aliases: palms down wrist curl over a bench
bb palms down wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay your forearms across it with your wrists just past the edge.
Hold a light barbell with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar lower slowly so your knuckles point toward the floor.
Lift the back of your hands up as high as you can, moving only at the wrists.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly; keep your forearms pressed into the bench and breathe normally.

exercises.name: Barbell Palms Up Wrist Curl Over A Bench
aliases: palms up wrist curl over a bench
bb palms up wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and rest your forearms on it, wrists hanging over the edge.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingers while keeping hold of it.
Curl the bar back into your palm and then bend the wrists up as far as they go.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly without lifting your forearms off the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell Pin Presses
instructions: Set a flat bench in a power rack and place the pins a few centimeters above your chest when lying down.
Load the bar on the pins, lie under it and grip it about shoulder-width or a little wider.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.
Breathe out and press the bar off the pins until your arms are straight.
Lower it under control back onto the pins, let it settle fully, then press again.

exercises.name: Barbell Press Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet anchored, holding a light barbell across your chest with an overhand grip.
Brace your abs and sit up in one smooth curl.
As you come up, press the bar straight above your head until your arms are locked out.
Lower the bar back to your chest and roll down slowly to the floor.
Breathe out as you sit up and press, and breathe in on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest-down on it with your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down and hold a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your shoulders while your upper arms stay vertical.
Squeeze hard at the top for a second.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder-width grip.
Keep a small, fixed bend in your elbows and brace your stomach.
Lower the bar back over your head in a smooth arc until your arms are roughly in line with your body.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same path.
Breathe in as the bar travels back and out as it returns.

exercises.name: Barbell Pullover To Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and hold a barbell over your chest with a grip about shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar back over your face and behind your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a good stretch under your arms, keeping your lower back on the bench.
Pull the bar back over your face and lower it to your lower chest.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight to finish the rep.
Breathe in as the bar goes back and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Stand tall and hold a light barbell behind your hips with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Lean forward very slightly from the hips and keep your arms straight.
Breathe out and lift the bar backward and up, away from your body, by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Stop when you feel the back of your shoulders working hard; the range is short.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly back to your hips.

exercises.name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees a little and hinge forward until your chest is close to level with the floor, back flat.
Breathe out and pull the bar toward your upper chest, keeping your elbows out wide.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar until your arms are straight, without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Barbell Rear Lunge (Same Leg, Forward Lean)
aliases: rear lunge same leg forward lean
bb rear lunge same leg forward lean
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and land on the ball of that foot.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, letting your chest lean slightly forward over the front thigh.
Keep most of your weight in the front heel.
Push through the front heel to bring the back foot forward to the start.
Repeat on the same leg for all reps, then switch, breathing out as you rise.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar underhand with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.
Unrack the bar with straight arms over your chest; use a spotter, as this grip is less secure.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and press the bar back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Decline Bench Press
aliases: bb reverse grip decline bench press
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back under the bar.
Grip the bar underhand, slightly wider than shoulder width, and have a spotter help you unrack it.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms in a steady line.
Keep your thumbs wrapped around the bar, breathe out on the press and rack it with your spotter's help.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Press
aliases: bb reverse grip incline bench press
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back under the bar with your feet flat.
Grip the bar underhand about shoulder-width apart and unrack it with a spotter's help.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Row
aliases: bb reverse grip incline bench row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down on it with your chest on the pad.
Hold a barbell below you with palms facing forward, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell over your chest with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly toward your forehead.
Stop just above your forehead without letting your elbows drift out.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold a barbell with palms facing down at shoulder width, arms almost straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up, keeping your wrists in line with your forearms.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical.
Lower slowly and with control; use a lighter weight than for a normal preacher curl.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl (Kneeling Over Bench)
aliases: reverse wrist curl kneeling over bench
bb reverse wrist curl kneeling over bench
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay your forearms across it, hands just past the edge.
Hold a light barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing the floor, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let your wrists bend down so the bar hangs below the bench line.
Breathe out and lift the backs of your hands toward the ceiling, moving only at the wrists.
Hold for a second, then breathe in and lower the bar slowly.
Keep your forearms pressed into the bench the whole time.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollerout
instructions: Kneel on a mat with a barbell loaded with round plates on the floor in front of your knees.
Grip the bar at shoulder width with your shoulders stacked over it.
Brace your abs and roll the bar forward slowly, letting your hips follow.
Go only as far as you can keep your lower back from sagging.
Breathe out and pull the bar back under your shoulders using your abs.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollerout From Bench
instructions: Load a barbell with round plates on the floor in front of a flat bench and kneel on the end of the bench.
Hold the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, arms straight under your shoulders.
Brace your abs, tuck your hips slightly and roll the bar forward as far as you can control.
Keep your back flat and do not let your hips drop toward the floor.
Pull the bar back toward the bench with your abs, breathing out as you return.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Behind Head Military Press
aliases: bb seated behind head military press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with your feet flat and take the bar from the rack onto your upper back, hands wider than shoulder width.
Sit tall, brace your stomach and keep your head slightly forward.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Breathe in and lower it slowly behind your head to about ear level, not lower.
Stop the set if you feel any pinching in the shoulder.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Bradford Rocky Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench and hold a barbell at your upper chest with an overhand grip a bit wider than your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
Press the bar up just high enough to clear the top of your head.
Lower it behind your head to the top of your neck.
Press it back over your head and lower it to the front of your shoulders.
Keep the movement smooth and breathe out on every press.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench and place the balls of your feet on a weight plate or low block, heels hanging off.
Rest a padded barbell across your thighs just above your knees and hold it in place.
Let your heels sink below the block for a full stretch.
Breathe out and push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly back to the stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise (Hip-Width Stance)
aliases: bb seated calf raise hip-width stance
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet hip-width apart and toes on a raised plate.
Place a barbell, wrapped in a pad or towel, across the bottom of your thighs and steady it with your hands.
Lower your heels toward the floor until you feel the calves stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Pause at the top, keeping your feet straight.
Breathe in and lower under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Close Grip Behind Neck Triceps Extension
aliases: seated close grip behind neck triceps extension
bb seated close grip behind neck triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a barbell overhead with your hands about a fist apart, palms facing forward.
Point your elbows toward the ceiling and keep them close to your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly behind your neck.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in the back of your arms, without letting the elbows flare.
