Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift the bar back overhead.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Close-Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide and lean forward slightly.
Hold a barbell underhand with your hands close together and rest the backs of your arms against your inner thighs.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest without moving your elbows.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Good Morning
instructions: Sit at the end of a flat bench with your feet wide and flat on the floor.
Rest a light bar on your upper back and hold it just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat and your chest up.
Lean forward from the hips, bringing your chest toward the bench as far as your back stays flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back to rise back to upright.
Breathe in as you lean forward and out as you sit up.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a barbell overhead with a narrow overhand grip.
Keep your elbows close to your head and pointing forward.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Breathe out and straighten your arms back overhead, keeping your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Twist
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet planted and a light barbell resting on your upper back.
Hold the bar wide with both hands and sit tall.
Keeping your hips still, turn your shoulders to one side in a controlled motion.
Return to the middle and turn to the other side.
Keep the pace slow and steady; do not swing the bar.

exercises.name: Barbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and a light barbell resting across your upper back.
Hold the bar with both hands and brace your abs.
Bend straight sideways to the right, keeping your chest facing forward.
Use the left side of your waist to pull yourself back to upright.
Repeat to the left, and avoid leaning forward or twisting.

exercises.name: Barbell Side Split Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and take a wide stance, toes turned slightly out.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Bend one knee and sit your hips back toward that heel while the other leg stays straight.
Lower until the working thigh is near parallel, keeping its knee in line with your toes.
Press through that foot to rise back to the wide stance.
Complete all reps on that side, then switch, breathing out as you push up.

exercises.name: Barbell Side Split Squat (Alternating)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet about twice shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Shift your hips toward one foot, bending that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Lower until the bent thigh is close to parallel with the floor, keeping your chest up and that heel down.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Shift straight into the same movement on the other side.
Keep alternating, breathing in as you lower and out as you push back.

exercises.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on your right leg holding a light barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep a small bend in the right knee.
Breathe in and hinge forward at the hips while your left leg lifts straight behind you.
Keep your hips square to the floor and your back flat as the bar slides down toward your shin.
Breathe out and drive the right hip forward to stand, lowering the back leg.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Sitted Alternate Leg Raise
instructions: Sit tall on the end of a bench with a light barbell resting across your lower thighs, holding it in place with both hands.
Lean back very slightly and tighten your abs, keeping your back straight.
Straighten one leg and lift it as high as you can, pressing that thigh up against the bar.
Breathe out as you lift, then lower the foot slowly back to the floor.
Switch legs on each rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Sitted Alternate Leg Raise (Pause at Top)
aliases: sitted alternate leg raise pause at top
bb sitted alternate leg raise pause at top
instructions: Sit upright near the edge of a bench, rest a light barbell across your thighs and steady it with your hands.
Brace your abs and keep your chest lifted.
Lock one knee straight and raise that leg until it is about level with the bench.
Hold for a moment, breathing out, then lower it slowly without letting it drop.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating each time.

exercises.name: Barbell Skier
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a light barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Soften the knees and push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and swing the bar up in front of you with straight arms to about eye level.
Control the bar at the top without leaning back.
Let it swing back down as you hinge again and flow straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Speed Squat
instructions: Load the bar to roughly half of what you would normally squat and set it on your upper back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Lower at a steady, controlled pace to your normal squat depth.
Without bouncing, reverse and drive up as fast as you can while keeping good form.
Finish tall without letting the bar leave your back.
Breathe in before each rep and out at the top; keep sets short so every rep stays fast.

exercises.name: Barbell Split Squat (Bar at Hips)
aliases: bb split squat bar at hips
instructions: Deadlift a barbell up to your hips with an overhand grip just outside your thighs.
Step one foot forward into a long split stance, back heel raised.
Keep your arms straight, your shoulders back and the bar level.
Breathe in and lower straight down until the back knee is just above the floor.
Breathe out and drive through the front foot to rise, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Finish the set, then switch the front leg.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat (on Knees)
instructions: Put a pad or folded mat under your knees inside a rack and set the bar at a height you can reach while kneeling.
Kneel with your knees hip-width apart, rest the bar on your upper back and hold it firmly.
Brace your core and sit your hips back toward your heels, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your glutes are just above your heels.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward until you are kneeling tall.
Breathe in as you sit back and out as you drive up.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat Jump Rear Lunge (No Step)
aliases: squat jump rear lunge no step
bb squat jump rear lunge no step
instructions: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace and lower into a squat.
Breathe out and jump straight up, holding the bar firmly against your back.
Land softly with bent knees and sink right into the next movement.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, then push through the front foot to stand.
Repeat, alternating the lunge leg.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat Jump Step Rear Lunge
aliases: bb squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: Place a light barbell on your upper back and stand about a foot in front of a low, stable step.
Brace your stomach and dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and forward onto the step, landing softly on both feet with knees bent.
Step back down to the floor one foot at a time.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, lower with control, then push back to standing.
Reset and repeat, switching the lunge leg each time.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Ab Rollerout
instructions: Stand behind a barbell loaded with round plates, then bend down and grip it at shoulder width with straight arms.
Brace your abs hard and round your upper back slightly.
Roll the bar forward slowly, keeping your hips in line and your knees straight.
Stop at the furthest point you can hold without your lower back sagging.
Pull the bar back toward your feet with your abs until you return to the start, breathing out on the way back.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a barbell behind you, held at arm's length against the back of your thighs.
Grip it with your palms facing backward and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingers so your wrists open.
Breathe out and curl the bar back up by bending your wrists toward your forearms.
Keep your arms straight and still; only the wrists move.
Lower slowly and breathe in on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Bradford Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell at your upper chest with a grip a bit wider than your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your lower back stays neutral.
Press the bar up just enough to pass over your head and lower it behind your neck.
Press it back over your head and bring it down to the front again.
Breathe out on each press and keep the bar close to your head.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Close Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold a barbell underhand with your hands about 15 cm apart.
Let the bar hang against your thighs and keep your elbows close to your ribs.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your upper chest.
Keep your chest up and avoid leaning back.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Close Grip Military Press
aliases: bb standing close grip military press
instructions: Take the bar from a rack at upper chest height with your hands just inside shoulder width.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, elbows slightly in front of the bar, stomach braced.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it clears your face.
Finish with arms straight and the bar over the middle of your head.
Breathe in and lower it slowly to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Concentration Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell underhand at shoulder width and stand with your feet wider than your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, arms hanging straight down.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your chest, keeping your upper arms pointing at the floor.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Front Raise Over Head
aliases: bb standing front raise over head
instructions: Stand tall and hold a light barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Brace your stomach and keep your arms straight with soft elbows.
Breathe out and lift the bar in front of you, past shoulder height, until it is over your head.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar along the same path to your thighs.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Set a barbell on your upper back as you would for a squat and step onto a sturdy block or plate with the balls of your feet.
Stand tall with your knees straight but not locked, feet hip-width apart.
Lower your heels below the edge until the calves stretch.
Breathe out and drive up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Keep your body upright and avoid bouncing at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, brace your stomach and press a barbell overhead with a narrow overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Reverse Grip Curl
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the bar with palms down at shoulder width.
Tuck your elbows against your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar to shoulder height, keeping your knuckles facing up.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise
aliases: bb standing rocking leg calf raise
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart on flat ground.
Shift your weight back onto your heels and lift your toes off the floor.
Rock forward and rise up high onto the balls of your feet.
Pause briefly at the top, then rock back through flat feet onto your heels again.
Keep your body straight and move from the ankles, not the hips.
Breathe steadily and use a light weight until the rhythm feels stable.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, knees soft, and a light barbell resting across your upper back.
Hold the bar wide and brace your abs.
Turn your shoulders to one side while your hips stay facing forward.
Rotate back through the middle to the other side.
Move with control rather than momentum and keep breathing.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl
aliases: bb standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall and grip a barbell underhand with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Let the bar hang at your thighs with your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest without leaning back.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Wide Military Press
instructions: Take the bar from a rack at upper chest height with your hands well outside shoulder width.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Wide-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell underhand with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your elbows by your sides and your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without lifting your elbows.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Barbell Stiff Leg Good Morning
instructions: Rest a light bar on your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Straighten your legs, leaving only a tiny bend so your knees are not locked hard.
Brace your core and set your back flat.
Hinge forward by pushing your hips back until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Breathe in as you fold and out as you rise; stop short if your back starts to round.

exercises.name: Barbell Upright Row (Close Grip)
instructions: Stand tall and hold a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip, hands about a fist apart.
Brace your stomach and keep the bar close to your body.
Breathe out and lead with your elbows to pull the bar up to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows higher than your wrists at the top and stop if your shoulders pinch.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

exercises.name: Barbell Upright Row (Shoulder-Width Grip)
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Stand tall, brace your stomach and relax your neck.
Breathe out and pull your elbows out to the sides, lifting the bar to your lower chest.
Pause briefly with your elbows level with your shoulders, not above them.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Weightlifting Complex
instructions: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, grip it just outside your legs and set a flat back.
Pull the bar from the floor, extend your hips explosively and catch it on the front of your shoulders in a partial squat.
From that position, breathe in and squat all the way down with elbows high, then stand up.
Dip your knees slightly and drive up with your legs to push the bar overhead, locking your arms.
Lower the bar to your shoulders, then to your hips and back to the floor under control.
Rest briefly and repeat the whole sequence.

exercises.name: Barbell Wide Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted and grip the bar about one and a half times shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades back and down, then unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, letting your elbows travel out to the sides.
Press back up powerfully until your arms are straight but not forcefully locked.
Inhale on the descent and exhale as you drive up; keep the weight moderate to protect your shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Wide Reverse Grip Bench Press
aliases: bb wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Take an underhand grip clearly wider than your shoulders and unrack the bar with a spotter.
Lower the bar under control to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are extended, keeping the bar steady.
Start with a light weight, breathe out on each press and keep your back on the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell Wide Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back from a rack and step out.
Place your feet well wider than your shoulders with your toes turned out to match.
Breathe in, brace and squat down, pushing your knees out in line with your toes.
Keep your shins fairly vertical and your chest up as you reach parallel or a bit below.
Drive up through your heels and mid-foot to stand.
Breathe out at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip about one and a half times shoulder width.
Stand tall with your stomach braced and chest up.
Breathe out and drive your elbows out to the sides to lift the bar toward your lower chest.
Stop when your upper arms are level with the floor.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Curl (Kneeling Over Bench)
aliases: bb wrist curl kneeling over bench
instructions: Kneel next to a flat bench and lay your forearms across it with your hands hanging off the far side.
Hold a barbell with your palms up and hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar lower toward the floor so your wrists bend back.
Breathe out and curl your palms up toward you as far as they go.
Squeeze for a moment, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Keep your elbows and forearms pinned to the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell Zercher Squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at about the height of your lower ribs.
Hook the bar in the bend of both elbows, clasp your hands together and pull it close to your body.
Lift it off, step back and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace and squat down, keeping your chest up and your upper back tight.
Go as low as you can with a flat back, then drive up through your feet.
Breathe out at the top; pad the bar if it hurts your arms.

exercises.name: Basic Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Breathe in and raise your arms overhead.
Breathe out and fold forward from the hips, reaching your hands down toward your toes.
Let your head and neck relax and bend your knees a little if you cannot reach comfortably.
Hold for a few breaths, then roll up slowly to standing.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Stand facing the anchor and hold one rope end in each hand with the ropes slightly slack.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart, bend your knees and hips into a half squat, and brace your stomach.
Move your arms up and down quickly, one after the other, to send waves down the ropes.
Keep the movement coming from your shoulders and keep your back flat.
Breathe steadily and keep going for the set time, then rest.

exercises.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle on a low pulley and face away from the machine, holding the handle in one hand behind you.
Step forward until your arm is pulled back behind your body with a stretch in the biceps.
Curl the handle forward and up without letting your elbow drift in front of your body.
Lower it back to the stretch slowly, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees about a hand's width off the floor.
Move your right hand and left foot forward a short step at the same time.
Then move your left hand and right foot forward.
Keep your back flat, hips low and knees off the floor, and breathe steadily as you crawl.

exercises.name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and lace your fingers behind your head.
Point your elbows out to the sides.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together, lifting your chest.
Hold the stretch for about 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Relax and repeat two or three times without pushing your head forward.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
instructions: Fasten the belt around your hips and attach it to the machine, then stand on the platform with feet a little wider than hip-width.
Hold the handles lightly for balance and release the stop so the load hangs from your hips.
Sit straight down between your heels until your thighs are about parallel, chest up.
Stand back up by pushing the floor away, keeping your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, place your hands beside your hips and grip the edge.
Walk your feet out until your legs are straight and only your heels touch the floor, hips just in front of the bench.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips, keeping your back close to the bench.
Stop when your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Bench Dip (knees Bent)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet out until your hips are just off the bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor, keeping your back close to the bench.
Stop when your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Bench Dip On Floor
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, put your hands next to your hips with fingers forward, and plant your feet on the floor with knees bent.
Lift your hips off the bench and move them just in front of it so your arms hold your weight.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower your hips toward the floor until your elbows reach about a right angle.
Keep your back close to the bench and your shoulders down away from your ears.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and breathe out as you rise.

exercises.name: Bench Hip Extension
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench so your hips are at the end and your legs hang toward the floor.
Hold the sides of the bench to keep your upper body still.
Squeeze your glutes and lift both legs together until they are in line with your body.
Keep your legs straight and do not swing or arch your lower back to get higher.
Lower your legs slowly until your feet are close to the floor.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width, pull your shoulder blades together and unrack it over your chest.
Breathe in and lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, elbows angled about 45 degrees from your body.
Touch lightly without bouncing, then press the bar up and slightly back to over your shoulders.
Breathe out near the top and keep your hips and upper back on the bench the whole time.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with the dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them up beside your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Lower them slowly until they are level with your chest and your elbows sit just below the bench.
Press back up, letting the dumbbells move slightly toward each other at the top.
Keep your feet flat and shoulder blades pulled back; breathe in on the way down and out on the press.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so the bar lines up with your mid-chest, then lie down.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and rotate it to unhook it.
Lower the bar slowly until it lightly touches your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, and rotate the bar to hook it when you finish.
Breathe in while lowering and out while pressing; set the safety stops just above chest level.

exercises.name: Bench Pull-Ups
instructions: Lay a sturdy bar across two benches so it is stable, and lie on your back under it.
Grip the bar overhand a little wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your legs or bend your knees and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Breathe out and pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bent Knee Lying Twist
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and together.
Stretch your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down.
Breathe out and let both knees lower slowly to the right while your shoulders stay on the floor.
Pause when you feel a comfortable stretch, then breathe in and bring the knees back to the middle using your stomach.
Lower them to the left and keep alternating slowly.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder-width, feet hip-width apart.
Soften your knees and push your hips back until your chest leans well forward, back flat.
Let the bar hang under your shoulders with straight arms and a tight stomach.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are straight, without standing up.
Breathe out as you pull and breathe in as you lower.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from the hips with soft knees until your chest is well forward and your back is flat.
Let the dumbbells hang under your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells up to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly to straight arms without standing up.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the bar with palms facing forward, hands about shoulder width.
Let the bar hang against your thighs and tuck your elbows to your sides.
Breathe out and bend your elbows to bring the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing it, close enough that the cable runs straight up.
Hold the bar underhand at shoulder width with your arms straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your chest, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs and your shoulders back.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without swinging.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold an EZ bar on the outer angled grips, palms up.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs and your chest up.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without letting your elbows move forward.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Grip the handles with palms facing up.
Breathe out and curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

exercises.name: Biceps Leg Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and feet flat.
Reach down with one hand and grip under the thigh of the same-side leg, just behind the knee, palm facing up.
Relax that leg and keep your elbow against your side.
Breathe out and curl your hand up, lifting the leg with your biceps rather than your hip.
Lower the leg slowly to the floor, finish the set and switch sides.

exercises.name: Biceps Narrow Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears and tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward the bar by bending your elbows.
Go up until your chin clears the bar, keeping your elbows in front of you.
Breathe in and lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: Biceps Pull-Up
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with palms facing you at shoulder width and hang with straight arms.
Set your shoulders down and keep your legs still.
Breathe out and pull yourself up, thinking of squeezing your biceps to bring the bar to your chest.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head and lift your shoulders and feet off the floor.
Bend one knee toward your chest while the other leg stretches out just above the floor.
Turn your upper body so the opposite elbow moves toward the bent knee.
Switch legs in a smooth pedaling motion and turn to the other side.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and breathe out on each twist.

exercises.name: Body-Up
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight slightly forward so your hands sit just in front of your elbows.
Breathe out and press your palms into the floor to straighten your elbows, lifting your forearms off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your stomach tight as you rise.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower back onto your forearms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall or chair for light support.
Stand tall with your stomach tight and knees straight but soft.
Breathe out and rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second, keeping your ankles from rolling out.
Breathe in and lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Stand on a step edge to make it harder.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Drop Jump Squat
instructions: Stand on the edge of a low box, about knee height or lower.
Step off the box with one foot; do not jump down.
Land on both feet at the same time with knees bent and hips back.
As soon as you touch the floor, swing your arms up and jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly, reset and climb back onto the box for the next rep.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Incline Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and place your forearm on it, elbow directly under your shoulder.
Stack your feet, or stagger them for more balance, with your legs straight.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold without letting your hips drop or roll forward, breathing steadily.
Lower your hips with control and switch sides.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Triceps Extension
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands on the floor in front of you, shoulder-width apart, with your body leaning forward in a straight line from knees to head.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Bend your elbows to lower your forearms to the floor, letting your body move forward.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your elbows and lift back up.
Move your hands farther forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Side Lying Biceps Curl
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your head resting on your bottom arm.
Keep your top upper arm against your side with the palm facing forward.
Place the fingers of your bottom hand on the top wrist if you can reach, or simply tense the arm hard.
Breathe out and curl the top hand toward your shoulder, squeezing the biceps as hard as you can against the resistance.
Breathe in and lower the forearm slowly, then switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly.
Hold your arms out in front of you or clasp your hands at your chest.
Breathe in and sit your hips back and down as if lowering onto a chair.
Keep your heels down, chest up and knees in line with your toes as you go below parallel if you can.
Breathe out and push through your whole foot to stand up.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squatting Row
instructions: Grip a sturdy post with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit down into a squat.
Drive through your heels to stand and pull your chest toward the post as you rise.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top and breathe out.
Sit back down into the squat, letting your arms straighten.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squatting Row (with Towel)
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy post and hold one end in each hand.
Step back with straight arms and sit down into a squat.
Push through your heels to stand up and pull your chest toward the post at the same time.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Lower back into the squat with straight arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing Close-Grip One Arm Row
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy vertical post or door frame and grip it with one hand at chest height.
Walk your feet in close to the post and lean back until your arm is straight.
Keep your body straight and your free hand on your hip.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward your hand, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Lower yourself back slowly.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing Close-Grip Row
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy post or door frame and grip it with both hands, one just above the other, at chest height.
Walk your feet toward the base and lean back until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line from head to heels.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself back slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row
instructions: Grip a sturdy post or door frame with one hand at about waist height.
Place your feet close to it and lean back until your arm is straight.
Turn your body slightly so your shoulders stay square and your stomach is tight.
Breathe out and pull yourself toward the post until your hand is near your ribs.
Lower back slowly.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row (with Towel)
instructions: Wrap a towel around a sturdy post and hold both ends together in one hand.
Stand close to the post and lean back until your arm is straight.
Keep your body straight and your stomach tight.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward your hand, driving your elbow back.
Lower yourself back slowly.
Finish the set and switch hands.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing Row
instructions: Grip a sturdy post or door frame with both hands at chest height.
Walk your feet in and lean back until your arms are straight.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower back slowly; step your feet closer to make it harder.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Standing Row (with Towel)
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy post and hold one end in each hand.
Step your feet in and lean back until your arms are straight.
Keep your body straight and your stomach tight.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward the post, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself back slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down.
Raise your legs until they point straight up, knees slightly soft.
Breathe out and use your abs to lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor without letting your legs drop.
Keep the lift small and controlled rather than swinging.

exercises.name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box about a short step away, feet hip-width apart.
Swing your arms back as you dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box with both feet, knees bent and in line with your toes.
Stand tall on the box, then step down rather than jumping off.

exercises.name: Box Jump Down With One Leg Stabilization
instructions: Stand on a low box or step with your feet together.
Step forward off the box with one foot.
Land on that single leg on the ball of the foot, then let the heel settle as the knee bends.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your hips level.
Hold the landing still for 2 to 3 seconds while breathing steadily.
Step back up and repeat, alternating legs or finishing one side first.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar on a rack at upper-chest height and place a bench a short step behind where you will stand.
Duck under the bar, rest it on your upper back, grip it just outside your shoulders and lift it off the rack.
Step back until the bench is just behind your heels, feet about shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace and sit your hips back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and your knees pushed out, then drive up through your feet to stand.
Breathe out at the top; rack the bar carefully after your last rep.

exercises.name: Boxing Jab
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and both fists up by your face.
Keep your elbows in and your chin slightly down.
Extend your lead arm straight out in front of you, turning the fist palm-down as your arm straightens.
Breathe out sharply with each punch.
Snap the hand straight back to your face and keep throwing for the round time.

exercises.name: Boxing Left Uppercut
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your left foot forward, knees soft, hands up by your cheeks and chin down.
Dip slightly by bending your knees and shifting a little weight onto your left side.
Push off the floor and turn your hips and chest to the right as you drive your left fist upward.
Keep your left elbow bent and close to your body so the punch travels straight up, not in a wide arc.
Breathe out sharply as you punch, then bring your fist straight back to guard.
Reset your stance before the next punch.

exercises.name: Boxing Right Cross
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance: left foot forward, right foot back, knees soft, hands up by your chin.
Turn your right hip and shoulder forward while pivoting on the ball of your right foot.
Extend your right arm straight toward the target, turning the palm down as the arm straightens.
Keep your left hand up guarding your face and breathe out sharply as you punch.
Bring the right fist straight back to your chin and reset your stance.
Repeat at a steady pace, staying light on your feet.

exercises.name: Boxing Right Uppercut
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your left foot forward and hands guarding your chin.
Dip slightly by bending your knees and shift a little weight onto your right side.
Drive up through your legs and turn your right hip forward.
Swing the right fist upward with the elbow bent about 90 degrees and the palm facing you.
Breathe out on the punch, keep the left hand guarding, and bring the right fist straight back to your chin.
Repeat at a steady rhythm without leaning too far forward.

exercises.name: Bridge - Mountain Climber (cross Body)
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Tighten your abs and keep your hips level with your shoulders.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return that foot to the floor and drive the other knee across the other way.
Keep alternating at a controlled pace without bouncing your hips, breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Broad Jump To Vertical
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Swing your arms back, dip into a quarter squat and jump forward as far as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent and hips back.
Without pausing, swing your arms up and jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly, reset your feet and repeat.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Stand about two steps in front of a bench with the bar on your upper back.
Reach one foot back and rest its top on the bench.
Lower straight down by bending the front knee until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the middle of your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.
Breathe out as you rise; finish all reps before switching legs.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand about two steps in front of a bench holding a dumbbell at each side.
Reach one foot back and rest the top of it on the bench.
Lower by bending the front knee until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and let the front knee move forward only as far as is comfortable.
Push through the whole front foot to rise back up.
Breathe out as you rise; complete all reps on one leg, then switch.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and put a bench about two steps behind it.
Rest the bar on your upper back, unrack it and place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Position your front foot so your knee stays over the middle of the foot at the bottom.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to rise.
Breathe out as you rise; finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor just in front of your feet.
Jump your feet back into a plank, keeping your back straight and stomach tight.
Jump your feet forward again so they land just behind your hands.
Explode up into a jump, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly with bent knees and flow into the next rep, breathing out on each jump.

exercises.name: Butt-Ups
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes before you start.
Press through your forearms and lift your hips high so your body forms an upside-down V, breathing out as you rise.
Pause briefly at the top with your legs straight.
Lower your hips slowly back to the plank line without letting them sag below it.

exercises.name: Butterfly Yoga Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together in front of you.
Pull your heels in toward your body as far as is comfortable.
Hold your feet or ankles and sit up tall.
Let your knees sink toward the floor; you can press them down lightly with your elbows.
Breathe slowly and hold for 30 to 60 seconds, leaning forward from the hips for a deeper stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and bring both handles up to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Set your feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press one handle straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder slowly while the other hand stays in place.
Press with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Cable Alternate Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Take the handle in your right hand with your elbow bent and pinned to your side.
Breathe out and push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly until your forearm is just above level with the floor.
Do one rep with the right arm, then switch the handle to your left hand and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
instructions: Set a cable pulley high and attach a single handle or a rope.
Kneel on a pad facing away from the machine with your ankles secured under a bench or held by a partner.
Hold the handle against your chest with both hands and keep a straight line from your knees to your head.
Breathe in and slowly lean forward from the knees, letting the cable support part of your weight.
Breathe out and pull with your hamstrings to bring your body back upright, using a lighter weight on the stack as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Cable Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys, grab a handle in each hand and lie back.
Start with your hands beside your chest, palms facing your feet and elbows below the bench line.
Press both handles straight up until your arms are extended above your chest.
Let your hands come slightly closer at the top and squeeze your chest for a moment.
Lower slowly back to the start, breathing in, and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Cable Close Grip Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grip it underhand with your hands close together.
Stand facing the machine with your arms straight and elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze at the top while keeping your elbows still.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley, hold it in one hand and step back a little.
Bend forward at the hips and rest your free hand on your knee, letting the working arm hang straight down.
Breathe out and curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm still.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Concentration Extension (on Knee)
instructions: Set a pulley high, place a bench beside the machine and sit facing sideways to it.
Hold the handle in the hand nearest the machine and rest that elbow on top of your knee, forearm angled up toward the pulley.
Breathe out and straighten your arm by pushing the handle down and forward.
Keep the elbow planted on your knee the whole time.
Let the handle return slowly until your elbow is fully bent, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Cross-Over Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Set both pulleys high with a single handle on each.
Grab the left handle with your right hand and the right handle with your left, so the cables cross in front of you.
Kneel or sit in the middle with your arms reaching up and your chest tall.
Pull both elbows down and out to your sides until your hands reach shoulder level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together, then let the handles rise slowly.
Breathe out on the pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set both pulleys high, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance.
Lean your torso slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows and your arms open wide.
Sweep your hands down and inward in a wide arc until they cross in front of your hips.
Pause with the crossover and squeeze your chest hard; switch which hand goes on top each rep.
Let your arms open back up slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest, breathing in as they open.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope ends beside your head with your hips high and still.
Breathe out and curl your chest down toward your knees by rounding your spine, not by bending at the hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom for a second.
Let the cable pull you slowly back up until your back is long again.

exercises.name: Cable Deadlift
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and stand facing the machine, close enough that the cable runs straight up.
Set your feet hip-width apart, hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back, pull your shoulders down and brace your core.
Push through your feet and stand up, driving your hips forward at the top.
Lower by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping tension on the cable.
Breathe out as you stand and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Cable Decline Fly
instructions: Set a decline bench between two low pulleys, hold a handle in each hand and lie back with your feet secured.
Raise your arms over your chest with palms facing each other and a slight bend in your elbows.
Let the handles travel apart in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the handles back together over your lower chest by squeezing your pecs, keeping the elbow bend fixed.
Breathe in as your arms open and out as they close.

exercises.name: Cable Decline One Arm Press
instructions: Place a decline bench beside a low pulley, hold the handle in the hand nearest the machine and lie back with your legs secured.
Start with the handle beside your lower chest, elbow bent below the bench line.
Press the handle straight up until your arm is fully extended.
Lower it slowly back to your chest while keeping your torso still.
Complete your reps, turn around to work the other arm, and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Cable Decline Press
instructions: Set both pulleys at about shoulder height, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance.
Start with the handles beside your chest, elbows bent and a little below shoulder level.
Breathe out and press the handles forward and slightly downward until your hands meet in front of your lower ribs.
Squeeze your chest for a second without locking your elbows.
Breathe in and let the handles come back slowly to your chest, keeping your torso still.

exercises.name: Cable Decline Seated Wide-Grip Row
instructions: Place a low-angled bench in front of the low pulley and attach a wide bar.
Sit facing the machine with your feet braced on the platform and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Sit tall with your arms straight and your shoulders reaching forward.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, flaring your elbows out and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your back from rounding.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Drag Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grip it underhand at shoulder width.
Stand close to the machine with the bar resting against your thighs.
Breathe out and curl the bar up while pulling your elbows back, so the bar slides up your body.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest and squeeze your biceps.
Breathe in and lower the bar along the same path, bringing your elbows forward to your sides.

exercises.name: Cable Floor Seated Wide-Grip Row
instructions: Attach a wide bar to a low pulley and sit on the floor facing it with your knees slightly bent.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip and sit up straight.
Keep your torso still and pull the bar to your upper stomach, elbows out to the sides.
Squeeze between your shoulder blades for a moment.
Straighten your arms slowly, letting your shoulders move forward without rounding your back.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys around shoulder or chest height, take the handles and step forward into a split stance.
Open your arms out to the sides with a soft bend in your elbows and your chest up.
Pull your hands forward and together in a horizontal arc until they meet in front of your chest.
Pause and squeeze, keeping your elbows from bending further.
Return slowly to the stretched position while breathing in; breathe out as you bring the hands together.

exercises.name: Cable Forward Raise
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley, stand facing away from the machine and hold the bar at your thighs, palms down, with the cable between your legs.
Step forward until the weight lifts and stand tall with your stomach braced.
Breathe out and raise the bar in front of you with straight arms to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower it slowly, keeping tension on the cable.

exercises.name: Cable Front Shoulder Raise
instructions: Attach a rope or straight bar to a low pulley, face the machine and hold it with both hands at your thighs.
Step back until the weight lifts, then stand tall with your stomach braced.
Breathe out and raise your straight arms up to eye level.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Cable High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley, grip it with palms down and turn so your back faces the machine.
Step forward into a split stance, lean slightly forward and bring your hands behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Breathe out and straighten your arms forward and up until they are in line with your body.
Keep your upper arms still beside your head as you extend.
Breathe in and let your hands return slowly behind your head.

exercises.name: Cable High Row (kneeling)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and kneel facing it, a little way back.
Grab the bar overhand at shoulder-width so your arms reach up and forward.
Kneel tall with your hips forward and your stomach tight.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Pause with your shoulder blades squeezed, then extend your arms slowly.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you reach back up.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set an incline bench at about 30 to 45 degrees between two low pulleys and sit back holding a handle in each hand.
Start with the handles beside your upper chest and your elbows pointing down and slightly out.
Press the handles up and slightly inward until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Hold briefly at the top while squeezing your upper chest.
Lower back under control, breathing in, and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Bench Row
instructions: Place an incline bench facing a low pulley and attach two handles or a short bar.
Lie on the bench with your chest on the pad and take the handles with straight arms.
Pull your elbows back past your body while keeping your chest on the pad.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out at the end of the pull.
Let your arms stretch forward slowly and with control.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Fly (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Place a stability ball between two low pulleys, hold a handle in each hand and roll down until your upper back rests on the ball.
Keep your feet wide and your hips a little lower than your shoulders so your torso is on an incline.
Start with your arms above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms wide in an arc until your chest is stretched, then pull them back together over your upper chest.
Keep your stomach tight so the ball stays still, and breathe out as your hands come together.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Pushdown
instructions: Place an incline bench in front of a high pulley with a straight bar attached.
Lie back on the bench with your head toward the machine and take the bar overhead with straight arms.
Brace your stomach and keep your lower back on the pad.
Keeping your elbows almost locked, pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom, then let the bar travel back overhead slowly.
Breathe out as you pull down and in as the bar returns.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Set an incline bench in front of a low pulley with the top of the bench facing the machine and attach a straight bar or rope.
Lie back on the bench and take the attachment over your head with your elbows bent and pointing up.
Breathe out and straighten your arms forward and up until they point above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and near your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbows slowly to let the attachment return behind your head.

exercises.name: Cable Judo Flip
instructions: Set a handle on a high pulley and stand side-on to the machine, feet wider than your shoulders.
Reach up and grab the handle with both hands above the shoulder nearest the machine.
Brace your abs and pull the handle down and across your body toward your far hip, turning your torso as you go.
Let your back foot pivot so your hips turn with you, like finishing a throw.
Return slowly against the cable to the start, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable Kneeling Rear Delt Row (with Rope)
aliases: kneeling rear delt row with rope
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine, holding the ends with palms facing down.
Kneel tall with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Breathe out and pull the rope toward your forehead, driving your elbows out and back.
Spread the rope ends apart and squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Kneeling Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley, take the ends and kneel facing away from the machine.
Bring your hands behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing forward.
Lean your torso slightly forward and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and straighten your arms forward and up, spreading the rope ends at the finish.
Breathe in and let your hands return behind your head slowly, keeping your elbows still.

exercises.name: Cable Lat Pulldown Full Range Of Motion
aliases: lat pulldown full range of motion
instructions: Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Let your arms straighten fully and your shoulders rise to feel a stretch in your lats.
Start by pulling your shoulders down, then bend your elbows and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Breathe out and squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Return slowly all the way to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Pulldown (with Rope Attachment)
instructions: Attach a rope to the high pulley and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Hold one end of the rope in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Sit tall with your chest up and your arms reaching overhead.
Pull the rope down toward your upper chest, spreading the ends apart as your elbows come down.
Squeeze your back, then let the rope rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way up.

exercises.name: Cable Low Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the low row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with straight arms and sit upright with your chest up.
Pull the handle to your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without leaning back.
Let your arms straighten slowly, keeping your back straight.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Bicep Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and lie on your back on the floor or a flat bench with your feet toward the machine.
Hold the bar underhand with your arms straight along your body and your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without lifting your elbows.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and lie on your back on the floor or a bench with your feet toward the machine.
Hold the bar underhand with your hands close together and arms straight down by your thighs.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your chest with your upper arms resting on the floor or bench.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Extension Pullover (with Rope Attachment)
aliases: lying extension pullover with rope attachment
instructions: Set a rope on a low pulley and lie on a flat bench with your head toward the machine.
Reach back and hold the rope behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing up.
Straighten your elbows so the rope moves up toward the ceiling.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the rope over your chest down toward your hips.
Reverse the path slowly: arms back overhead, then bend the elbows to the start.
Breathe out as you pull over and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Fly
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys, hold a handle in each hand and lie back.
Extend your arms above your chest with palms facing each other and a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a smooth arc until you feel a good stretch in your chest.
Bring your hands back together above your chest by squeezing your pecs.
Keep your shoulders down against the bench and breathe out as you close.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension (Rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and lie on a flat bench with your head toward the machine.
Hold the rope with palms facing each other and press your arms up so your hands are over your chest.
Tilt your upper arms back slightly toward the machine and keep them fixed.
Breathe in and bend your elbows so your hands come down beside your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms, pulling the rope ends slightly apart at the top.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and hold it in one hand.
Step back, stagger your feet and hinge forward with a flat back, resting your free hand on your knee.
Let your working arm reach toward the pulley with a slight stretch in your back.
Row the handle to your hip, keeping your elbow close and your torso still.
Return slowly to the stretch, then finish your reps and switch arms.
Breathe out as you row and in as you reach.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Curl
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle underhand in one hand with the arm straight and elbow at your side.
Breathe out and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top while keeping your elbow from moving forward.
Breathe in and lower slowly; finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Decline Chest Fly
instructions: Place a decline bench beside a low pulley, lie back with your feet locked in and take the handle in the hand nearest the cable.
Raise the handle above your chest with a soft bend in the elbow and rest your free hand on your stomach.
Breathe in and open your arm out to the side in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Breathe out and sweep the handle back over your chest as if hugging a tree, keeping the elbow angle fixed.
Finish all reps, then turn the bench around and train the other side.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: Set a pulley at about chest height when you are lying on the ball, hold the handle and roll down until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body forms a flat line from knees to shoulders, feet planted wide.
Start with the arm extended above your chest and a slight bend in the elbow.
Breathe in and lower the arm out to the side until your chest feels stretched.
Breathe out and pull the handle back over your chest, keeping your hips high the whole time.
Do all your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Incline Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: Set a low pulley, grab the handle and sit on the ball, then walk your feet out until your mid and upper back rest on the ball with your hips lower than your shoulders.
Hold the handle low beside you with the arm open and the elbow slightly bent.
Breathe out and sweep the arm up and across until your hand is above your upper chest.
Pause and squeeze the top of your chest.
Breathe in and lower slowly back to the open position without letting the ball roll.
Finish the set, then repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Incline Press
instructions: Set the pulley low, hold the handle in one hand and face away from the machine in a staggered stance.
Bring the handle to the side of your chest with the elbow bent and slightly below shoulder height.
Brace your stomach and breathe out as you press the handle forward and up at about a 30 degree angle.
Stop just short of locking the elbow and squeeze your chest.
Breathe in and lower the handle back to your chest under control, keeping your hips and shoulders square.
Complete the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Incline Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm incline press on exercise ball
instructions: Set a low pulley behind you, take the handle in one hand and roll back on the ball until it supports your mid and upper back, hips slightly dropped.
Bring the handle beside your chest with the elbow bent.
Breathe out and press the handle up and slightly forward over your upper chest.
Keep your feet wide and your stomach tight so the ball does not roll.
Breathe in and lower the handle back to your chest slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Lateral Bent-Over
instructions: Set a pulley at shoulder height, hold the handle in the hand nearest the machine and step away until the cable is tight.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back so your torso is angled toward the floor.
Start with your working arm out to the side, elbow slightly bent.
Pull the handle down and across in an arc until your hand is under your chest, squeezing that side of the chest.
Let the arm return slowly, finish all reps, then switch sides; breathe out on each pull.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Preacher Curl
instructions: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and attach a single handle.
Rest the back of one upper arm on the pad and hold the handle underhand with your arm nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: Set the pulley around ball height, hold the handle and lie back so your head and upper back rest on the ball, hips up level with your knees.
Start with the handle beside your chest and the elbow pointing down and out.
Breathe out and press the handle straight up over your chest.
Keep your hips level and both shoulders on the ball; do not let the pulling side rotate.
Breathe in and bring the handle back to your chest slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a single handle attached.
Rest one upper arm on the pad and grip the handle with your palm facing down.
Breathe out and curl the handle up, keeping your wrist straight.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Straight Back High Row (kneeling)
aliases: one arm straight back high row kneeling
cable one arm straight back high row
instructions: Set a single handle at about chest height and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm straight and your torso upright.
Tighten your stomach and keep your hips and shoulders facing forward.
Pull the handle to the side of your chest, driving your elbow straight back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then extend your arm slowly.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch, breathing out on each pull.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Curl On Exercise Ball
instructions: Place an exercise ball in the middle of a cable crossover with single handles on the high pulleys.
Sit tall on the ball with feet wide and take a handle in each hand, arms raised to the sides, palms up.
Breathe out and curl both handles toward your head without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top while keeping the ball still.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly back out.

exercises.name: Cable Palm Rotational Row
instructions: Set a single handle at about waist height and stand facing the machine.
Take the handle with your palm facing down and step back until the cable is tight, knees soft.
Pull the handle toward your waist and turn your palm up as your elbow passes your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the end and breathe out.
Return slowly, turning the palm down again as your arm straightens.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable Press On Exercise Ball
instructions: Place the ball between two low pulleys, take a handle in each hand and lie back with your upper back on the ball.
Push your hips up so your body is flat from knees to shoulders and your feet are hip-width apart.
Start with the handles at the sides of your chest, elbows bent.
Breathe out and press both handles up until your arms are nearly straight over your chest.
Breathe in and lower them slowly to chest level, keeping your hips from sagging.

exercises.name: Cable Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a high pulley with your knees under the pads and hold the bar a bit wider than your shoulders.
Start with straight arms and your chest lifted.
Pull the bar down to your collarbone, thinking of putting your elbows in your back pockets.
Keep your torso nearly upright; avoid swinging back.
Return the bar slowly to the top.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Pulldown (pro Lat Bar)
instructions: Attach the angled lat bar to the high pulley and sit with your thighs secured.
Hold the grips at the ends of the bar and sit tall.
Pull the bar down in front of your face toward your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down to your sides and squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar return slowly until your arms are fully straight.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you let it up.

exercises.name: Cable Pulldown Bicep Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley, grip it underhand and step back until your arms reach up and forward.
Kneel or stand with your stomach tight and your upper arms fixed at about head height.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your forehead by bending only your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps when the bar is close to your head.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Cable Pushdown (Straight Arm, Forward Lean)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and stand facing it, about an arm's length away.
Grab the bar overhand at shoulder-width and step back to feel tension.
Hinge slightly forward with soft knees and straight arms.
Sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs, keeping your elbows locked.
Squeeze your lats, then let the bar rise slowly to eye level.
Breathe out on the way down and in on the way up.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Row (stirrups)
instructions: Set a single handle on a pulley at chest height and hold it in one hand, arm straight, palm facing down.
Stagger your feet, step back until the weight lifts and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and pull the handle toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow high and out to the side.
Squeeze the back of your shoulder for a second at the end.
Breathe in and let your arm straighten slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Drive
instructions: Attach a single handle to a pulley set at about chest height and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm reaching forward and slightly bent.
Breathe out and drive your elbow back past your torso, then straighten your arm so your hand finishes beside your hip.
Squeeze the triceps hard with the arm straight and slightly behind you.
Breathe in and let the handle return forward slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown machine and take a wide overhand grip on the long bar.
Lean your head slightly forward, keeping your back upright.
Pull the bar down behind your head to about the top of your neck.
Keep the motion smooth and stop if your shoulders feel pinched.
Let the bar rise slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
instructions: Attach ankle straps to a low pulley and lie on your back with your feet toward the machine and the straps around your ankles.
Lift your legs so your knees are bent at about a right angle over your hips, and hold the floor or a fixed object behind your head.
Tighten your abs, breathe out and curl your hips off the floor, pulling your knees toward your chest.
Pause for a second with your abs squeezed.
Breathe in and lower your hips slowly, letting the cable draw your knees back to the start.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the bar with palms facing down at shoulder width, arms straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up with your elbows fixed at your sides.
Keep your wrists flat as you reach the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly back to straight arms.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (sz-Bar) (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: reverse grip triceps pushdown sz-bar with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster with your elbows resting against its sides.
Attach an EZ-style bar to a high pulley and grip it underhand with your palms facing up.
Stand close to the machine with your elbows bent and pressed into the arm blaster.
Breathe out and press the bar toward your thighs until your elbows are straight.
Let it rise slowly back up, keeping your wrists firm.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse One Arm Curl
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and grip it with one hand, palm facing down.
Stand facing the machine with your arm straight and your elbow tucked against your side.
Breathe out and curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping your wrist straight.
Pause at the top without letting your elbow drift forward.
Breathe in and lower the handle slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a straight bar attached.
Sit with your upper arms flat on the pad and hold the bar with palms facing down.
Breathe out and curl the bar up while keeping your wrists straight.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly to almost straight arms.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and sit on a bench facing the machine.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists past your knees.
Let the cable pull your hands down so your wrists bend toward the floor.
Breathe out and raise the backs of your hands as high as you can.
Hold briefly, then breathe in and return slowly against the cable's pull.
Keep the movement at the wrists only.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse-Grip Straight Back Seated High Row
aliases: reverse-grip straight back seated high row
instructions: Set a straight bar on a high pulley and sit facing it on a bench or the floor.
Grab the bar with your palms facing up, hands about shoulder-width.
Sit tall with your arms straight up and forward.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your back straight and your elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then let the bar return slowly.
Breathe out as you pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Crossover Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor or a low bench centred between two low pulleys of a crossover station.
Take the rope on the left with your right hand and the rope on the right with your left hand so the cables cross.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight in front of you.
Pull both elbows back to your sides and squeeze your shoulder blades together, breathing out.
Return slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your back upright.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Elevated Seated Row
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit on a box or raised bench facing it.
Hold one end of the rope in each hand with your arms straight and your chest up.
Pull the rope toward your stomach, spreading the ends apart as your hands reach your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Straighten your arms slowly without letting your back round.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Extension Incline Bench Row
instructions: Place an incline bench in front of a low pulley with a rope attached.
Lie chest-down on the bench and hold one end of the rope in each hand, arms straight.
Pull the rope toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows out to the sides.
Pull the ends of the rope apart at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades, breathing out.
Let your arms straighten slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and attach a rope.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and hold the rope ends with your palms facing each other.
Breathe out and curl the rope up toward your face.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your elbows.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Cable Rope High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
aliases: rope high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley, hold one end in each hand and turn your back to the machine.
Take a split stance, lean slightly forward and bring the rope behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Breathe out and straighten your arms forward, spreading the rope ends apart at the end.
Keep your elbows close to your head throughout.
Breathe in and let the rope come back slowly behind your head.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Incline Tricep Extension
instructions: Place an incline bench in front of a low pulley with a rope attached, and lie back with your head toward the machine.
Reach back and take the rope with both hands, then raise your elbows so your upper arms point up and slightly back.
Breathe out and straighten your arms until your hands are above your face.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close together.
Breathe in and bend your elbows slowly to let the rope return behind your head.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Lying On Floor Tricep Extension
aliases: rope lying on floor tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and lie on your back on the floor with your head toward the machine.
Hold the rope with both hands and raise your upper arms so they point straight up, elbows bent.
