Breathe out and straighten your arms until your hands are over your chest.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling and close together.
Breathe in and slowly bend your elbows to lower the rope beside your head.

exercises.name: Cable Rope One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
aliases: rope one arm hammer preacher curl
instructions: Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a rope attached.
Rest one upper arm on the pad and hold the rope near its knot with your palm facing in.
Breathe out and curl the rope up, keeping your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Seated Row
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley, sit on the seat and place your feet on the platform with knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope ends with palms facing each other and sit up tall.
Pull the rope to your stomach, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out without leaning far back.
Return slowly until your arms are straight and you feel your back stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Russian Twists (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and lie with your upper back on a stability ball, side-on to the machine, hips lifted in a bridge.
Hold the handle with both hands, arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your hips level, rotate your shoulders away from the machine, rolling slightly across the ball.
Rotate back to center under control without letting the cable yank you.
Finish your reps, then turn around and work the other side.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Chest Press
instructions: Set the pulleys at about chest height when seated, place a bench between them and sit with a handle in each hand.
Sit tall with your back against the pad or upright, feet flat, and bring the handles to the sides of your chest.
Breathe out and press the handles straight forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Let your hands come slightly closer together at the end and squeeze your chest.
Breathe in and let the handles return slowly to chest level.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and sit on a bench facing away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends at the sides of your head and sit tall.
Breathe out and curl your upper body forward and down, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly while your abs are fully squeezed.
Uncurl slowly back to tall sitting without letting the weight jerk you.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and sit on the floor or a low bench facing the machine.
Grip the bar underhand with your arms straight and your elbows at your sides, back upright.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Seated High Row (v-Bar)
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a high pulley and sit facing it a little way back.
Hold the handle with straight arms reaching up and forward.
Lean back just slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your back, then extend your arms slowly.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Neck Extension (with Head Harness)
aliases: seated neck extension with head harness
instructions: Attach a head harness to a low cable and sit on a bench facing the machine.
Lean forward slightly with a straight back and let the cable pull your chin toward your chest.
Rest your hands on your thighs and keep your shoulders still.
Pull your head back slowly until you are looking slightly up.
Pause, then let your head return under control; exhale as you pull back.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Neck Flexion (with Head Harness)
aliases: seated neck flexion with head harness
instructions: Attach a head harness to a cable at about head height and sit facing away from the machine.
Sit tall and let the cable draw your head back slightly.
Place your hands on your thighs and keep your torso still.
Bring your chin down toward your chest against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly; keep the weight light and breathe out as you flex.

exercises.name: Cable Seated One Arm Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench in front of a low pulley with a single handle attached, feet wide.
Take the handle in one hand and brace the back of that arm against your inner thigh.
Breathe out and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps hard at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Overhead Curl
instructions: Place a bench in the middle of a cable crossover with single handles on the high pulleys.
Sit tall and take a handle in each hand, raising your arms out to the sides with palms up.
Breathe out and curl both handles toward your head, keeping your upper arms level.
Squeeze your biceps at the end of the curl.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly back out.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench placed between two low pulleys and hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
Lean forward with a flat back until your chest is close to your thighs.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Stop when your arms are in line with your shoulders and squeeze for a second.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly so the cables cross again.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation
instructions: Sit side-on to a cable set at elbow height and hold the handle in the hand closest to the machine.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and tuck it against your side; a small rolled towel there helps.
Breathe out and rotate your forearm in across your stomach, keeping your elbow in place.
Pause briefly, then return slowly until your forearm points forward or slightly out.
Use a light weight, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Twist
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and sit side-on to the machine on a bench or the floor, far enough away to keep tension on the cable.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest, arms almost straight.
Sit tall, tighten your abs and breathe out as you turn your shoulders away from the machine.
Keep your hips still so the movement comes from your trunk.
Return slowly to the start, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench placed between two low pulleys and bring both handles to shoulder height, palms forward.
Sit tall with your feet flat and your stomach braced.
Breathe out and press both handles up until your arms are straight and the handles are close together over your head.
Keep your lower back from arching.
Breathe in and lower the handles slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Side Bend
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the hand nearest the machine, arm straight.
Place your other hand on your hip and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Let the cable pull you into a slight side bend toward the machine.
Use the far side of your waist to bend the other way, past upright.
Return under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable Side Bend Crunch (bosu Ball)
instructions: Place a BOSU dome-up beside a low pulley and lie with your hip on the dome, feet away from the machine and braced against something solid.
Hold the cable handle with your top hand beside your head.
Breathe out and crunch sideways, lifting your upper body off the dome toward your top hip.
Lower back over the dome slowly to feel a stretch along your side.
Complete your reps, then turn over for the other side.

exercises.name: Cable Side Crunch
instructions: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle beside your head with the hand nearest the machine.
Brace your abs with your feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Breathe out and crunch sideways, pulling your elbow down toward your hip on the far side.
Hold the squeeze for a moment.
Straighten back up slowly, finish the set, then work the other side.

exercises.name: Cable Squat Row (with Rope Attachment)
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable set at about chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is tight and sit down into a squat with your arms straight.
Drive up through your heels to stand and, as you rise, row the rope to your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Straighten your arms as you sit back into the squat for the next rep.

exercises.name: Cable Squatting Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar or handle to a low pulley and stand facing it with feet a little wider than your hips.
Grip the bar underhand and sit down into a deep squat, resting the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your chest up.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly while staying in the squat.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand with your back to the machine.
Reach behind you and hold the bar at arm's length with your palms facing backward.
Step forward slightly so the cable has tension and your wrists open.
Breathe out and curl the bar up by bending your wrists, keeping your arms straight.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Stand tall and avoid leaning forward to help the movement.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Attach a handle or a hip belt to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle at your side with a straight arm, or clip the belt around your hips.
Place the balls of your feet on a low step with heels off.
Lower your heels until your calves stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping your body upright.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Cross-Over High Reverse Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys above head height and hold the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left.
Stand in the middle with your arms crossed in front of your face and elbows slightly bent.
Brace your stomach and breathe out as you sweep your arms out and down until they are level with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Breathe in and bring your arms back up and across slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the rope ends beside your head.
Step forward until the cable has tension and set your feet hip width apart.
Breathe out and curl your ribs down toward your hips, rounding your back slightly.
Keep your hips and legs still so the abs do the work.
Uncurl slowly to tall standing.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Crunch (with Rope Attachment)
instructions: Attach a rope to the high pulley, hold one end in each hand and stand facing away from the machine with the rope beside your ears.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly soft.
Breathe out and curl your chest down toward your hips, rounding your back and squeezing your abs.
Keep your hips still and your hands fixed by your head so your arms do not do the pulling.
Breathe in and slowly uncurl back to upright.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Fly
instructions: Set the pulleys a little above shoulder height, grab both handles and step forward into a split stance.
Lean slightly forward, keep your chest proud and let your arms open wide with a slight elbow bend.
Draw your hands together in front of your lower chest in a hugging motion.
Squeeze for a moment, then open your arms slowly until your chest is stretched.
Breathe out as you bring the hands in and keep your torso still throughout.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Inner Curl
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand side-on to the machine, holding the handle in the hand farther from it.
Let the arm hang straight with the palm facing forward and the elbow at your side.
Breathe out and curl the handle up and slightly in toward your opposite shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Standing One Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley, take it in one hand and turn your back to the machine.
Raise the hand behind your head so the elbow is bent and pointing up beside your ear.
Stand in a staggered stance and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and straighten your arm toward the ceiling.
Breathe in and let the handle lower behind your head slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Standing One Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley and hold it in one hand, standing beside or facing the machine.
Stand on the same-side foot on a low step with the heel off, other foot lifted behind.
Hold the machine frame with your free hand for balance.
Lower your heel for a full stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Pulldown (with Rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, a step back, with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope ends with your thumbs up and arms reaching up and forward.
Breathe out and pull the rope down toward your upper chest, bending your elbows and keeping them in front of you.
Squeeze your biceps and upper back at the bottom.
Breathe in and let your arms straighten back up slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Rear Delt Row (with Rope)
aliases: standing rear delt row with rope
instructions: Set a rope on a pulley at chest height and hold the ends with palms facing down.
Step back until your arms are straight, stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and pull the rope toward your face, raising your elbows out to the sides.
Spread the rope ends apart at the end and hold for a second.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
aliases: standing reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley, stand with your back to the machine and take the handle with one hand, palm facing up.
Raise that arm so the elbow points to the ceiling and the handle sits behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arm overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head and still.
Lower the handle slowly behind your head, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Row (v-Bar)
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a cable at about chest height and hold it with both hands.
Step back until your arms are straight and the weight lifts off the stack.
Stand with your knees soft and your feet hip-width apart, chest up.
Pull the handle to your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back, then straighten your arms slowly.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable at elbow height and hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine.
Bend that elbow to 90 degrees and keep it against your side with your forearm across your stomach.
Breathe out and rotate your forearm outward, away from your body, keeping the elbow in place.
Stop when you feel the end of your comfortable range.
Breathe in and return slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Twist Row (v-Bar)
instructions: Set a V-handle at chest height and stand facing the cable with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back to straight arms with your knees soft and stomach braced.
Pull the handle toward your stomach while turning your chest to one side.
Let your hips stay mostly forward so the turn comes from your upper body.
Return to the centre with straight arms, then pull and turn to the other side.
Breathe out on each pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Up Straight Crossovers
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height, hold a handle in each hand and stand tall in the middle with your feet hip-width apart.
Open your arms out to the sides with a soft bend in the elbows and your chest up.
Breathe out and bring your hands together in front of your chest, letting one hand cross past the other.
Squeeze your chest at the crossed position for a second.
Breathe in and let your arms open back out slowly, staying upright without leaning.
Swap which hand crosses on top each rep.

exercises.name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown (with Rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to the high pulley and hold one end in each hand.
Step back, hinge slightly forward and reach your arms up toward the pulley.
Keeping your arms nearly straight, pull the rope down in an arc toward your thighs.
At the bottom, spread the rope ends to the sides of your hips and squeeze your lats.
Let your arms rise slowly back to the start.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you let it up.

exercises.name: Cable Straight Back Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the low pulley with your feet braced and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit upright with your chest up and shoulders down; this is your fixed position.
Pull the handle to your stomach without leaning back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
Straighten your arms slowly while your torso stays upright.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Supine Reverse Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and lie chest-down on it, holding the left handle in your right hand and the right in your left.
Let your arms hang crossed under the bench with a slight bend in the elbows.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Thibaudeau Kayak Row
instructions: Sit at the pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar down toward one side of your chest, letting your torso turn slightly toward that side.
Squeeze the lat on that side and breathe out.
Let the bar rise slowly back to the centre.
Pull toward the other side on the next rep and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (v-Bar) (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: triceps pushdown v-bar with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster so the plate rests against your stomach with your elbows against its sides.
Attach a V-handle to a high pulley and grip it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall close to the machine with your elbows pressed into the arm blaster.
Breathe out and push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let the handle rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Cable Tuck Reverse Crunch
instructions: Attach ankle straps to a low pulley and lie on your back with your feet toward the machine.
Hold onto something solid behind your head or press your palms into the floor.
Start with your legs nearly straight, then breathe out and tuck your knees in toward your chest.
At the end, curl your hips slightly off the floor to finish the crunch.
Extend your legs slowly against the cable without letting your lower back arch.

exercises.name: Cable Twist
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and stand side-on to the machine, feet shoulder width apart and knees soft.
Hold the handle with both hands, arms extended in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and rotate your shoulders away from the machine, keeping your arms in front of your chest.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and repeat facing the other way.

exercises.name: Cable Twist (up-Down)
instructions: Set a handle on the high pulley and stand side-on to the machine, feet a little wider than shoulder width.
Reach up and hold the handle with both hands above your near shoulder, arms almost straight.
Tighten your abs and pull the handle down and across your body toward your far hip, turning your chest as you go.
Let your back foot pivot so your knees and hips turn with you, and breathe out as you pull.
Return the handle slowly along the same path to the top.
Finish your set, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable Twisting Pull
instructions: Set a single handle on a low pulley and stand facing it, holding the handle in one hand.
Step back with your knees soft until your arm is straight and you feel tension.
Brace your stomach and rotate slightly toward the machine to start.
Pull the handle up and back toward your chest while turning your shoulders away from the machine.
Reverse the motion slowly back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides, breathing out on each pull.

exercises.name: Cable Two Arm Curl On Incline Bench
aliases: two arm curl on incline bench
instructions: Place an incline bench between two low pulleys with single handles attached.
Sit back on the bench and take a handle in each hand, letting your arms hang down and slightly behind you, palms forward.
Breathe out and curl both handles toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until you feel the stretch again.

exercises.name: Cable Two Arm Tricep Kickback
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and take the left cable in your right hand and the right cable in your left hand so they cross.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and pull your upper arms back alongside your body, elbows bent.
Breathe out and straighten both arms behind you.
Squeeze the triceps hard with your arms fully straight.
Bend your elbows slowly to return, keeping the upper arms in place.

exercises.name: Cable Upper Chest Crossovers
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position, take a handle in each hand and step to the middle with a slight forward stagger.
Let your arms hang down and slightly back with palms facing forward and a small bend in the elbows.
Breathe out and sweep your hands up and in until they meet in front of your face at about chin height.
Squeeze your upper chest briefly, keeping your shoulders down away from your ears.
Breathe in and lower your arms back along the same arc under control.

exercises.name: Cable Upper Row
instructions: Set a straight bar on the cable at about chest height and stand facing it.
Grip the bar overhand a little wider than shoulder width and step back until the cable is tight.
Stand tall with soft knees and a tight stomach.
Pull the bar to your upper chest with your elbows out at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Straighten your arms slowly with control.

exercises.name: Cable Wide Grip Rear Pulldown Behind Neck
aliases: wide grip rear pulldown behind neck
instructions: Sit at the pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar wide with an overhand grip.
Lean your head slightly forward so the bar can pass behind it.
Pull the bar down behind your head to about the base of your neck, elbows pointing down.
Breathe out and squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Stop and switch to a front pulldown if you feel any pinching in the shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and sit on a bench facing it.
Hold the bar with your palms up and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists just past your knees.
Let the cable draw your hands down so your wrists bend back.
Breathe out and curl your palms up toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on your legs.

exercises.name: Calf Press (Leg Press)
instructions: Sit in the 45-degree leg press and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Press the platform up until your legs are straight but not locked, then release the safety handles.
Keep your knees still and let the platform push your toes back toward you.
Breathe out and press the platform away by pointing your toes.
Pause, then breathe in and return slowly to a full stretch.
Lock the safety handles before you take your feet off.

exercises.name: Calf Push Stretch With Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place both palms on it at shoulder height.
Step one foot back and keep it straight with the heel pressed into the floor.
Bend the front knee and lean your weight toward the wall.
Keep your back heel down and your toes pointing forward; hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Breathe out as you sink deeper, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch With Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height.
Step one foot back about a long stride, toes pointing straight ahead.
Keep the back leg straight and press its heel into the floor.
Bend the front knee and lean toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch With Rope
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs straight in front of you.
Loop a rope or towel around the ball of one foot and hold an end in each hand.
Sit tall and keep the knee straight.
Gently pull the rope so your toes come back toward you.
Hold a comfortable stretch for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Step onto the captain's chair, rest your forearms on the pads, hold the handles and press your back against the backrest.
Let your legs hang straight and tighten your abs.
Breathe out and lift your straight legs in front of you until they are level with the floor.
Pause for a second without leaning your shoulders back.
Breathe in and lower your legs slowly, stopping before they swing.

exercises.name: Chair Leg Extended Stretch
instructions: Sit near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your back straight.
Straighten one leg in front of you with the heel on the floor and toes pointing up.
Keep the other foot flat on the floor with the knee bent.
Place your hands on the bent leg and lean forward from the hips, keeping your back long.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands together behind your lower back.
Straighten your arms and gently pull your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your back until you feel a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders.
Keep your chin level and your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then release.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip the dip bars and jump or step up so you are supported on straight arms.
Lean your chest forward and bend your knees slightly so your body tilts.
Bend your elbows and lower yourself until you feel a stretch in your chest and your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms while keeping the forward lean.
Breathe in going down, out coming up, and stop the descent if your shoulders feel pinched.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (Assisted)
instructions: Pick an assistance level, step up and kneel on the pad, then grip the dip handles with straight arms.
Lean your chest slightly forward and let your elbows point a little out to the sides.
Bend your elbows and lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and rise back to the top.
Breathe in on the way down and out as you push up.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (on Dip-Pull-Up Cage)
instructions: Grip the dip handles and jump or step up until you are supported on straight arms.
Cross your ankles behind you and lean your torso forward.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower yourself until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows or you feel a strong stretch in your chest.
Keep your elbows angled slightly out and your shoulders down away from your ears.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms while keeping the forward lean.

exercises.name: Chest Dip On Straight Bar
instructions: Stand in front of a straight bar at about hip height, grip it with hands shoulder-width apart and jump up so you are supported on straight arms with the bar at your hips.
Lean your chest forward over the bar and bring your legs slightly forward underneath you for balance.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
Keep your elbows pointing back and slightly out, not flaring wide.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand held above your chest, palms facing each other.
Unlock your elbows into a slight bend and keep it the same for the whole set.
Open your arms slowly out to the sides until your hands are about level with your chest.
Pull the dumbbells back up and together as if hugging a large barrel.
Inhale during the lowering and exhale as you bring the weights up.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest, then sit with your back flat against the pad.
Grip the handles with palms facing down and your elbows slightly below shoulder height.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest, without letting the weight stack touch down.
Breathe out as you push and in as you return.

exercises.name: Chest Stretch With Exercise Ball
instructions: Kneel beside an exercise ball and place one forearm or hand on top of it with the arm out to the side.
Keep your other hand on the floor for support and your back flat.
Slowly lower your chest toward the floor and turn it slightly away from the ball, letting the ball roll a little.
Stop when you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with slow breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Chest Tap Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands just wider than your shoulders and your body straight.
Lower your chest close to the floor with your stomach tight.
Push up as hard as you can so your upper body rises off the floor.
Quickly tap your chest with both hands while you are in the air.
Get your hands back to the floor and land with soft elbows, then go into the next rep.
Master clap push-ups before trying this, and stop if you start landing heavily.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down with your chest on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Row both dumbbells up, bringing your elbows back past your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms, keeping your chest on the bench.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and eyes looking straight ahead.
Without tipping your head up or down, glide your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Feel a gentle stretch at the base of the skull and keep your eyes level.
Hold for 3 to 5 seconds while breathing normally.
Relax back to the start and repeat.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart and arms straight.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears and tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Keep your body still and avoid swinging your legs.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully straight.

exercises.name: Chin-Up (Assisted)
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width.
Start from straight arms with your stomach tight.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar, elbows driving down in front of you.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Chin-Ups (narrow Parallel Grip)
instructions: Grab close parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with straight arms, legs together and stomach tight.
Pull yourself up, driving your elbows down close to your ribs.
Bring your chin above your hands with your chest close to the handles.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Circles Knee Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Lean forward a little and place your hands on top of your knees.
Slowly move your knees in a circle, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Make 10 smooth circles in one direction.
Reverse and make 10 circles the other way.
Keep the circles small and pain-free and breathe normally.

exercises.name: Clap Push Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with hands a bit wider than your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest close to the floor with your stomach tight.
Push up as hard and fast as you can so your hands leave the floor.
Clap your hands quickly in front of your chest.
Land with soft elbows, hands back in place, and sink straight into the next rep.
Stop the set as soon as you cannot get enough height to clap safely.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
instructions: Lift the bar from the floor and extend your hips explosively, pulling yourself under it to catch it on the front of your shoulders.
Stand up out of the catch with the bar in the front rack.
Dip and drive with your legs, then split or push your feet as you punch the bar overhead.
Bring your feet back together under the locked-out bar before lowering it.

exercises.name: Clock Push-Up
instructions: Get into a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Do one full push-up, lowering your chest close to the floor and pressing back up.
Walk your hands a step to one side so your body pivots around your feet.
Do another push-up in the new position, then keep stepping and pushing until you have gone around the full circle.
Keep your stomach and glutes tight so your hips never sag, and breathe out on every press.

exercises.name: Close Grip Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip, hands a few centimetres apart.
Set your shoulders down and keep your legs still.
Breathe out and pull up, keeping your elbows in front of you, until your chin clears the bar.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted on the floor.
Grip the bar a little narrower than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your body.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and your shoulder blades pulled together the whole set.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your lower chest.
Grip the bar a little narrower than shoulder width and unhook it by turning your wrists.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows tucked close.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight.
Re-hook the bar by turning your wrists at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach the V handle to the high pulley and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Grip both sides of the handle with your palms facing each other and arms straight.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle to your upper chest, elbows driving down.
Squeeze your lats and breathe out at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other and the dumbbells touching.
Press the dumbbells together firmly and keep them in contact for the whole set.
Breathe in and lower them to your mid chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades squeezed together.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your hands slightly narrower than your shoulders and your body straight.
Tighten your stomach and glutes so your hips don't sag.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows brushing your sides.
Stop just above the floor.
Breathe out and press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up (on Knees)
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your chest, a little narrower than shoulder-width.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line with your body; don't let them pike up.

exercises.name: Cocoons
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms stretched overhead, both slightly off the floor.
Breathe out and sit up while pulling your knees in to your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins for a moment so your body forms a tight ball.
Breathe in and stretch back out slowly to the long starting position, keeping your arms and legs off the floor if you can.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Lean forward and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh, arm straight down.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly to a straight arm; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and rest the inside of your top leg's knee or ankle on it.
Prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is straight, holding yourself up with the top leg pressing into the bench.
Hold for time, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Crab Twist Toe Touch
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips into a crab position.
Kick one leg up while lifting the opposite hand and reaching it across to touch your toes, breathing out.
Keep your hips lifted and your supporting arm straight as you twist.
Return the hand and foot to the floor, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Cross Body Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and fingertips lightly behind your head.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders while turning to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
Lift the knee slightly to meet the elbow if you like.
Lower back down with control and repeat to the other side.
Keep your elbows wide and avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides and palms facing in.
Breathe out and curl the right dumbbell up and across your chest toward your left shoulder, thumb on top.
Keep your upper arm close to your body.
Breathe in and lower it along the same path.
Repeat with the left arm toward the right shoulder and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and lift your head and shoulder blades off the floor by tightening your abs.
Keep your lower back on the floor and look slightly up, not at your knees.
Lower slowly and keep tension on your abs between reps.

exercises.name: Crunch (Machine)
instructions: Set the weight, sit on the machine and hook your feet under the foot pads if it has them.
Hold the handles or place your arms on the pads in front of your chest.
Breathe out and curl your chest down toward your hips, rounding your back with your abs.
Squeeze for a second at the bottom without yanking with your arms.
Breathe in and return slowly, stopping before the weight stack touches down.

exercises.name: Crunch (hands Overhead)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Stretch your arms overhead, keeping them in line with your ears.
Breathe out and curl your head, arms and shoulders off the floor as one unit.
Keep your arms beside your ears; do not swing them forward to help.
Lower slowly until your shoulders touch the floor.

exercises.name: Crunch (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your lower and middle back rest on the ball.
Plant your feet wide for balance and place your fingertips by your ears.
Let your upper back drape gently over the ball to stretch your abs.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up until your abs are fully tight.
Lower slowly back over the ball.

exercises.name: Crunch (on Stability Ball, Arms Straight)
instructions: Lie back on a stability ball with it under your middle back and your feet planted wide.
Hold your arms straight up toward the ceiling with your palms together.
Breathe out and crunch up, reaching your hands higher toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your abs at the top without sitting all the way up.
Lower slowly until your back rests over the ball again.

exercises.name: Curl-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, palms resting on your thighs.
Tighten your abs and keep your lower back in contact with the floor.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders up, sliding your hands along your thighs toward your knees.
Stop when your shoulder blades clear the floor and hold for a second.
Breathe in and roll back down slowly.

exercises.name: Curtsey Squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or clasped at your chest.
Step your right foot back and across behind your left leg.
Breathe in and bend both knees to lower your hips, keeping your chest up.
Keep your front knee over the ankle and your hips facing forward.
Breathe out and push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Cycle Cross Trainer
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the farthest point of each stride.
Sit with your back against the backrest, feet on the pedals, and hands on the handles.
Start a smooth pedaling motion while pushing and pulling the handles in rhythm.
Keep your core lightly tight and avoid rocking side to side.
Set the resistance to a level you can hold for your planned time, breathing steadily.
Lower the pace for the last few minutes to cool down.

exercises.name: Cycling (Outdoor)
instructions: Set the saddle so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Ride at a pace you can hold, shifting gears to keep your cadence steady on hills.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Cycling (Stationary Bike)
instructions: Set the seat so your knee is only slightly bent when the pedal is at the bottom.
Sit tall, hold the handlebars lightly, and strap your feet in if the pedals have straps.
Warm up for a few minutes at an easy pace and low resistance.
Raise the resistance or speed to a level where you can still talk in short sentences.
Keep your hips still on the seat and push through the whole pedal circle.
Ease off for the last few minutes to cool down before stopping.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms pointing to the ceiling and your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your abs.
Breathe out and slowly lower your right arm overhead and your left leg toward the floor at the same time.
Stop just above the floor, keeping your lower back still, then return to the start.
Repeat with the left arm and right leg, moving slowly.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar overhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet so you hang with straight arms and relaxed legs.
Keep a light brace and breathe steadily.
Hold for time, then step down.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs, then bend your knees until your shins touch it.
Flatten your back, pull your shoulders down and take a big breath into your belly.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close to your legs as it rises.
Once it passes your knees, push your hips forward and stand tall; do not lean back.
Lower it by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees once it passes them, and breathe out at the top or after setting it down.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells on the floor just outside your feet.
Hinge at the hips, bend your knees and grip the dumbbells with your back flat and chest up.
Brace your core and push through your feet to stand up straight.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs and finish by squeezing your glutes.
Lower them back down by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees.
Breathe out as you stand and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lock your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Take a grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack the bar, ideally with a spotter's help.
Lower the bar slowly to the lower part of your chest, keeping your elbows tucked a little.
Drive the bar straight back up until your arms are extended over your chest.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you press.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand at your chest.
Press both dumbbells up over your lower chest until your arms are straight.
Lower them under control to the sides of your lower chest.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up.
Exhale on each press; when finished, bring the dumbbells to your chest before sitting up.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with the lower part of your chest and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent and pointing down and out.
Breathe out and press the handles forward and down until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end without locking your elbows.
Breathe in and return the handles slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the rollers and your head at the low end.
Cross your arms over your chest or put your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up off the bench, rounding your upper back.
Stop once your abs are fully contracted, before you sit all the way up.
Lower slowly back to the bench.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on a bench or step behind you and set your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Brace your stomach so your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor, keeping elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight again.
Inhale as you go down and exhale as you push up; do not let your hips drop.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the rollers and your arms crossed on your chest.
Brace your abs and breathe out as you curl up, then keep rising until your chest is near your thighs.
Lead with your chest rather than jerking with your head.
Breathe in and lower slowly, rolling your back down one section at a time.
Stop just before your head touches the bench and go again.

exercises.name: Deep Push Up
instructions: Place two hex dumbbells on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width and grip the handles.
Walk your feet back into a push-up position with your body in one straight line.
Breathe in and lower your chest between the dumbbells until it drops just below your hands.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body and your hips in line.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position and place your hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching.
Set your feet together or slightly apart and keep your body in a straight line.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward your hands, elbows pointing back.
Go as low as you can while keeping your hips in line.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms; drop to your knees if needed.

exercises.name: Dip (Assisted)
instructions: Pick an assist weight on the stack, step up and kneel on the pad with your hands on the dip handles.
Straighten your arms so you start at the top with your chest up and shoulders down.
Bend your elbows and lower yourself slowly, keeping the elbows pointing back rather than out.
Stop when your upper arms are about level with the floor or your shoulders start to feel strained.
Breathe out and push the handles down until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: Dip (Machine)
instructions: Set the seat so the handles sit at about chest height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with palms facing in and your elbows pointing back.
Breathe out and push the handles down until your arms are straight, without locking the elbows hard.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up through the whole push.
Breathe in and let the handles come back up slowly until your elbows are at about a right angle.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and your heels hanging off.
Hinge forward at the hips and rest your forearms or hands on a bench or bar in front of you.
Keep your back flat and your legs nearly straight.
Lower your heels for a deep calf stretch.
Breathe out and push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Double Under Jump Rope
instructions: Warm up with regular single jumps until you have a steady rhythm.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and hands near your hips.
Jump a little higher than usual, staying tall with your legs nearly straight.
Spin the rope with fast wrist flicks so it passes under you twice before you land.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and go straight into the next jump.
Breathe steadily and mix in single jumps when you need to recover.

exercises.name: Drag Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, bar resting on your thighs.
Breathe out and pull your elbows back behind you as you curl, so the bar slides up your stomach.
Keep the bar in contact with or just off your body until it reaches your lower chest.
Squeeze the biceps hard at the top for a second.
Lower the bar along the same path back to your thighs.

exercises.name: Drop Push Up
instructions: Kneel tall on a mat with your body upright and your hands at chest height.
Keep your body straight from knees to head and let yourself fall forward.
Catch yourself on your hands about shoulder-width apart and bend your elbows to soften the landing.
Lower your chest close to the floor in a knee push-up.
Push hard enough to bring your torso back up to the upright kneeling position.
Start with small falls and move your knees further back as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: alternate biceps curl with arm blaster
db alternate biceps curl with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster and rest your elbows against the sides of the plate.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up to your shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other dumbbell.
Keep alternating without leaning back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest both upper arms on the pad, holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up, keeping your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it slowly to an almost straight arm.
Curl the other dumbbell the same way.
Keep alternating without lifting your elbows off the pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower it slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Curl the other dumbbell the same way.
Keep alternating, moving only at the elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your back straight, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder, thumb pointing up.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other one.
Keep alternating without rocking your torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and keep your hips still.
Breathe out and press one dumbbell up while you bend your upper body a little to the opposite side.
Straighten your body as you lower the dumbbell to your shoulder.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternating Bicep Curl With Leg Raised On Exercise Ball
aliases: alternating bicep curl with leg raised on exercise ball
db alternating bicep curl with leg raised on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and lift one foot off the floor, straightening that leg in front of you.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up while keeping your balance.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other dumbbell.
Switch the raised leg halfway through the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternating Seated Bicep Curl On Exercise Ball
aliases: alternating seated bicep curl on exercise ball
db alternating seated bicep curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with your feet flat and wide, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and keep your elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other dumbbell.
Keep alternating without leaning or rolling the ball.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Around Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms straight and resting by your thighs, palms facing up.
Keeping your arms nearly straight and low, sweep the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue the arc until the dumbbells meet above and behind your head.
Reverse the circle along the same path back to your thighs.
Move slowly, use light weights, and keep your lower back pressed to the bench; breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Seated Press
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward.
Sit up tall and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and don't lean back.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Squat
instructions: Stand a short step in front of a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Breathe in, brace and sit your hips back and down until your glutes lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and your knees pushed out in line with your toes.
Without relaxing onto the bench, drive through your heels to stand up.
Breathe out as you stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl Lunge With Bowling Motion
aliases: bicep curl lunge with bowling motion
db bicep curl lunge with bowling motion
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Step your right leg back and across behind your left, bending both knees as if bowling a ball.
At the bottom of the lunge, breathe out and curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while staying low.
Push through your front foot to stand up, then repeat stepping back with the other leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl On Exercise Ball With Leg Raised
aliases: bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
db bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and raise one foot off the floor, leg straight in front of you.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up at the same time.
Squeeze briefly, then lower them slowly.
Switch the raised leg halfway through or between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl With Stork Stance
aliases: db bicep curl with stork stance
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing forward.
Shift your weight onto one leg and place the other foot against the inside of the standing calf or knee.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly while keeping your balance.
Switch legs halfway through the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: db biceps curl with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster so the plate sits across your stomach and rest your elbows against its sides.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight and palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl Reverse
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing back.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, palms still facing down.
Pause at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl Squat
instructions: Set your feet about shoulder-width apart and let a dumbbell hang at each side.
Breathe in and squat down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, chest up.
Breathe out and drive through your feet to stand up.
At the top, curl both dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly, then start the next squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl V Sit On Bosu Ball
aliases: biceps curl v sit on bosu ball
db biceps curl v sit on bosu ball
instructions: Sit on the center of a BOSU dome holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor, knees bent, to form a V shape.
Brace your stomach and let your arms hang with palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, then lower them slowly.
Keep your chest up and your balance steady through the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Burpee
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down and set the dumbbells on the floor under your shoulders, gripping the handles.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank on the dumbbells, keeping your body straight.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up with the dumbbells, keeping your back flat as you lift.
Breathe out as you stand, then lower straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower the dumbbells just below your knees, back flat.
Jump your hips forward hard, extending your hips, knees and ankles, and shrug the dumbbells up close to your body.
As they rise, pull your elbows up and then quickly rotate them under to catch the dumbbells on your shoulders.
Land in a quarter squat with soft knees, then stand tall.
Lower the dumbbells to your thighs with control and breathe out after each catch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Close Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold two dumbbells over your chest with palms facing each other, touching end to end along their sides.
Squeeze the dumbbells together firmly.
Lower them to your mid-chest, keeping them in contact and your elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep the squeeze on for the whole set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Complex Push Up Row Clean And Press
aliases: complex push up row clean and press
db complex push up row clean and press
instructions: Start in a push-up position holding two dumbbells on the floor under your shoulders, feet wide for balance.
Do one push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs, set it down, then row the other.
Step your feet up toward your hands, then clean the dumbbells from the floor to your shoulders by driving through your hips.
Stand tall and press the dumbbells overhead, breathing out.
Lower them to your shoulders, then to the floor, and step back into the push-up position for the next rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in your left hand at your side.
Step forward with your right foot into a lunge.
Breathe in and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor, keeping your shoulders level.
Do not let your body lean toward the dumbbell side.
Breathe out and push off the right foot to step back to standing.
Finish the set, then switch the dumbbell to the right hand and lunge with the left leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl (Pause at Top)
aliases: cross body hammer curl pause at top
db cross body hammer curl pause at top
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up and across your chest toward the opposite shoulder, thumb up.
Squeeze briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower it slowly back to your side.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
instructions: Stand tall and hold light dumbbells at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Pull your elbows up and out until your upper arms are level with your shoulders and your forearms hang down.
Keeping your elbows in place, rotate your forearms up until the dumbbells are above your elbows.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse each step slowly to return to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured, holding dumbbells above your lower chest with palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle fixed.
Open your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest in a wide hugging arc.
Breathe in as you open and out as you close; choose a weight you can control at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Hammer Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and hold the dumbbells at your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your sides rather than flared.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended over your lower chest.
Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest.
Breathe out as you press and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and hold a dumbbell in one hand above your chest, palm facing in.
Place your free hand on the bench or your stomach to stay balanced.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc, elbow slightly bent.
Stop when your upper arm is about level with your body and you feel the stretch.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbell back up over your chest along the same arc.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Hammer Press
aliases: db decline one arm hammer press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and hold one dumbbell over your chest, palm facing in toward your body.
Put your free hand on your stomach or hold the bench to stay steady.
Lower the dumbbell to the side of your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Breathe out and press it straight back up until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug
instructions: Lie face down on an angled bench, chest supported, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the dumbbells hang straight below your shoulders.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows.
Pause at the top and squeeze your traps.
Lower your shoulders slowly to a full stretch.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug (Shoulder Blades Back)
aliases: db decline shrug shoulder blades back
instructions: Set a bench at a moderate angle and lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with your palms facing each other.
Keeping your arms straight, pull your shoulders up and back so your shoulder blades meet.
Hold the squeeze for a second at the top.
Let your shoulders sink slowly back down and forward.
Breathe out as you squeeze and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Triceps Extension
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to raise the dumbbells back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Decline Twist Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with legs secured and hold the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, turning your palms to face the ceiling as you go down.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift back up in the same arc, rotating your palms back to face each other and then turning your little fingers slightly inward at the top.
Squeeze your chest at the top and breathe out on the way up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearm on your thigh, palm facing up, holding a dumbbell.
Keep your wrist still and slowly open your fingers so the dumbbell rolls down toward the fingertips.
Stop before it slips, with the handle resting on the last joints of your fingers.
Close your fingers to roll the dumbbell back up into a tight fist.
Squeeze for a moment, then repeat; switch hands after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly On Exercise Ball
instructions: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk your feet out until your head and upper back rest on it.
Lift your hips so your body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Press the dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Breathe in and open your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbells back together over your chest without changing the elbow bend.
Keep your hips up throughout; lower them only when the set is over.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand tall holding one dumbbell with both hands above your head, arms straight.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
At the bottom, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping elbows pointing up.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift the dumbbell back overhead.
Push off your front foot to stand up, then lunge with the other leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise (One Dumbbell, Both Hands)
aliases: front raise one dumbbell both hands
db front raise one db both hands
instructions: Stand tall and hold one dumbbell by its ends with both hands in front of your thighs.
Brace your stomach and keep your arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Hold briefly without leaning back.
Breathe in and lower it slowly to your thighs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Full Can Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, thumbs pointing forward.
Turn your arms so they point slightly forward, about halfway between the front and the side.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells along that angle to shoulder height, thumbs up.
Keep your shoulders down and your elbows almost straight.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl (Alternating)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing your body.
Breathe out and curl the right dumbbell up with your thumb pointing up.
Stop near shoulder height and keep the elbow at your side.
Breathe in and lower it slowly.
Curl the left dumbbell the same way and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl On Exercise Ball
aliases: db hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with feet wide, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and keep your elbows tucked.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up with your thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly, keeping the ball still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curls (with Arm Blaster)
aliases: db hammer curls with arm blaster
instructions: Put on the arm blaster with your elbows resting against the plate.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up, keeping your thumbs pointing up.
Pause at the top without letting your elbows leave the plate.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell High Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your shoulders and your arms are straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells toward the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms level.
Squeeze your biceps hard at the top.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides; use light weights.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Press
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand pressed up over your upper chest.
Keep your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench.
Breathe in and lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest while the other arm stays straight.
Breathe out and press it back up to meet the other dumbbell.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the whole set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl
instructions: Set a bench to about 45 to 60 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down behind your torso with palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up without moving your upper arms forward.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are fully straight and you feel the stretch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Breeding
instructions: Sit on a bench set to about 45 degrees with your back on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your upper chest.
Take about three seconds to lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows bent to roughly a right angle.
Pause for one second at the bottom without relaxing.
Press back up smoothly, breathing out as you push.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: db incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the ball holding two dumbbells and walk forward until your mid and upper back rest on it, hips lower than your shoulders.
Hold the dumbbells over your upper chest, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.
Breathe in and lower the weights out to the sides in a wide arc until your chest is stretched.
Breathe out and squeeze them back up and together over your upper chest.
Keep your feet wide and planted so the ball stays still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging and palms facing your body.
Keep your shoulders back against the pad.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up with your thumbs leading.
Stop near shoulder height and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench and hold the dumbbells at your upper chest with palms facing each other.
Tuck your elbows in so they point down and slightly forward.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower them slowly back to your upper chest, keeping the palms facing in.
Exhale on the press and inhale as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: incline hammer press on exercise ball
db incline hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk your feet forward until your upper back rests on it.
Let your hips sink a little lower than your shoulders to make an incline, with your feet flat and wide.
Hold the dumbbells over your chest with palms facing each other.
Lower them beside your chest with your elbows tucked close to your body.
Breathe out and press back up, keeping the ball still under you.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Inner Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging and palms facing forward.
Turn your arms slightly out so your hands start a little wider than your shoulders.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up and out toward the outside of your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Fly
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees, lie back and hold one dumbbell above your shoulder with your palm facing in.
Hold the side of the bench with your free hand to keep your body square.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell out to the side, elbow softly bent, until you feel a stretch in your upper chest.
Breathe out and bring it back up over your shoulder in a hugging motion.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: incline one arm fly on exercise ball
db incline one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and roll back on the ball until it supports your mid and upper back, hips slightly dropped.
Set your feet wide and press the dumbbell up over your upper chest, palm facing in.
Breathe in and lower the weight out to the side in an arc, keeping the elbow slightly bent.
Stop at a comfortable stretch and keep your shoulders level on the ball.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbell back over your chest.
Finish the set and repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Hammer Press
aliases: db incline one arm hammer press
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding one dumbbell at shoulder level with your palm facing in.
Plant your feet and rest your free hand on your stomach or the bench.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to the side of your chest, elbow close to your body.
Keep your torso square to the ceiling, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Hammer Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: incline one arm hammer press on exercise ball
db incline one arm hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the ball holding one dumbbell, walk your feet out, and settle your upper back on the ball with your hips slightly low.
Spread your feet wide for balance and hold the dumbbell at your shoulder, palm facing in.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder, keeping the elbow tucked.
Keep your hips and shoulders level, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Lateral Raise
aliases: db incline one arm lateral raise
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie on your side against it, holding a dumbbell in your top hand in front of your thigh.
Brace yourself with your bottom arm and keep your top arm almost straight.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell out and up until your arm is about vertical.
Pause briefly, keeping the movement slow.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell under control, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press
instructions: Set a bench to 30 to 45 degrees and lie back with one dumbbell held at the side of your upper chest.
Plant your feet and grip the bench with your free hand.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight above your shoulder.
Keep both shoulder blades pinned to the bench so your body does not roll.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell slowly back to your chest.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: incline one arm press on exercise ball
db incline one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in one hand and walk your feet out until your mid and upper back rest on it, hips slightly lower than your shoulders.
Bring the dumbbell to the side of your upper chest with the elbow bent.
Breathe out and press it up and slightly back so it ends over your shoulder.
Keep your free hand on your stomach or out to the side for balance.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell slowly to your chest.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Palm-In Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench holding the dumbbells against your upper chest, palms facing each other and the dumbbells touching.
Squeeze the dumbbells firmly into each other.
Press them straight up while keeping them in contact the whole way.
Lower slowly back to your chest without letting them drift apart.
Breathe out as you press; use a lighter weight than for a regular incline press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: db incline press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the ball holding two dumbbells on your thighs, then walk forward until your mid and upper back are on the ball with your hips dropped a little.
Bring the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest, palms facing forward.
Breathe out and press both dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
Keep your feet planted wide and your stomach tight.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells under control back to your chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Raise
instructions: Set a bench to a steep incline, sit back against it and bring a dumbbell in each hand to shoulder height, palms forward.
Keep your back and head against the pad and your feet flat.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
