Pause for a second at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Turn your palms to face each other and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Lie on a 45-degree incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight above your shoulders.
Keep your elbows locked; only your shoulder blades will move.
Let your shoulder blades pinch back so the dumbbells lower a few centimetres.
Reach the dumbbells toward the ceiling by pushing your shoulder blades apart and forward.
Hold the reach for a second, lower slowly, and breathe out as you push up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Shrug
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight and relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, keeping your elbows straight.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulders are fully stretched down.
Breathe out on the shrug and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline T-Raise
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down.
Turn your hands so your thumbs point forward.
Breathe out and raise your arms straight out to the sides until your body forms a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold briefly.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand straight above your face, palms facing each other.
Fix your upper arms in place, angled slightly back.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
Go down until you feel a deep stretch in the back of your arms.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to bring the dumbbells back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Twist Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging and palms facing your body.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, turning your palms to face up as they rise.
Finish with your little fingers turned slightly higher than your thumbs and squeeze.
Keep your upper arms still against the bench angle.
Breathe in and lower slowly, turning your palms back in at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Twisted Flyes
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells above your upper chest with palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
At the bottom, turn your palms to face each other.
Bring the dumbbells back up and together, rotating so your palms face forward again as they meet.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top and exhale on the way up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Two Arm Extension
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your head, palms facing each other.
Point your elbows up and keep your upper arms still.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells slowly behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your arms.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift the dumbbells back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Y-Raise
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 to 45 degrees and lie on it face down.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight and thumbs pointing up.
Raise your arms forward and out at an angle so your body and arms form a Y.
Lift until your arms are in line with your body, pulling your shoulder blades down, and breathe out.
Lower slowly with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Iron Cross
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing down.
Breathe out and raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Keeping them at that height, open your arms out to the sides until your body forms a T.
Bring your arms back to the front at the same height.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells to your thighs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickbacks On Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie with your stomach and chest on an exercise ball, feet wide on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your upper arms alongside your body with your elbows bent at about a right angle.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze the triceps for a moment at the top.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring the dumbbells back down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Bicep Curl Exercise Ball
aliases: db kneeling bicep curl exercise ball
instructions: Kneel on a mat behind an exercise ball, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward and rest the backs of your upper arms on top of the ball, arms angled down in front of it, palms up.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping the ball steady under your arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral To Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Keep them at that height and sweep them around to the front.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells to your thighs.
On the next rep raise to the front first and sweep out to the side, alternating the direction.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunge With Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Step forward and lower into a lunge until both knees are bent at about a right angle.
Hold the lunge, breathe out and curl both dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly.
Push through your front foot to step back to standing, then lunge with the other leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Alternate Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand straight above your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend one elbow to lower that dumbbell slowly beside your head.
Breathe out and straighten that arm back up.
Switch to the other arm and keep trading sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Elbow Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, letting them travel down and slightly toward your feet as the dumbbells come toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows close together rather than flaring to the sides.
Stop when the dumbbells are just above your shoulders.
Breathe out and push the dumbbells back up by straightening your elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Extension (across Face)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in one hand straight above your chest, palm facing your feet.
Support the working upper arm with your free hand if you like.
Breathe in and bend the elbow so the dumbbell travels across your face toward the opposite shoulder.
Stop when the dumbbell is just above that shoulder.
Breathe out and straighten your arm to bring it back up; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side and hold a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Bend that elbow to 90 degrees and keep it against your side, with the dumbbell resting near your stomach.
Breathe out and rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling, keeping your elbow in place.
Stop when you reach the end of your comfortable range.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Hammer Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells at your chest with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your torso, pointing toward your feet.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Lower them slowly until they lightly touch the sides of your chest.
Breathe out as you press and keep your feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying On Floor Rear Delt Raise
aliases: lying on floor rear delt raise
db lying on floor rear delt raise
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on a small towel.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with your arms out to the sides in a T, elbows slightly bent.
Breathe out and lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold for one to two seconds at the top.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly to the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Deltoid Rear
aliases: db lying one arm deltoid rear
instructions: Lie on your stomach along a flat bench, one dumbbell in your working hand and that arm hanging straight beside the bench.
Rest your other hand on the bench or the floor and keep your chest on the pad.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight bend in the elbow until your arm is level with the bench.
Squeeze the back of your shoulder for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell held at chest level, palm facing toward your feet.
Brace your stomach and keep both shoulders flat on the bench.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight over your shoulder.
Lower it under control until your elbow is just below the bench line.
Complete the set, then change arms; exhale as you press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Press (Neutral Grip)
aliases: lying one arm press neutral grip
db lying one arm press neutral grip
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell beside your chest, palm facing in toward your body.
Place your free hand on your stomach or hold the bench for balance.
Press the dumbbell straight up, keeping your elbow tucked close to your side as it leaves your chest.
Lower slowly back to the side of your chest without letting your torso roll.
Finish your reps, then switch arms; breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Pronated Triceps Extension
aliases: lying one arm pronated triceps extension
db lying one arm pronated triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell straight above your shoulder with your palm facing your feet.
Keep that upper arm vertical and still.
Breathe in and bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell toward your forehead.
Stop just above your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arm; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Rear Lateral Raise
aliases: lying one arm rear lateral raise
db lying one arm rear lateral raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in your top hand, arm hanging in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly for balance and keep a small bend in your elbow.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell up and back until your arm points to the ceiling.
Keep your body from rolling backward.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Supinated Triceps Extension
aliases: lying one arm supinated triceps extension
db lying one arm supinated triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell straight above your shoulder with your palm facing your face.
Keep your upper arm pointing straight up.
Breathe in and bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell beside your head on the same side.
Pause when your forearm is about level with the bench.
Breathe out and straighten the arm; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench and rest one forearm on the bench with your hand just past the end.
Hold a light dumbbell by one end so the heavier side sticks out past your thumb.
Start with your palm facing up.
Breathe out and slowly turn your hand until the palm faces down.
Breathe in and rotate back to palm up under control.
Keep your elbow and forearm still; only the forearm twists. Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation On Floor
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your upper arm on the floor with the elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing up.
Hold a light dumbbell at one end, or by its handle, with your thumb toward your head.
Slowly rotate your forearm so your palm turns to face down toward your feet.
Keep your elbow and upper arm still on the floor.
Rotate back to the start under control and switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pullover On Exercise Ball
aliases: db lying pullover on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your upper back across the ball, hips lifted and feet flat, holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and lock that angle in place.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until your arms are roughly in line with your body.
Keep your hips up and your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.
Breathe out and pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your chest and back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Delt Row
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench set high enough that your arms can hang straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing your feet.
Lift the dumbbells by driving your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie on your stomach along a flat bench, holding two dumbbells with your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your palms facing each other and a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and lift both dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Single Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell straight above your shoulder, palm facing in.
Support the working upper arm with your other hand if you like, and keep it vertical.
Breathe in and bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell toward the opposite shoulder or beside your head.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back up.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with one forearm resting on the bench and your hand just past the end.
Hold a light dumbbell by one end with the weighted side sticking out past your thumb.
Start with your palm facing down.
Breathe out and slowly turn your hand until the palm faces up.
Breathe in and rotate back to palm down with control.
Do not let your elbow lift; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supination On Floor
instructions: Lie on your back with your upper arm on the floor, elbow bent at 90 degrees and forearm pointing up.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing your feet.
Slowly rotate your forearm so the palm turns to face your head.
Keep the elbow pinned to the floor and move only the forearm.
Return slowly to the start and switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supine Biceps Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor beside the bench, palms facing up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly back to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supine Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a high flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor beside the bench, palms facing up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly back to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Wide Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms drop out to the sides at about a 45-degree angle from your body, slightly below the bench, palms up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms in that wide position.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Neutral Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells beside your chest, elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep the dumbbells moving together and under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Bench Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell over your chest in one hand, palm facing in.
Hold the bench with your other hand and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell out to the side, elbow slightly bent, until your arm is about level with the bench.
Breathe out and sweep the dumbbell back up over your chest.
Keep your hips and shoulders flat on the bench so you do not twist.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Chest Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm chest fly on exercise ball
db one arm chest fly on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your head and upper back on the ball, hips lifted level with your knees, and hold one dumbbell over your chest.
Place your feet wider than hip-width for a solid base.
Breathe in and open the arm out to the side in a slow arc, elbow softly bent.
Resist the pull of the weight; keep your hips level and do not roll off the ball.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbell back over your chest.
Complete the set, then change arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Concentration Curl (on Stability Ball)
aliases: one arm concentration curl on stability ball
db one arm concentration curl on stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet wide and flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand, lean forward and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top while keeping your balance on the ball.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Decline Chest Press
aliases: db one arm decline chest press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked in and hold a dumbbell beside your lower chest.
Grip the bench with your free hand.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up over your lower chest until your arm is extended.
Breathe in and lower it slowly, elbow at about 45 degrees from your side.
Keep both shoulders on the bench through every rep.
Switch arms when the set is done.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm fly on exercise ball
db one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: Roll down on the ball until your head and shoulders are supported, hips up and feet flat, holding a dumbbell over your chest.
Put your free hand on your hip or stretch it out to the side for balance.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the elbow slightly bent.
Stop when you feel a good stretch across your chest.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbell back up in a wide arc.
Change arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm French Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm french press on exercise ball
db one arm french press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with your feet flat and wide, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead so your arm is straight and close to your head.
Breathe in and bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten the arm, keeping the elbow pointing up.
Keep your back straight and stomach tight, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
aliases: db one arm hammer preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest one upper arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell with your palm facing in.
Start with the arm nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze at the top without lifting the elbow.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm hammer press on exercise ball
db one arm hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: Rest your upper back on the ball with your feet flat, knees bent and hips lifted level with your knees.
Hold one dumbbell above your chest with your palm facing in.
Lower it to the side of your chest, elbow close to your ribs.
Breathe out and press back up until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your glutes the whole time so your hips stay up, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Incline Chest Press
aliases: db one arm incline chest press
instructions: Lie on a bench set to about 30 degrees with a dumbbell at the side of your upper chest, palm facing your feet.
Hold the bench with your free hand and keep your back flat against the pad.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell up, letting your palm turn slightly inward near the top.
Pause with the arm straight over your shoulder.
Breathe in and lower it back to your chest slowly.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Kickback
instructions: Place your left knee and left hand on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in your right hand.
Keep your back flat and lift your right upper arm so it is level with your torso, forearm hanging down.
Breathe out and straighten your right arm back until it is fully extended.
Hold and squeeze for a second.
Breathe in and lower the forearm slowly; switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side and your other hand on your hip.
Brace your stomach and keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Keep your body upright without leaning.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise With Support
aliases: one arm lateral raise with support
db one arm lateral raise with support
instructions: Stand side-on to a sturdy post and hold it with your near hand at about waist height.
Take a dumbbell in your other hand and lean your body slightly away from the post.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is level with the floor.
Keep your arm almost straight and your stomach tight.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Press On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm press on exercise ball
db one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your upper back on the ball, hips lifted and feet planted, holding a dumbbell beside your chest.
Tighten your stomach and glutes to keep your hips level.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is extended.
Breathe in and lower it slowly to the side of your chest.
Do not let the shoulder on the working side lift off the ball.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Prone Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let that arm hang straight down off the side of the bench, palm facing forward.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm pointing down.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Prone Hammer Curl
aliases: db one arm prone hammer curl
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down beside the bench with your palm facing in.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, thumb pointing forward and up.
Squeeze at the top while your upper arm stays pointing down.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Pullover On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm pullover on exercise ball
db one arm pullover on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your upper back across the ball, hips up, and hold a dumbbell over your chest in one hand with a slight elbow bend.
Rest your free hand on your stomach.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell back past your head in an arc until you feel a stretch along your side and chest.
Keep your ribs down and your hips level.
Breathe out and pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Fly (with Support)
aliases: one arm reverse fly with support
db one arm reverse fly with support
instructions: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, with your back flat and level.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, arm hanging under your shoulder, palm facing in.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight bend in the elbow.
Stop at shoulder height and squeeze for a second without twisting your body.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Grip Press
aliases: db one arm reverse grip press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing toward your head.
Start with the dumbbell beside your chest and your elbow close to your side.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is extended over your shoulder.
Keep your wrist firm and your elbow tucked as you press.
Breathe in and lower it slowly back beside your chest.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
aliases: db one arm reverse preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest the back of one upper arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Start with your arm almost straight but not locked.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping your wrist in line with your forearm.
Stop when your forearm is close to vertical and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Spider Curl
aliases: db one arm reverse spider curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest near the top and a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down with your palm facing back.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping your palm facing down and your wrist straight.
Squeeze at the top while your upper arm stays vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
aliases: db one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm along your thigh, wrist just past your knee.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Let your hand drop so the wrist bends toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift the back of your hand as high as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Bicep Curl On Exercise Ball
aliases: one arm seated bicep curl on exercise ball
db one arm seated bicep curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with feet wide, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm forward.
Rest your free hand on your thigh and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Squeeze briefly, then lower slowly without leaning to the side.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Hammer Curl
aliases: db one arm seated hammer curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing in.
Keep your back straight and your elbow tucked against your side.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up with your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
aliases: one arm seated neutral wrist curl
db one arm seated neutral wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm along your thigh with the hand past the knee.
Hold a dumbbell in that hand with your thumb pointing up, like holding a hammer.
Let the front end of the dumbbell tip down toward the floor.
Raise the front end up toward the ceiling by bending the wrist toward the thumb side.
Lower slowly, keep the forearm still on your thigh, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing forward.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Keep your hips and shoulders level the whole time.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down with a flat back and grip the dumbbell with one hand, the other arm out for balance.
Drive through your legs and extend your hips explosively, keeping the dumbbell close to your body.
As it rises past your chest, pull your elbow high and flip the dumbbell up to lock it out overhead.
Stand tall with the arm straight, then lower it to your shoulder, then your hip, then the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Standing Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow close to your side and your shoulders still.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up to your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Standing Hammer Curl
aliases: db one arm standing hammer curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing your thigh.
Keep your elbow tucked and your torso still.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping your thumb pointing up.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension (on Bench)
aliases: one arm triceps extension on bench
db one arm triceps extension on bench
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in one hand straight overhead.
Keep that elbow close to your head and pointing forward.
Breathe in and bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arm back overhead.
Keep your torso still; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Upright Row
instructions: Stand tall and hold a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh, palm facing you.
Put your free hand on your hip and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and lift your elbow up and out, pulling the dumbbell up close to your body.
Stop when your elbow reaches shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and lay one forearm on your thigh with your wrist hanging past the knee.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Let the dumbbell lower so your wrist bends back.
Breathe out and curl your palm up toward your forearm.
Squeeze briefly, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Complete the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
aliases: db one arm zottman preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with one upper arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
At the top, turn your wrist so your palm faces down.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell slowly with your palm still facing down.
At the bottom, turn your palm back up, finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell One Leg Fly On Exercise Ball
aliases: one leg fly on exercise ball
db one leg fly on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your head and upper back on the ball, hips lifted, and hold two dumbbells over your chest, palms facing in.
Straighten one leg in front of you so you are balancing on the other foot.
Breathe in and open your arms out to the sides with a soft bend in the elbows.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Keep your hips level and the ball still; use a lighter weight than usual.
Halfway through the set or on the next set, switch the supporting leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Neutral Wrist Curl
aliases: db over bench neutral wrist curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay your forearms across it with your hands just past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your thumbs pointing up.
Let the front ends of the dumbbells dip down toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift the front ends up as high as you can by moving only your wrists.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping your forearms flat on the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
aliases: over bench one arm neutral wrist curl
db over bench one arm neutral wrist curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and rest one forearm on it, hand just past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with your thumb pointing up and steady the forearm with your other hand.
Let the front of the dumbbell tip down toward the floor.
Breathe out and raise it as far as your wrist allows without lifting your forearm.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
aliases: over bench one arm reverse wrist curl
db over bench one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay one forearm on it, hand hanging past the edge, palm facing down.
Hold a light dumbbell and let the back of your hand drop toward the floor.
Lift the back of your hand up as high as you can, moving only at the wrist.
Hold the top for a second, then lower slowly.
Keep your forearm flat on the bench the whole time and switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Wrist Curl
aliases: over bench one arm wrist curl
db over bench one arm wrist curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay one forearm on it, palm up, with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell and let it lower so your wrist bends toward the floor.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up by bending only the wrist.
Hold the top for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly to a full stretch.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl
aliases: db over bench reverse wrist curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and rest both forearms on it with your hands past the edge.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with palms facing down.
Let the dumbbells hang so your wrists bend down.
Breathe out and raise the backs of your hands as high as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Keep your forearms flat on the bench throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent Over Row
aliases: db palm rotational bent over row
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your back is nearly level with the floor, knees soft.
Let the dumbbells hang with palms facing behind you.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips and rotate your palms to face forward as they rise.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top and breathe out.
Lower slowly, turning your palms back as your arms straighten.
Keep your back flat for the whole set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Palms In Incline Bench Press
aliases: db palms in incline bench press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back against the bench.
Breathe out and press both dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Stop when your elbows are just below the bench line, then press again.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Plyo Squat
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell at each side and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders pulled down so the dumbbells stay still.
Squat down to about half depth, chest up.
Explode upward, pushing through your feet so they leave the floor.
Land quietly on the balls of your feet and bend your knees to absorb the landing.
Pause to reset, breathing out as you jump, then go again.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Over Exercise Ball
aliases: db preacher curl over exercise ball
instructions: Kneel behind an exercise ball and lean forward until your chest and stomach rest on top of it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and let your arms hang straight down in front of the ball, palms forward.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up, keeping your upper arms pointing at the floor.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping the ball steady with your knees.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Preacher Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit or stand at a preacher bench and rest the back of one upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your thumb pointing up and the arm almost straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping the thumb on top.
Stop when your forearm is near vertical and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Press On Exercise Ball
instructions: Sit on the ball with dumbbells on your thighs and walk out until your head and upper back rest on it.
Lift your hips level with your knees and bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Breathe out and press both dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your chest.
Breathe in and lower them slowly until your elbows are just below your torso.
Keep your hips from dropping as you get tired.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pronate-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit upright on a bench and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands gripping the handle, palms facing down.
Keep your elbows close to your head and pointing forward.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Stop when you feel a good stretch in the back of your arms.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to raise it back overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Lie chest-down on a bench set to about 45 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up while your upper arms stay vertical.
Squeeze hard at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest near the top and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with your palms facing each other.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze at the top while your upper arms stay vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover Hip Extension On Exercise Ball
aliases: pullover hip extension on exercise ball
db pullover hip extension on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your upper back on the ball, hips lowered toward the floor, holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc, elbows slightly bent.
Breathe out and pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
With the weight held over your chest, squeeze your glutes and drive your hips up until your body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Lower your hips back down with control to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover On Exercise Ball
instructions: Place your shoulders across the ball, hips up and feet flat, and hold one dumbbell under the top plate with both palms.
Start with the dumbbell above your chest and your elbows slightly bent.
Breathe in deeply as you lower the weight behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Breathe out and bring it back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your elbows at the same angle throughout; the movement comes from the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides, turning your palms down as you go.
Stop at shoulder height and pause briefly.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back until your upper body is almost level with the floor.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with the dumbbells under your chest.
Breathe out and lift your elbows out to the sides and up until your upper arms are level with your back.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row (shoulder)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your upper body is almost level with the floor, knees slightly bent.
Let the dumbbells hang under your shoulders with your palms facing behind you.
Breathe out and pull the dumbbells up toward your chest, keeping your elbows wide.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders when your upper arms are level with your back.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Fly
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, and hinge forward until your upper body is almost level with the floor.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other and a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Keep your neck in line with your back and don't jerk the weights.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench and lean forward until your chest is close to your thighs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand behind your calves, palms facing each other.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Stop when your arms are level with your shoulders and pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise (support Head)
aliases: db rear lateral raise support head
instructions: Set a bench to a high incline, stand behind it, and hinge forward until your forehead rests on the top of the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging down and a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.
Keep your forehead on the pad and squeeze your shoulder blades briefly.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and turn your palms to face your head.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest with your arms straight.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause briefly when the dumbbells reach chest level.
Breathe out and press them back up, keeping your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides and palms facing behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and wrists straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up with the backs of your hands leading.
Stop near shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench One Arm Row
aliases: reverse grip incline bench one arm row
db reverse grip incline bench one arm row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie on it face down.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing forward and let the arm hang straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back and breathe out at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Two Arm Row
aliases: reverse grip incline bench two arm row
db reverse grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: Lie face down on a low-incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Turn your palms to face forward.
Pull both dumbbells toward your hips, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without lifting your chest off the pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Row
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees until your back is close to level, keeping it flat.
Pull the dumbbells toward your hips, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest the back of one upper arm on a preacher pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing down and the arm almost straight.
Breathe out and curl it up while keeping your wrist in line with your forearm.
Stop when your forearm is near vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with your palms facing back.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up, keeping your palms down and wrists straight.
Pause at the top with your upper arms still vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms down, wrists just past your knees.
Let the dumbbells drop so your wrists bend toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift the backs of your hands upward.
Hold briefly, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Choose a light weight so you can control every rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rotation Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and knees slightly bent, holding the dumbbells under your chest with palms facing each other.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides.
As you lift, rotate your hands so your thumbs point forward at the top.
Pause at shoulder height and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Breathe in and lower slowly, turning your hands back to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Scott Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells beside your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Point your elbows straight out to the sides so your upper arms are in line with your shoulders.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up and slightly in until your arms are straight.
Breathe in and lower them slowly back to the wide starting position.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Front Raise
instructions: Sit tall on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and keep your feet flat.
Breathe out and raise one dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height, turning the palm down.
Lower it slowly as you breathe in.
Raise the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Hammer Curl On Exercise Ball
aliases: seated alternate hammer curl on exercise ball
db seated alternate hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with feet wide, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms in.
Brace your stomach.
Breathe out and curl one dumbbell up with your thumb pointing up.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other one.
Keep alternating while keeping the ball still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward.
Keep your back against the pad and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press one dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Breathe in and lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep one dumbbell overhead and breathe in as you lower the other to shoulder height.
Breathe out and press it back up.
Hold that arm overhead and lower the other one.
Keep alternating with your back against the pad and your stomach braced.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Bench Extension
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with feet flat and back straight.
Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top end.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your ears.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press it back overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Arm Lateral Raise
aliases: db seated bent arm lateral raise
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your elbows bent to 90 degrees at your sides.
Brace your stomach and keep your forearms pointing forward.
Breathe out and lift your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your shoulders.
Keep your elbows and wrists at the same height at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Alternate Kickback
aliases: db seated bent over alternate kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean your chest forward over your thighs with a flat back.
Lift your upper arms so they run alongside your body, elbows bent at about a right angle.
Breathe out and straighten one arm back until it is in line with your body.
Squeeze the triceps, then bend the elbow slowly to return.
Do the same with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Triceps Extension
aliases: db seated bent over triceps extension
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Raise your upper arms beside your body and bend your elbows to about a right angle.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back at the same time.
Hold the squeeze for a moment with your arms in line with your body.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the dumbbells.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Turn your palms to face forward and keep your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl (on Stability Ball)
aliases: seated biceps curl on stability ball
db seated biceps curl on stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet flat and hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand.
Sit tall, brace your stomach and let your arms hang with palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps while staying balanced.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl To Shoulder Press
aliases: seated biceps curl to shoulder press
db seated biceps curl to shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Turn your palms to face forward at shoulder height and push both dumbbells up until your elbows straighten overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders with control.
Breathe in and lower them slowly to your sides to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with the balls of both feet on a low block, heels off.
Rest a dumbbell on each thigh just above the knees and hold them in place.
Lower your heels to stretch the calves.
Breathe out and lift your heels as high as you can.
Squeeze for a second at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Cuban Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees and forearms pointing down.
Rotate your forearms up until the dumbbells are above your elbows.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells overhead, then lower them back to the 90-degree position.
Rotate your forearms back down and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise
instructions: Sit tall on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides.
Brace your stomach and keep your back straight.
Breathe out and raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, palms facing down.
Pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Sit tall with your elbows tucked.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Inner Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging and palms facing forward.
Turn your arms slightly outward so your hands start a little wide.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up and out toward the outside of your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top with your elbows still at your sides.
Breathe in and lower slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean your chest forward over your thighs.
Raise your elbows so your upper arms are tight to your sides and close to level, forearms hanging down.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back until they are fully extended.
Squeeze the triceps at the top.
Breathe in and bend your elbows slowly to return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise (Back Supported)
aliases: db seated lateral raise back supported
instructions: Set a bench upright, sit with your back against it and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your feet flat and your head against the pad.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly without shrugging.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs with your hands just past your knees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Let the front ends of the dumbbells drop toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift them as high as you can using only your wrists.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping your forearms on your thighs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Bicep Curl On Exercise Ball With Leg Raised
aliases: seated one arm bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
db seated one arm bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm forward.
Brace your stomach and lift the opposite foot off the floor, leg straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly while holding your balance.
Finish the set, then switch arm and raised leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and lean forward with a flat back.
Place your free hand on your knee and raise the working elbow so the upper arm is close to level and tight to your side.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back until it is fully extended.
Squeeze for a second.
Breathe in and lower the forearm slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Rotate
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm on your thigh with your hand past the knee.
Hold a light dumbbell vertically, like a hammer, by its middle or one end.
Breathe out and rotate your hand until the palm faces up.
Rotate the other way until the palm faces down, moving slowly.
Keep your forearm on your thigh; only the forearm twists.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Shoulder Press
aliases: db seated one arm shoulder press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with your feet flat and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing forward.
Rest your free hand on your thigh and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Keep your body from leaning to either side.
Breathe in and lower slowly to your shoulder, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise
aliases: db seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench and place the ball of one foot on a low block or plate, heel hanging off.
Set a dumbbell upright on top of that knee and hold it steady with your hand.
Let your heel drop below the block for a stretch.
Breathe out and push the knee up by rising onto the ball of your foot.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Hammer Grip
aliases: seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip
db seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip
instructions: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a step and the heel hanging off.
Stand a dumbbell on end on top of that knee and grip its handle with your palm facing in.
Press the dumbbell down lightly to keep it steady.
Breathe out and rise onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and lower your heel slowly below the step.
Complete the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Palm Up
aliases: seated one leg calf raise - palm up
db seated one leg calf raise - palm up
instructions: Sit on a bench with the ball of one foot on a step, heel off the edge.
Lay a dumbbell across that thigh just above the knee and hold it with your palm facing up.
Keep your back straight and your foot pointing forward.
Breathe out and raise your heel as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly into a stretch.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl
aliases: db seated palms up wrist curl
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your wrists just past your knees.
Let the dumbbells lower so your wrists bend back.
Breathe out and curl both palms up as high as possible.
Pause, then breathe in and lower under control.
Keep your forearms flat and still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and place the back of one upper arm flat on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell underhand with the arm almost straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
aliases: db seated reverse grip concentration curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Lean forward and rest the back of that upper arm against your inner thigh, palm facing down.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up, keeping your wrist straight.
Stop near shoulder level.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
aliases: seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
db seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in one hand overhead, palm facing up behind you.
Keep the elbow pointing to the ceiling and the upper arm close to your head.
Breathe in and bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back overhead.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press (parallel Grip)
aliases: db seated shoulder press parallel grip
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows slightly in front of your body and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your palms facing each other the whole time.
Breathe in and lower slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in one hand straight overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Breathe in and bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back overhead.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise
aliases: db side lying one hand raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your head resting on your bottom arm and a dumbbell in your top hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your legs stacked and your top arm almost straight.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbell up until your arm points just short of the ceiling.
Lower it slowly as you breathe in.
Finish your set, then roll over and work the other side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Plank With Rear Fly
aliases: db side plank with rear fly
instructions: Lie on your side and set up a side plank on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Hold a light dumbbell in your top hand, starting with it near the floor in front of your chest.
Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to feet and tighten your stomach.
Raise the dumbbell out and up until your arm points to the ceiling, keeping a slight bend in the elbow.
Lower it slowly while keeping your hips up.
Finish the set and switch sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Carry
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one hand until your arm is straight, biceps near your ear.
Stand tall, brace your stomach and keep your ribs down.
Walk forward with short, steady steps, keeping the dumbbell directly over your shoulder.
Breathe steadily and don't lean to either side.
After the set distance, lower the dumbbell with control and switch hands.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift With Stepbox Support
aliases: single leg deadlift with stepbox support
db single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: Place a low step about a stride behind you and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Put most of your weight on your front leg and rest the toes of your back foot on the step.
Soften the front knee and breathe in.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along the front leg, keeping your back flat.
Breathe out, squeeze the front glute and stand tall.
Finish the set, then switch the working leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift With Stepbox Support (One Dumbbell)
aliases: single leg deadlift with stepbox support one dumbbell
dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
db single leg deadlift with stepbox support one db
db single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: Stand on your right leg with the toes of your left foot resting on a low box behind you.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand next to your thigh.
Keep a small bend in the right knee and brace your stomach.
Breathe in and hinge forward, lowering the dumbbell toward the middle of your right shin.
Keep your hips level and stop when you feel a strong stretch in the right hamstring.
Breathe out and push your hips forward to stand; switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench, holding one dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Balance on one leg and lift the other foot slightly forward off the floor.
Push the dumbbell a little forward to counterbalance as you sit back and down on the standing leg.
Lower until you lightly touch the box, keeping the knee over your toes and the heel down.
Drive through the standing heel to stand back up without letting the free foot touch down.
Breathe out as you stand; finish one leg, then switch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell hanging at each side.
Brace your core, lift your chest and look straight ahead.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down, letting the dumbbells hang straight.
Go down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, heels flat.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Hammer Curl And Press
aliases: standing alternate hammer curl and press
db standing alternate hammer curl and press
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Breathe out and hammer curl one dumbbell up to your shoulder.
Press that dumbbell straight overhead, keeping your palm facing in.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to your side with control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating, stomach tight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe out and press one dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Breathe in and lower it back to your shoulder.
Press the other side and keep alternating, staying upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise one dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower it slowly.
Raise the other arm and keep alternating without leaning.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternating Tricep Kickback
instructions: Take a dumbbell in each hand, unlock your knees and tip your torso forward from the hips, back flat.
Bring your upper arms up beside your body with elbows bent at about a right angle.
Breathe out and straighten one arm back until it is in line with your body.
Bend it slowly to return, then straighten the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still and your back flat as you alternate.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you and elbows in front.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe out and press up while turning your palms forward and moving your elbows out to the sides.
Finish with your arms straight and palms facing forward over your head.
Breathe in and reverse the turn as you lower back to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Around World
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms almost straight and brace your stomach.
Breathe in as you sweep the dumbbells out to the sides and up until they meet over your head.
Breathe out and reverse the circle back down to your thighs.
Move slowly and keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Bent Over One Arm Triceps Extension
aliases: standing bent over one arm triceps extension
db standing bent over one arm triceps extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and put your other hand on a bench, hinging forward until your back is nearly flat.
Raise the working upper arm beside your body with the elbow bent at about a right angle.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back until it is fully extended.
Squeeze the triceps, then lower the dumbbell slowly by bending the elbow.
Finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Bent Over Two Arm Triceps Extension
aliases: standing bent over two arm triceps extension
db standing bent over two arm triceps extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, soften your knees and hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor.
Pull your upper arms up beside your body with your elbows bent.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back at the same time.
Squeeze for a moment with your arms in line with your body.
Bend your elbows slowly to return, keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing forward.
Pull your shoulders back and keep your elbows by your ribs.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up until your forearms are near vertical.
Squeeze at the top without leaning back.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Concentration Curl
instructions: Stand with feet wide, hinge forward at the hips and rest your free hand on your knee or a bench.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and let that arm hang straight down below your shoulder.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your chest without moving the upper arm.
Squeeze hard at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head
aliases: db standing front raise above head
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing each other.
Brace your stomach and keep your arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and raise the dumbbells in front of you and keep going until they are over your head.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch.
Breathe in and lower slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Inner Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Turn your hands slightly outward so the dumbbells point away from your body, elbows tucked at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbells up and out toward the outside of your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Kickback
instructions: With two dumbbells in hand, soften your knees and lean your torso forward to about 45 degrees or lower.
Bring your upper arms up beside your torso and let your forearms hang down.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back until they are in line with your body.
Pause and squeeze the triceps.
Breathe in and lower your forearms slowly without letting your elbows drop.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Concentration Curl
aliases: db standing one arm concentration curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, arm straight and palm facing forward.
Cup the working elbow with your free hand to hold it against your side.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell slowly toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps hard at the top for a second.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl (over Incline Bench)
aliases: standing one arm curl over incline bench
db standing one arm curl over incline bench
instructions: Set a bench to a steep incline and stand behind it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and drape the back of that upper arm over the top of the backrest, arm hanging down the front.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your arm off the pad.
Breathe in and lower slowly to an almost straight arm; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Curl Over Incline Bench
aliases: standing one arm curl over incline bench
db standing one arm curl over incline bench
instructions: Set a bench to a steep incline and stand behind it holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Drape the back of that upper arm over the top of the backrest so your arm hangs down the front, palm facing up.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Extension
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and press a dumbbell straight overhead in one hand.
Brace your stomach and keep the elbow close to your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arm back overhead.
Keep your torso upright; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Palm In Press
aliases: standing one arm palm in press
db standing one arm palm in press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand, palm facing in and elbow in front.
Brace your stomach and keep your free hand on your hip.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up, keeping your palm facing in.
Keep your shoulders level and don't lean away.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Reverse Curl
aliases: db standing one arm reverse curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, arm straight and palm facing behind you.
Keep the elbow at your side and the wrist straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up with the back of your hand leading.
Stop near shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Palms In Press
instructions: Stand tall and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing each other and elbows pointing forward.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your palms facing in the whole time.
Breathe in and lower slowly to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a preacher bench or standing preacher station and rest the back of one upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell underhand with the arm nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight and palms facing behind you.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, keeping your wrists flat.
Pause near shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a preacher bench and rest the backs of both upper arms on the pad, holding a dumbbell in each hand palms up.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
At the top, rotate your wrists so your palms face down.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly with palms down.
At the bottom, turn your palms back up before the next rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step Up Lunge
instructions: Set two sturdy benches about a stride apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step your front foot onto one bench and rest the top of your rear foot on the bench behind you.
Breathe in and lower straight down between the benches, keeping your chest up.
Go as deep as you can control, letting the front knee travel forward over the toes.
Breathe out and drive through the front heel to rise back up.
Finish the set, then switch legs carefully.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step Up Single Leg Balance With Bicep Curl
aliases: step up single leg balance with bicep curl
db step up single leg balance with bicep curl
instructions: Stand facing a box or step holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place one foot on the box and push through it to stand up on top.
Keep the other leg lifted with the knee bent and balance on the box leg.
While balanced, breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, then lower them slowly.
Step back down with control and repeat, switching legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up Lunge
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place your right foot fully on the box and push through it to stand on top, bringing the left foot up.
Step down with the left foot, then the right, back to the floor.
Step the right foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, breathing out as you rise.
Repeat, leading with the same leg for the set, then switch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up Split Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and place your right foot flat on a low step.
Step your left foot back into a long split stance with the heel lifted.
Breathe in and lower until the back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front heel pressed into the step.
Breathe out and push through the front foot to return to the top.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell with both hands directly above your chest, arms straight.
Brace your stomach and press your lower back gently into the bench.
Keeping your elbows straight, lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch along your chest and sides.
Raise it back to above your chest without bending your arms.
Inhale on the way back and exhale on the way up; use a lighter dumbbell than for a bent-arm pullover.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand against the front of your thighs, palms facing you, feet hip-width apart.
Soften your knees slightly and pull your shoulders back and down.
Push your hips back and let the dumbbells slide down your thighs, keeping them close to your legs.
Stop just below the knees or when your hamstrings are fully stretched.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward until you are upright.
Breathe in as you hinge and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull Through
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its end with both hands.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length between your legs.
Breathe in, push your hips back and let the dumbbell travel back between your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Keep your back flat and arms long, without squatting deep.
Breathe out and thrust your hips forward, squeezing your glutes, so the dumbbell rises to just in front of your hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull Through (Bottom Stretch)
aliases: db sumo pull through bottom stretch
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes pointed out and hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your hips.
Soften your knees and tighten your stomach.
Push your hips back and reach the dumbbell down and back between your legs, keeping your back flat.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings and inner thighs at the bottom.
Breathe out and drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes hard at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
instructions: Stand beside a rack or sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand at your side, feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in and sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Use the support only for balance, not to pull yourself up.
Breathe out and drive through your heels to stand.
Switch the dumbbell to the other hand halfway through, or on the next set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Turn the dumbbells so their ends point toward each other.
Breathe in and bend your elbows out to the sides, lowering the dumbbells inward until they touch your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
