Breathe out and straighten your arms to push the dumbbells back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback With Stork Stance
aliases: db tricep kickback with stork stance
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, lift one foot and rest it against the inside of your standing leg.
Hinge forward slightly with a flat back and bring your upper arms beside your body, elbows bent.
Breathe out and straighten both arms back.
Hold the squeeze briefly, then bend your elbows to return.
Keep your balance and switch standing legs halfway through or between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Twisting Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand beside your chest, palms facing each other.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up, turning your hands as you go so your palms face your feet at the top.
Bring the dumbbells close together over your chest and squeeze.
Lower them slowly while turning your palms back to face each other.
Keep your elbows from flaring wide as you move.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides to shoulder height with elbows bent to 90 degrees and forearms pointing forward.
Breathe out and rotate your forearms up until they point to the ceiling, keeping your elbows in place.
Pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and rotate back down slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell W-Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench and hold the dumbbells beside your shoulders, palms forward, elbows pointing down and out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades back and down so your arms form a W.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Breathe in and lower them back into the W position.
Keep your back straight and your stomach braced throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold one dumbbell vertically in front of your thighs, both palms cupped flat under the top plate.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your chest, keeping it vertical.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms on the pad, holding a dumbbell in each hand palms up.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up.
Turn your palms to face down at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, resisting the weight with your forearms.
Turn your palms back up at the bottom and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbells Seated Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupped under the top plate.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.
Keep your back against the pad and your ribs down.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing your arms back gently until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Swing them forward and cross them in front of your chest, alternating which arm goes on top.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled, gradually increasing the range.
Breathe naturally and continue for about 20 to 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Elbow Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping it beside your hips.
Walk your feet out until your legs are straight and only your heels touch the floor, then slide your hips off the bench.
Breathe in and bend your elbows straight back to lower your hips toward the floor.
Stop when your elbows reach about a right angle, keeping your back close to the bench.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Elbow Lift - Reverse Push-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees with your upper arms by your sides and forearms pointing up.
Press your elbows into the floor to lift your upper back and chest off the mat.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out at the top.
Lower yourself slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: Elbow-To-Knee
instructions: Lie on your back with your fingertips behind your head and your knees bent, feet flat.
Breathe out, lift your shoulders and bring your left knee up as your right elbow twists toward it.
Touch or nearly touch elbow to knee, then lower both with control.
Repeat with your left elbow and right knee.
Keep your elbows open and the movement slow.

exercises.name: Elevator
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width and arms straight.
Let your shoulders rise toward your ears in a relaxed hang.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a few centimetres.
Hold for a second and breathe out.
Lower slowly back to the relaxed hang.

exercises.name: Elliptical
instructions: Step onto the pedals one foot at a time while holding the fixed handles.
Start striding slowly, then take hold of the moving handles.
Stand upright and keep your whole foot on the pedal instead of rising onto your toes.
Push and pull the handles in rhythm with your legs.
Choose a resistance that makes you breathe harder but still lets you talk.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Alternating Arm Ups
instructions: Lie face down with your stomach on the ball, feet on the floor and hands on the floor in front of you.
Tighten your stomach so your body stays steady on the ball.
Lift one arm straight forward in line with your ear, thumb pointing up.
Hold for a second, then lower it with control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Arms Extended
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and your feet wide on the floor or braced against a wall.
Reach both arms straight forward past your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest until your arms, back and legs form one line.
Breathe out as you lift and keep your neck in line with your back.
Lower slowly over the ball.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Hands Behind Head
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and your feet planted wide or against a wall.
Place your fingertips lightly behind your head with elbows out.
Lift your chest off the ball until your body is straight, squeezing your glutes.
Do not pull on your head; keep your chin tucked slightly.
Lower slowly and breathe in on the way down.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Knees Off Ground
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and press the balls of your feet against a wall, legs straight.
Keep your knees off the floor and cross your arms on your chest.
Lift your chest until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe out at the top.
Lower slowly while keeping your legs straight.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Rotation
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and your feet wide on the floor.
Place your fingertips behind your head.
Lift your chest until your back is straight.
At the top, turn your chest to one side, then back to the middle.
Lower slowly and alternate the side you turn to each rep.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips, then place your heels on an exercise ball in front of you.
Lift your hips off the bench so your arms and the ball hold your weight, legs straight.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower your hips until your elbows reach about a right angle.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep the ball still and your back close to the bench.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot flat in front, both knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place a stability ball in front of you and rest your hands on top of it.
Tuck your pelvis under slightly and squeeze your right glute.
Shift your hips forward slowly, rolling the ball a little ahead, until you feel the stretch at the front of the right hip.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with slow breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Hug
instructions: Kneel on a mat with a stability ball in front of you.
Lean forward and wrap your arms around the ball, resting your chest and head on it.
Let your back round softly over the ball and relax your shoulders.
Breathe slowly and feel the space open between your shoulder blades.
Roll the ball gently forward and back or side to side for 30 to 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel on a mat with a stability ball in front of you.
Place both hands on top of the ball, thumbs up.
Roll the ball forward and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Let your chest sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch along your sides and under your arms.
Breathe deeply and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Lower Back Stretch (pyramid)
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and a stability ball on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and place both hands on the ball.
Roll the ball forward and let your chest drop between your arms, keeping your legs straight.
Push your hips up and back so your body forms a pyramid shape.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then roll the ball back to stand up.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Lying Side Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel beside the ball and lie sideways over it so it sits under your ribs and hip.
Straighten your legs and stagger your feet on the floor for balance.
Reach your top arm over your head and let your side curve over the ball.
Breathe into the stretched side and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Come back up slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise
instructions: Place an exercise ball against a wall and lean your lower back into it.
Walk your feet slightly forward so you stand upright, feet hip-width apart.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Breathe out and rise onto the balls of your feet, letting the ball roll slightly up the wall.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower your heels slowly.
Keep gentle pressure into the ball the whole time.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise (tennis Ball Between Ankles)
aliases: exercise ball on the wall calf raise
instructions: Lean your lower back into an exercise ball placed against a wall, with your feet a little in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles and press it gently with both feet.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can without letting the tennis ball drop.
Hold for a second, then lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Exhale on the way up and inhale on the way down.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball On The Wall Calf Raise (tennis Ball Between Knees)
aliases: exercise ball on the wall calf raise
instructions: Place an exercise ball against a wall and lean your lower back into it, feet slightly in front of you and hip-width apart.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides.
Put a tennis ball between your knees and squeeze it lightly.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can, letting the ball roll slightly up the wall.
Keep squeezing the tennis ball, pause at the top, then lower your heels slowly.
Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball One Leg Prone Lower Body Rotation
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and your hands on the floor in front, arms straight.
Lift one leg straight back until it is in line with your body.
Keeping your hands planted, slowly rotate your hips and swing the raised leg across behind you toward the other side.
Go only as far as you can stay balanced on the ball.
Rotate back to the center, lower the leg and repeat with the other leg.
Breathe out as you rotate and keep your core tight the whole time.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball One Legged Diagonal Kick Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out at your sides and one heel on top of the ball; hold the other leg up toward the ceiling.
Press your heel into the ball and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to heel.
Keeping your hips up, bend the knee and roll the ball in toward your glutes.
Push the ball back out at a diagonal, angling the leg slightly away from your body, until the leg is straight.
Bring the ball back to center and keep your hips level the whole time.
Breathe out as you curl in; finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Pike Push Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your hands on the floor under your shoulders and your shins resting on the ball.
Brace your stomach and lift your hips toward the ceiling, rolling the ball in until your toes are on top of it.
Lower back to a straight plank position with control.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms.
Keep your back from sagging at any point; reset if the ball drifts sideways.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Prone Leg Raise
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Straighten your legs behind you with your toes resting on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift both legs until they line up with your body.
Breathe out as you lift and avoid swinging.
Lower your legs slowly until your toes lightly touch the floor.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Seated Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on top of a stability ball with your feet flat and knees bent.
Walk one foot forward and straighten that leg, resting the heel on the floor.
Sit tall and place your hands on your thighs.
Lean forward from the hips with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the straight leg.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Seated Triceps Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor.
Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and let your hand drop behind your head toward your upper back.
Hold the bent elbow with your other hand and gently ease it back and toward your head.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, keeping your ribs down.
Release slowly and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Supine Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in each hand, walk your feet forward and lie back until your head and upper back rest on it.
Lift your hips level with your knees and press the dumbbells straight up, palms facing each other.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Keep squeezing your glutes so your hips don't drop.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle at elbow height and stand side-on to the machine, holding it in the hand farther from the stack.
Tuck your elbow against your side, bent to 90 degrees, forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm out and away from your body, keeping the elbow pinned.
Return slowly across your body.

exercises.name: Ez Bar French Press On Exercise Ball
instructions: Hold an EZ bar on the inner angled grips and lie back on the ball until your upper back and head are supported, hips raised.
Press the bar up over your chest with your arms straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows pointing up and not flaring out.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Lying Bent Arms Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold an EZ bar over your chest with a narrow overhand grip.
Bend your elbows and keep that bend fixed.
Breathe in and lower the bar back behind your head in an arc until you feel your lats stretch.
Keep your lower back on the bench.
Breathe out and pull the bar back over your chest.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your head near the end and hold an EZ bar on the inner grips above your face.
Let your upper arms angle slightly back toward your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar past your forehead to behind your head.
Feel the stretch in the back of your arms while keeping your elbows narrow.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to bring the bar back above your face.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Hold an EZ bar on the angled grips with your palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips until your back is at about 45 degrees or lower, knees soft and back flat.
Pull the bar toward your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wide and hold an EZ bar underhand on the inner grips.
Lean forward and brace the backs of your upper arms against your inner thighs, arms hanging down.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Standing French Press
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold an EZ bar overhead on the inner grips, arms straight.
Tighten your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your lower back stays neutral.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift the bar back overhead.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Anti Gravity Press
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it with your head past the top edge.
Hold an EZ bar at the level of your face with an overhand grip, elbows bent and pointing down.
Breathe out and press the bar forward and up in line with your body until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad and your shoulder blades squeezed.
Breathe in and bring the bar back slowly to your face.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Close-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold an EZ bar on the inner angled grips, palms facing up.
Let the bar rest against your thighs and keep your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Decline Close Grip Face Press
aliases: ez bb decline close grip face press
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding an EZ bar on the inner grips above your chest.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to bring the bar down toward your chin and face, letting your elbows travel slightly forward.
Stop a few centimeters above your face.
Breathe out and press the bar back up over your chest until your arms are straight.
Move slowly and use a spotter for heavier sets.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Decline Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and hold an EZ bar on the inner grips above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical to the floor and your elbows pointing up.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just above your head without moving your upper arms.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold an EZ bar on the inner grips with straight arms above your head.
Keep your upper arms fixed and angled slightly back.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Go as deep as you can control while feeling the stretch.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to raise the bar.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Jm Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar on the inner grips with straight arms over your chest.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, letting the bar come down toward your upper chest and chin.
Let your elbows move forward toward your feet so your forearms fold against your upper arms.
Stop just above your chin.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms along the same path.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
aliases: ez bb reverse grip preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with palms facing down and arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up, keeping your wrists in line with your forearms.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical.
Breathe in and lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Seated Curls
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat and hold an EZ bar underhand on the angled grips, resting it on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly back to your thighs.

exercises.name: Ez Barbell Spider Curl (Incline Bench)
aliases: ez bb spider curl incline bench
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest near the top edge.
Hold an EZ bar underhand and let your arms hang straight toward the floor.
Breathe out and curl the bar up, keeping your upper arms pointing straight down.
Squeeze your biceps hard at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Ez-Bar Biceps Curl (with Arm Blaster)
instructions: Put on the arm blaster and hold an EZ bar underhand on the angled grips.
Stand tall with your arms straight and your elbows pressed against the plate.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Ez-Bar Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold an EZ bar on the inner angled grips over your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep the bar moving in a straight line over your lower chest.

exercises.name: Ez-Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl
aliases: ez-bb standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold an EZ bar underhand on the outer angled grips.
Let the bar rest at your thighs with your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest without swinging.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Cable)
instructions: Set a rope on a cable at about head height and hold one end in each hand, thumbs toward you.
Step back until your arms are straight and the weight is off the stack; stand tall with a light brace.
Pull the rope toward your face, driving your elbows high and wide and pulling the ends apart as they pass your ears.
Pause with your hands beside your head and your shoulder blades squeezed together, then let the arms straighten under control.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Dumbbell)
instructions: Place a heavy dumbbell on each side of your feet.
Bend your knees, keep your back flat and pick them up as in a deadlift.
Stand tall with shoulders pulled back and down and arms straight at your sides.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps, keeping your stomach tight and your body still.
Breathe steadily, and set the dumbbells down carefully at the end of the distance.

exercises.name: Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up, wrists past your knees.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Slowly open your fingers and let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Close your fingers to roll the bar back into your palms.
Finish with a small wrist curl and squeeze hard.
Keep the bar under control; use a weight you can hold safely at the fingertips.

exercises.name: Flag
instructions: Grip a sturdy vertical pole with both hands, the top hand above your head and the bottom hand about shoulder-width lower, both thumbs pointing up.
Lock the bottom arm straight to push into the pole and pull hard with the top arm.
Jump or kick your legs up and out to the side while tightening your abs and the side of your body facing up.
Straighten your body until it is level with the floor, legs together or spread for an easier version.
Hold while breathing steadily, then lower your legs with control. Build up with tucked knees first.

exercises.name: Flexion Leg Sit Up (bent Knee)
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent and feet just off the floor, arms by your sides.
Breathe out and lift your upper body while pulling your knees in toward your chest.
Meet in a tight tuck, balancing on your hips for a moment.
Lower your back and push your feet away slowly, stopping before they rest on the floor.

exercises.name: Flexion Leg Sit Up (straight Arm)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet slightly off the floor, and your arms straight overhead.
Breathe out and swing your straight arms forward as you sit up and draw your knees in.
Reach your hands past your knees toward your feet at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly back to the start, arms overhead again.

exercises.name: Floor Fly (with Barbell)
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, holding a light barbell over your chest with a narrow overhand grip.
Keep your elbows softly bent throughout.
Lower the bar toward your chest in an arc, letting your elbows travel out wide until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause lightly on the floor, then squeeze your chest to bring the bar back up over your chest.
Breathe out as you lift and keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on the floor inside a rack with the bar set at the height of your outstretched arms.
Grip the bar as for a bench press and unrack it over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms rest on the floor, pause briefly, and keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands flat under or beside your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your stomach.
Lift both heels a few centimeters off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick, alternating movements, keeping them straight.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time; raise your legs higher if it starts to arch.
Breathe steadily, and kick for a set time or count.

exercises.name: Forward Jump
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Dip into a quarter squat while swinging your arms back.
Swing your arms forward hard and jump forward as far as you can, pushing off both feet.
Land on both feet with your knees bent and your weight in the middle of your feet.
Hold the landing for a second, then walk back or turn around for the next jump.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step your right foot well out in front of you.
Breathe in and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your chest up and the front knee over the ankle.
Breathe out and push off the front foot to step back to the start.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Set an empty or light bar in a rack at shoulder height.
Step under it so the bar rests on the front of your shoulders, close to your throat.
Raise your arms straight out in front at shoulder height, palms down, without holding the bar.
Step back, set your feet shoulder-width apart, breathe in and squat down while keeping your chest tall.
Breathe out and stand up, keeping the arms level so the bar stays in place.

exercises.name: Frog Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open to the sides.
Reach your arms forward toward your feet or rest your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders up, reaching toward your feet.
Keep your knees relaxed and open; do not push through your legs.
Breathe in and lower slowly back down.

exercises.name: Frog Planche
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
Rest your knees against the backs of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Keep your arms as straight as you can and lean your shoulders forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor and balance, tightening your abs to pull your knees in toward your chest.
Hold while breathing steadily, then lower your feet with control.

exercises.name: Front And Back Neck Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch along the back of the neck.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds while breathing slowly.
Bring your head back to neutral, then gently tilt it back to look up at the ceiling.
Stop at a comfortable stretch in the front of the neck and hold for 15 to 20 seconds.
Move slowly and never force the range.

exercises.name: Front Groin Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up and weight balanced.
Bring the rear knee up quickly toward your chest.
Snap the lower leg forward and up so the top of the foot rises in front of you.
Pull the foot back immediately by bending the knee.
Set the foot down where it started, then repeat or switch legs.

exercises.name: Front Leg Hook Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your left leg forward and your guard up.
Shift your weight onto your back foot.
Raise your front knee and extend the leg so the foot passes just outside the target.
Pull the heel back sharply across the target by bending the knee.
Recoil the leg and place it back in your stance, staying balanced.
Do your reps, then switch the lead leg.

exercises.name: Front Lever
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and back and tighten your abs and glutes so your body is rigid.
Pressing the bar down toward your hips with straight arms, lift your legs and hips up until your body is level with the floor, facing the ceiling.
Hold the line from shoulders to feet without bending your hips or arms, breathing in short, steady breaths.
Lower slowly back to a hang. If the full hold is too hard, practice with your knees tucked or one leg bent.

exercises.name: Front Lever Reps
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Pull your shoulder blades down and lock your arms straight.
Tighten your stomach and glutes and lift your straight body until it is level with the floor.
Hold for a moment with your body horizontal, breathing steadily.
Lower slowly back to the hang and repeat; tuck your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Front Plank With Twist
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Rotate your hips to the right, lowering the right hip toward the floor without touching it.
Rotate back through the middle and lower the left hip toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders still and move at a steady pace, breathing throughout.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell against your thighs with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Brace your stomach and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and lift the bar forward and up until your arms are level with the floor.
Hold for a second without leaning back.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your thighs.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Cable)
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle in one hand beside your hip, palm facing back.
Take a small step forward, stand tall and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and raise the handle in front of you with a straight arm to shoulder height.
Hold for a second without twisting your body.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Brace your stomach and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and lift both dumbbells forward to shoulder height.
Pause for a second at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Front Snap Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the kicking knee high and point it at the target.
Pull your toes back and snap the lower leg forward, hitting with the ball of the foot.
Breathe out sharply as you kick, then snap the leg straight back.
Lower the foot into your stance and repeat, switching legs after your reps.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Rack the bar at shoulder height and step under so it rests on the front of your shoulders, close to your throat.
Hold it with a grip that lets your elbows point forward and up.
Walk it out and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Take a breath, brace and squat down between your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Stop when your hips are below your knees or your back starts to round, then stand up.
Breathe out at the top and keep your elbows lifted the whole set.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the bar at upper-chest height, step under it and rest it on the front of your shoulders.
Hold the bar with your fingertips just outside your shoulders and push your elbows forward and up.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of the bar, then unhook it.
Breathe in, brace your stomach and sit straight down between your heels, keeping elbows high.
Go as low as you can with a straight back, then breathe out and drive up through your whole foot.
Rehook the bar when your set is done.

exercises.name: Full Maltese
instructions: Hold rings or parallettes with your arms locked straight and positioned far wider than your shoulders.
Tighten your abs, glutes and legs so your body is one rigid line.
Lean forward and lift your legs together as you lower your chest toward hand height.
Hold your body flat and level with your hands while breathing steadily.
Lower out of the hold with control. Build up through the straddle version first.

exercises.name: Full Planche
instructions: Set your hands on the floor or parallettes about shoulder-width apart, elbows locked.
Push the floor away so your upper back rounds slightly, and tighten your whole body.
Lean forward until your shoulders are well in front of your hands.
Lift your legs together behind you until your body forms one straight line parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your abs, glutes and legs to keep the line, hold while breathing steadily, then lower slowly. Build up through the tuck and straddle versions first.

exercises.name: Full Planche Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the floor or on low parallettes about shoulder-width apart, fingers turned slightly out.
Lean your shoulders well forward past your hands and lift both feet off the floor, holding your body straight and level.
Keep your arms locked, your shoulder blades spread apart and your glutes and legs squeezed.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your straight body toward the floor, keeping it horizontal.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms without letting your hips drop.
Only attempt this after mastering easier planche holds such as the tuck and straddle planche.

exercises.name: Gironda Sternum Chin
instructions: Hang from a bar with a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Start pulling up while arching your upper back and leaning your head and shoulders back.
Keep pulling until your lower chest touches the bar, with your body close to horizontal at the top.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full hang.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat close to your glutes, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently toward the floor and tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and push through your heels to lift your hips a few centimeters off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for two seconds without arching your back.
Breathe in and lower your hips slowly to the floor.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and roll a padded barbell up over your hips.
Lie back, bend your knees and plant your feet flat, hip-width apart, close to your glutes.
Hold the bar with both hands to keep it from rolling.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Pause and squeeze your glutes, then lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms by your sides.
Breathe out and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high and level, lift your right foot a few centimeters off the floor, knee still bent.
Put it down, then lift the left foot.
Keep alternating slowly, breathing steadily and not letting the hips drop or twist.
Lower your hips to the floor when the set is done.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a bench, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Rest your arms on the floor by your sides.
Brace your stomach and breathe out as you press your heels into the bench to lift your hips.
Rise until your knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and lower your hips slowly until they almost touch the floor.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Fasten an ankle strap to a low pulley and around one ankle, then face the machine.
Hold the frame with both hands and step back until the cable is slightly tight.
Stand on the other leg with a soft knee and lean forward a little, keeping your core tight.
Push the strapped leg straight back by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back.
Pause at the top, then let the leg return forward slowly.
Breathe out as you kick back; switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
instructions: Set the pad so it sits behind your working leg, just above the knee or at the back of the thigh.
Stand facing the machine, hold the handles and keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Brace your stomach and lean your chest forward a little.
Breathe out and push the lever back with your working leg by squeezing the glute.
Stop when your hip is fully open without arching your lower back.
Let the lever come forward slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: Set the foot plate so your knees rest just behind the pad and lock your ankles under the rollers.
Start with your body horizontal and straight from head to knees, hands crossed on your chest.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe out as you pull with your hamstrings, bending your knees to raise your body.
Keep your hips straight; do not bend at the waist.
Stop when your body is upright, then breathe in and lower slowly back to horizontal.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically by the top end with both hands against your chest.
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder-width and toes slightly out.
Breathe in and sit down between your heels, keeping your elbows pointing down and chest up.
Let your elbows brush the insides of your knees at the bottom.
Breathe out and push through your whole foot to stand tall.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by both sides of the handle at chest height, elbows pointing down.
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out a little.
Breathe in and sit down between your heels, keeping your chest up.
At the bottom, let your elbows brush the inside of your knees and push your knees out.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up tall.
Breathe out as you stand.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a light bar on your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees softly bent.
Brace your core and keep your back flat from head to hips.
Push your hips straight back and let your chest lower toward the floor.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings or your torso is close to level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand up.
Breathe in on the way down and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Gorilla Chin
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width and your legs straight.
Brace your abs and pull your chest toward the bar while drawing your knees up to your chest.
Get your chin over the bar with your knees tucked high.
Lower your body and your legs together slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging; keep each rep strict.

exercises.name: Groin Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, put the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open to the sides.
Place your fingertips by your ears or cross your arms on your chest.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up off the floor, ribs toward hips.
Keep your knees relaxed and open while you crunch.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Hack Calf Raise
instructions: Step into the hack squat machine facing the backrest or facing away, as your machine allows, and set your shoulders under the pads.
Place the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform with heels off.
Stand up to unrack the weight and release the safety handles.
Lower your heels for a full calf stretch, keeping knees soft and still.
Breathe out and rise onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, and re-engage the safety handles when done.

exercises.name: Hack One Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Set up in the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads.
Place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the platform and lift the other foot behind it.
Unrack the weight with a light load and release the safety handles.
Lower your heel for a full stretch, keeping the knee soft.
Breathe out and drive up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, rack the weight and switch legs.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Place the bar on the floor and stand in front of it with your heels a few centimeters away.
Squat down, reach behind you and grip the bar with your palms facing back, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your chest, flatten your back and take a breath.
Drive through your feet and stand up, sliding the bar up the backs of your legs.
Pause tall at the top, then bend your knees and lower the bar along the same path.
Breathe out as you reach the top.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
instructions: Step into the machine with your back flat on the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles and stand tall.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Keep your back and hips against the pad, then drive up through your feet.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you push; re-engage the safeties at the end.

exercises.name: Half Knee Bends
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front for balance.
Push your hips back slightly and bend your knees to about halfway down.
Keep your heels on the floor, chest up, and knees in line with your toes.
Straighten your legs to stand back up without locking the knees.
Move in a steady rhythm, breathing in on the way down and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Half Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, arms straight and reaching toward your knees.
Tighten your abs and tuck your chin slightly.
Breathe out and curl up until your upper body is about halfway to upright.
Pause for a second, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Breathe in and roll back down slowly.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows tucked and your wrists straight.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up, keeping the palms facing each other.
Squeeze at the top near shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and step your right foot about half a step forward.
Straighten the right leg and lift its toes so only the heel is on the floor.
Bend your left knee a little and put your hands on your hips or left thigh.
Keep your back flat and push your hips back until you feel the stretch behind the right thigh.
Breathe slowly, hold for about 30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Hands Bike
instructions: Sit or stand facing the machine and adjust it so the center of the handles is level with your shoulders.
Grip the handles and sit tall with your feet flat and your stomach lightly braced.
Turn the handles in smooth circles, pushing away and pulling back evenly with each arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down, and breathe steadily.
Start at an easy pace for a few minutes, then raise the resistance or speed for your workout.
Switch the turning direction partway through to work the muscles differently.

exercises.name: Hands Clasped Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and clasp your hands together in front of you.
Breathe in and lift your clasped hands overhead.
Breathe out and lean to one side, then bend forward and bring your hands down toward your toes.
Keep the circle going, sweeping across your feet to the other side.
Breathe in and rise up that side until your hands are back overhead.
Do several circles, then reverse the direction.

exercises.name: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and interlace your fingers behind your lower back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Breathe out and fold forward from the hips, letting your clasped hands lift up and over toward your head.
Draw a slow circle with your upper body and hands from one side to the other at the bottom.
Breathe in and roll back up to standing, lowering the hands behind you.

exercises.name: Handstand
instructions: Place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, about a hand's length from a wall if you are learning.
Kick one leg up, followed by the other, until your body is upside down and your legs come together.
Push the floor away so your arms are straight and your shoulders are by your ears.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes to keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and balance by pressing through your fingers, then step down one leg at a time.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, a hand's length from a wall, and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Tighten your stomach and glutes and keep your body straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your head slowly toward the floor, elbows angled slightly forward.
Stop when your head lightly touches the floor or a cushion.
Breathe out and press back up until your arms are straight.
Come down one leg at a time when you finish.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with a grip just outside your legs.
Hinge so the bar slides to just above your knees, back flat.
Extend your hips and knees explosively, shrug, and pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away and your arms straight.
Tighten your abs and settle any swinging before you begin.
Breathe out and raise your knees until your thighs are level with the floor.
Continue by tilting your hips up so your knees travel toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly back to a straight hang without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your legs together.
Pull your shoulders down slightly so you are not hanging loosely.
Breathe out and raise your legs in front of you, curling your hips up at the top.
Lower your legs slowly until they are straight below you.
Stop any swing before the next rep.

exercises.name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Draw your shoulders slightly down and keep your legs still so you are not swinging.
Breathe out and lift your knees up and to one side, rotating your hips so your knees aim at one shoulder.
Lower your legs slowly back to the center under control.
Raise to the other side on the next rep, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Hanging Pike
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your legs straight and together.
Brace your abs and press the bar down slightly so your shoulders engage.
Breathe out and lift your straight legs up, folding at the hips until your feet touch or near the bar.
Lower your legs slowly back down under full control.
Keep your knees straight throughout; bend them slightly only if your hamstrings are tight.

exercises.name: Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your legs straight and together.
Raise your straight legs until they are about level with your hips.
From there, breathe out and curl your pelvis up, lifting your hips and pushing your feet a little higher.
Uncurl your hips first, then lower your legs slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, legs straight and together.
Brace your abs and keep your knees locked.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold briefly, then lower slowly without letting your body swing.

exercises.name: Hanging Straight Twisting Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your legs straight and together.
Brace your abs to stop any swinging.
Breathe out and raise your straight legs up and toward your right side, rotating your hips.
Lower slowly back to the center.
Repeat toward your left side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Heel Push Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your kicking knee up to chest height.
Pull your toes back so the heel leads.
Drive the heel straight forward, pushing your hips into the kick.
Breathe out as you push, then pull the knee back and place the foot down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: High Knee Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Walk your feet back slightly so your body leans forward in a straight line.
Drive your right knee up toward your chest, then quickly switch to the left.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep alternating as fast as you can.
Keep your core tight, your back straight, and breathe quickly but steadily.

exercises.name: High Row (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your chest against the pad and adjust the seat so the handles are above head height.
Reach up and grab the handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles down and back, bringing your elbows past your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly back up.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
instructions: Set the machine so the pads rest on the outside of your knees with your legs together.
Sit tall with your back against the pad and hold the handles.
Push your knees outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause and squeeze the sides of your hips.
Let the pads come back together slowly without letting the weights touch.
Breathe out as you push out and in as you return.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Cable)
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and fasten it around the ankle nearest the machine.
Stand side-on to the machine and step away until the cable is tight with your strapped leg slightly out to the side.
Hold the machine or a rail for balance and stand tall with your core tight.
Pull the strapped leg in and across in front of your standing leg, keeping it straight.
Pause briefly, then let the leg return out to the side slowly.
Breathe out as you pull in; finish your reps, then turn around for the other leg.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
instructions: Set the machine so your legs start open at a comfortable stretch with the pads on the inside of your knees.
Sit tall with your back against the pad and hold the handles.
Squeeze your knees together until the pads meet or nearly meet.
Pause and squeeze your inner thighs.
Let your legs open slowly back to the start, controlling the weight.
Breathe out as you squeeze and in as you open.

exercises.name: Hip Raise (bent Knee)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat near your hips and arms by your sides.
Flatten your lower back into the floor by tightening your abs.
Breathe out and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Keep your ribs down; do not arch your lower back at the top.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and roll a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat about hip-width apart, close enough that your shins are vertical at the top.
Tuck your chin, brace, and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top without arching your lower back, then lower your hips under control.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back on the pad and the hip belt or pad across your hips.
Set your feet flat on the platform so your shins are vertical when your hips are up.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your thighs line up with your body.
Hold the squeeze for a moment, then lower until the weight is almost back on its rest.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a bench beside the Smith machine, sit on the floor with your upper back against the bench and the bar padded across your hips.
Plant your feet flat about shoulder width apart, knees bent, and hold the bar with both hands.
Brace your abs, tuck your chin slightly, and unhook the bar.
Breathe out and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs and torso are level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips slowly.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs a few centimetres off it.
Keep your arms by your ears and your legs together; bend your knees to make it easier.
Hold for time without letting your lower back lift.

exercises.name: Hug Knees To Chest
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your legs straight.
Bend both knees and bring them up toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins or hold behind your knees.
Pull your knees gently closer to your chest while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting your lower back sink into the floor.
Release your legs slowly back to the mat.

exercises.name: Hyght Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand held over your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle for the whole set.
Breathe in and open your arms out to the sides until the dumbbells are about level with the bench.
Breathe out and bring the dumbbells back up in a wide arc as if hugging a large barrel.
Stop just before the dumbbells touch to keep tension on your chest.

exercises.name: Hyperextension (on Bench)
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the end and your upper body hanging off.
Have a partner hold your ankles, or hook your feet under something stable.
Cross your arms over your chest and let your upper body lower toward the floor.
Lift your upper body until it is in line with your legs, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly back down without jerking.
Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Impossible Dips
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with your arms straight and your body upright.
Bend your elbows and lower yourself slowly, letting your elbows move back until your forearms lie along the bars.
Pause briefly with your weight on your forearms and your stomach tight.
Breathe out and press your palms into the bars to straighten your elbows and lift back to straight arms.
Lean slightly forward as you press to keep your balance over your hands.

exercises.name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet, bending your knees only as much as you need.
Walk your hands forward one at a time until you reach a high plank with your body straight.
Hold the plank briefly with your abs tight and hips level.
Keeping your legs as straight as you can, walk your feet in toward your hands, then roll up to standing.

exercises.name: Inchworm (Traveling)
instructions: Stand at one end of a clear space with your feet hip-width apart.
Fold forward, place your hands on the floor and walk them out until you reach a high plank.
Hold the plank for a moment with your abs tight and your hips level.
With your legs as straight as possible, take small steps to walk your feet up toward your hands.
Without standing up, walk your hands out again and keep traveling forward for the set distance.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 to 45 degrees and sit back with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, squeeze your shoulder blades back and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, just under the collarbone, with control.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are extended above your shoulders.
Breathe in on the way down, breathe out as you press, and keep your back on the pad.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Set an incline bench to 30 to 45 degrees, sit back and kick the dumbbells up to the sides of your upper chest.
Press them up until your arms are straight above your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until they are level with your upper chest.
Drive them back up without clanging them together at the top.
Keep your back on the pad and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set an incline bench at 30 to 45 degrees under the Smith bar so the bar lines up with your upper chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unhook it.
Lower the bar slowly to just below your collarbone.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Breathe out as you press and keep your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Put an incline bench between two low pulleys, grab the handles and lie back with your feet on the floor.
Raise your hands above your upper chest, palms facing in and elbows softly bent.
Let your arms open slowly out to the sides until your hands are about level with your chest.
Hug the handles back up and together, keeping the same elbow angle throughout.
Inhale while opening and exhale while closing.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold the dumbbells above your upper chest, palms facing each other.
Set a slight bend in your elbows and lock that angle in.
Let the dumbbells travel apart in a wide arc until your chest feels stretched.
Bring them back together over your upper chest by squeezing your pecs.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you lift; avoid going so deep that your shoulders hurt.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest and sit with your back flat on the pad.
Grip the handles, keep your feet flat and your shoulder blades pulled back.
Breathe out and press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Breathe in and let the handles come back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Do not let the weight stack touch down between reps.

exercises.name: Incline Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart or a little narrower on the edge of a bench or sturdy box.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Breathe in and lower your chest to the edge, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line; use a higher surface to make it easier.

exercises.name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight and palms forward.
Breathe out and curl the right dumbbell up while the left arm stays down.
Squeeze at the top, then breathe in and lower it slowly to full stretch.
Curl the left dumbbell the same way.
Keep alternating, keeping your head and back against the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Leg Hip Raise (leg Straight)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your head at the top and hold the bench behind your head.
Keep your legs straight and together, just off the pad.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they point up, then curl your hips off the bench.
Lower your hips first, then your legs, slowly.
Stop before your legs rest on the bench so your abs stay working.

exercises.name: Incline Push Up Depth Jump
instructions: Set up in a push-up position with your hands on a low box or step and your body straight.
Push explosively off the box so your hands leave it and move out to land on the floor on either side.
Land with soft elbows and let your chest sink toward the floor to absorb the impact.
Immediately push hard off the floor to bring your hands back up onto the box.
Keep your stomach braced so your hips stay in line, and breathe out sharply on each push.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a sturdy bench a little wider than your shoulders and walk your feet back.
Make a straight line from head to heels and tighten your stomach.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the bench.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Breathe in going down and out going up; use a lower surface as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (on Box)
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a stable box or bench, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the box.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees and your stomach tight.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Use a lower box as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Incline Reverse Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on a bench about shoulder-width apart with your fingers pointing toward your feet.
Walk your feet back into a straight plank with your body angled up.
Lower your chest toward the bench, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press back up to straight arms.
Exhale as you press and keep your wrists comfortable; widen the hands slightly if they strain.

exercises.name: Incline Scapula Push Up
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box at shoulder-width and walk your feet back into an inclined plank with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line and your elbows locked but not hyperextended.
Breathe in and let your chest sink between your shoulders so your shoulder blades come together.
Breathe out and push the bench away, spreading your shoulder blades apart and rounding your upper back slightly.
Move slowly and keep your arms straight throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Step onto the treadmill and start walking at a slow speed on a flat setting.
Raise the incline gradually to a level that makes you breathe harder.
Stand tall, lean only slightly forward from the ankles, and take full steps.
Let your arms swing naturally instead of holding the rails.
Keep a steady pace for your planned time, then lower the incline and speed to cool down.

exercises.name: Incline Twisting Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on a slanted sit-up bench with your feet hooked under the rollers and your head at the low end.
Cross your arms on your chest or put your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and sit up, turning as you rise so your right shoulder heads toward your left knee.
Turn back to center and lower slowly.
Alternate the direction of the twist each rep.

exercises.name: Intermediate Hip Flexor And Quad Stretch
instructions: Loop a rope or strap around your right ankle and kneel on your right knee on a soft surface, left foot flat in front.
Hold the rope over your right shoulder with your right hand.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your right glute to start the stretch at the front of the hip.
Gently pull the rope to bring your right heel toward your glutes.
Keep your chest up and hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release the rope slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Inverse Leg Curl (bench Support)
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your heels hooked under a secure bench or have the bench held steady.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, with your hips pushed forward and glutes squeezed.
Slowly lean forward from the knees, resisting with your hamstrings as long as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands when you can no longer control the descent.
Push lightly off the floor and pull with your hamstrings to return to upright kneeling.
Breathe out as you pull back up; keep your hips from bending throughout.

exercises.name: Inverse Leg Curl (on Pull-Up Cable Machine)
instructions: Kneel on the seat of the station facing away from the machine, with your ankles hooked under the leg pad.
Keep a straight line from your knees to your head and cross your arms or hold them ready in front.
Breathe in and slowly lean forward from the knees, fighting the fall with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control, then catch yourself with your hands if needed.
Pull with your hamstrings, using a small push from the hands if needed, to return upright while breathing out.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at about hip height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders, with straight arms.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips so your body is one straight line resting on your heels.
Pull your chest to the bar, driving your elbows back.
Lower slowly to straight arms without letting your hips sag.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Inverted Row (Bent Knees, Shoulder Blade Squeeze)
instructions: Set a bar about waist height in a rack or smith machine.
Lie underneath and grab the bar with an overhand grip a bit wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and plant your feet flat, lifting your hips so your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Inverted Row Bent Knees
instructions: Set a bar in a rack or Smith machine at about waist height and lie under it.
Grip the bar overhand slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees, plant your feet and lift your hips so your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Breathe out and pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to straight arms without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Inverted Row On Bench
instructions: Lie on your back under a solid flat bench that will not tip.
Grip the long edges of the bench with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees, feet flat, and lift your hips so your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Breathe out and pull your chest up toward the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Inverted Row With Straps
instructions: Hang the straps from a high anchor and hold one handle in each hand.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight and your body is at an angle.
Brace your stomach and glutes so your body stays straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest up to your hands, turning your palms in and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight; walk your feet further forward to make it harder.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Iron Cross Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower that leg across your body toward the opposite hand, letting your hips turn.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and go only as far as is comfortable.
Hold briefly while breathing out, then bring the leg back up and down to the start.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest and rest your chest on the pad.
Hold one handle with your arm straight; you can brace your free hand on the machine.
Row the handle back until your elbow passes your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, keeping your chest on the pad.
Return slowly to straight, finish your reps, then switch arms.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring your palms together in front of your chest, elbows out to the sides.
Keep your shoulders down and your wrists straight.
Press your palms into each other as hard as you can, feeling your chest tighten.
Hold the squeeze for 10 to 20 seconds while breathing steadily; do not hold your breath.
Relax for a few seconds, then repeat.

exercises.name: Isometric Wipers
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands set much wider than your shoulders.
Lower halfway down and hold that height.
Shift your body toward one hand, bending that elbow while the other arm straightens.
Slide slowly across to the other hand without rising up, then back again.
Keep your hips level and your stomach tight, and breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width with straight arms over your chest.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, letting the bar travel down and slightly toward your chin.
Let your elbows drift forward toward your feet so your forearms end up resting near your upper arms.
Stop a few centimeters above your chin and throat.
Breathe out and press back up along the same path until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Jack Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line, then jump your feet back in toward your hands.
Stand up and go straight into one jumping jack, opening your feet and swinging your arms overhead.
Bring your feet and arms back together and drop into the next rep.
Land softly and breathe steadily; slow down if your plank starts to sag.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit-Up
instructions: Lie flat with your legs straight and your arms stretched overhead.
Brace your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Breathe out and lift your arms and legs together, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Balance on your hips for a moment at the top.
Lower your arms and legs slowly at the same time.

exercises.name: Janda Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat; a partner can hold the backs of your ankles, or hook your heels against a fixed low support.
Pull your heels down and back into the floor and keep that pressure the whole rep.
Cross your arms on your chest, breathe out and curl up very slowly.
Rise only as far as you can while keeping your heels pressing down.
Lower slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: Jump Box Over
instructions: Stand next to a low, sturdy box with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto the box, landing softly with both feet flat and knees bent.
Step or hop down on the far side, landing gently.
Turn around and repeat in the other direction, breathing out on each jump.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Pick a rope length where the handles reach your armpits when you stand on its middle.
Hold the handles at hip height with elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your whole arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your knees slightly bent, your body tall, and your breathing relaxed.
Start with short rounds and rest between them as needed.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Squat down while swinging your arms back behind you.
Swing your arms forward and up as you jump as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees, hips back and knees in line with your toes.
Reset your stance and repeat.
Breathe out as you jump and in as you land and lower.

exercises.name: Jump Squat (Hands on Hips)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Squat down until your thighs are close to parallel, chest up.
Jump straight up as high as you can, using only your legs.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, then let your heels settle and bend your knees.
Flow straight into the next squat and jump without pausing.
Breathe out on each jump and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out a little wider than your shoulders while swinging your arms out and up overhead.
Land lightly on the balls of your feet with soft knees.
Jump your feet back together and lower your arms to your sides.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm and breathe evenly throughout.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Advanced Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and turn both feet about 45 degrees away from that arm.
Lock your eyes on the kettlebell and keep the arm straight and vertical.
Push your hips toward the kettlebell side and fold sideways, sliding your free hand down the inside of your front leg to the floor.
Keep the overhead arm stacked over your shoulder as you go down.
Drive back up to standing by squeezing your hips and side, then finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at arm's length in front of your thigh.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back so the bell lowers to just above your knee.
Drive your hips forward hard and let the bell rise close to your body.
Pull your elbow down and rotate your hand so the bell settles softly against your forearm at shoulder height.
Lower the bell back to the hang, switch hands at the bottom, and repeat on the other side.
Breathe out on each drive and keep your core tight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position so they rest on the outside of your forearms at shoulder height.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press one kettlebell straight up until your arm is straight, wrist firm.
Lower it back to the rack under control.
Press the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Press On Floor
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, holding a kettlebell in each hand with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press one kettlebell straight up until that arm is fully extended.
Lower it back down until your elbow touches the floor.
Press the other kettlebell up, and keep alternating sides.
Keep your wrists straight with the bell resting on the back of your forearm, and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Renegade Row
instructions: Place two kettlebells shoulder-width apart and hold their handles in a push-up position.
Spread your feet wider than hip-width for balance and brace your stomach and glutes.
Push one hand into the floor and row the other kettlebell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level and avoid turning your body toward the lifting side.
Set the kettlebell down with control and row with the other arm.
Breathe out on each row and in as you set it down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand and hinge forward with soft knees and a flat back.
Let both kettlebells hang under your shoulders.
Row one kettlebell to your ribs while the other stays down.
Lower it slowly, then row the other side.
Keep your torso still and your hips level the whole time.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand in front of your shoulders, palms facing you and elbows in front.
Stand tall with your stomach braced.
Breathe out and press up while turning your palms forward and opening your elbows out.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Breathe in and reverse the turn as you lower to the start.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Bent Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and turn your feet about 45 degrees away from that side.
Rest the elbow against your side so the bell sits on your forearm.
Lean your body sideways and forward away from the bell, letting your arm straighten under it as your torso goes down.
Once your arm is locked straight, keep your eyes on the bell and stand back up under it.
Lower the bell to your shoulder with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Clean From The Hang Position
aliases: bottoms up clean from the hang position
kb bottoms up clean from the hang position
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell in one hand hanging between your legs, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back to load the hang position.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Squeeze the handle hard and catch the bell upside down in front of your shoulder, elbow tucked and forearm vertical.
Hold it steady for a moment, then lower it back to the hang with control; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Double Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell in each hand hanging in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
