Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull one bell up close to your body, rotating your hand so the bell rests on the back of your forearm at your shoulder.
Keep the other bell hanging still.
Lower the racked bell back to the hang with control, then clean the other one.
Keep alternating sides, breathing out on each drive.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Double Jerk
instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, keeping your upper body upright.
Drive up hard through your legs to launch the kettlebells upward.
As they rise, dip under them a second time to lock your arms out.
Stand up fully with the kettlebells overhead, then lower them to the rack with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Double Push Press
instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position with feet hip-width apart.
Brace your stomach and dip a few centimeters by bending your knees, chest up.
Drive through your legs and use that push to press the kettlebells overhead.
Finish with your arms straight and legs straight.
Lower the kettlebells to the rack under control and reset.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Double Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than hip-width with two kettlebells on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and swing both kettlebells back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the kettlebells up close to your body.
Punch your hands up so the kettlebells turn over softly onto your forearms as your arms lock overhead.
Lower them back down in front of you and into the next swing with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Double Windmill
instructions: Hold one kettlebell locked out overhead and another hanging in your other hand.
Turn your feet about 45 degrees away from the overhead arm.
Watch the top bell, push your hips toward it, and fold sideways to lower the bottom bell along the inside of your front leg.
Go as low as you can with a long spine and a straight overhead arm.
Stand back up with control, finish your reps, then switch the bells to the other side.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Extended Range One Arm Press On Floor
aliases: extended range one arm press on floor
kb extended range one arm press on floor
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and hold one kettlebell at your chest, upper arm on the floor.
Press the kettlebell straight up until your elbow is locked.
At the top, reach the kettlebell further toward the ceiling so your shoulder lifts slightly off the floor.
Let the shoulder settle back down, then lower the kettlebell until your elbow touches the floor.
Finish the set, switch arms, and breathe out as you press and reach.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure 8
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders, sit your hips back into a half squat and keep your back flat.
Hold a kettlebell in your right hand in front of you.
Pass the bell back between your legs to your left hand, which reaches around from behind your left leg.
Bring it forward around the left leg, then pass it back through the middle to your right hand behind the right leg.
Keep tracing the figure eight smoothly, chest up and abs braced.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
instructions: Clean the kettlebells to your chest so each rests on the back of your forearm, wrists straight and elbows tucked in.
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Breathe in, brace and squat down between your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Go as deep as you can while your heels stay down and your back stays flat.
Drive up through your feet to standing.
Breathe out at the top and keep the bells close to your body.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell in one hand, arm straight, and hinge so the bell hangs just above your knees.
Keep your back flat and your shoulder pulled down.
Drive your hips forward quickly so the bell floats up close to your body.
As it rises, keep your elbow close and rotate your hand around the handle so the bell lands softly on the back of your forearm.
Finish standing tall with the bell at your chest, wrist straight, then let it drop back to the hang and hinge.
Breathe out as your hips snap forward; switch hands after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass Through
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until your back knee is just above the floor.
At the bottom, pass the kettlebell under your front thigh to your other hand.
Push through the front heel and step back to standing.
Lunge with the other leg and pass the bell back under that thigh.
Keep your chest up and your core tight, breathing out as you rise.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Clean And Jerk
aliases: kb one arm clean and jerk
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell, hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to bring it up into the rack at your shoulder.
Dip slightly at the knees and drive up hard to launch the kettlebell upward.
Drop under it with a second small dip to lock your arm out, then stand tall.
Lower it to the rack and then back between your legs, and switch hands after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell in one hand with the handle in your palm and the bell resting on the back of your forearm.
Rest your upper arm on the floor at about 45 degrees from your body.
Breathe out and press the kettlebell straight up until your arm is locked out over your shoulder.
Keep your wrist straight and your knuckles pointing to the ceiling.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your upper arm touches the floor lightly.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Jerk
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet hip-width apart.
Dip slightly by bending your knees, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your legs to launch the kettlebell.
Bend your knees again to drop under it and lock your arm out overhead.
Stand tall, then lower the kettlebell back to the rack and switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Military Press To The Side
aliases: one arm military press to the side
kb one arm military press to the side
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your stomach and keep your hips square.
Breathe out and press the kettlebell up while bending your upper body a little to the opposite side.
Finish with your arm straight and your eyes on the kettlebell.
Breathe in, straighten up as you lower it to the rack, and switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Push Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet hip-width apart.
Brace your stomach and dip a little at the knees, keeping your chest up.
Drive through your legs and press the kettlebell overhead in one smooth movement.
Finish with your arm and legs straight.
Lower the kettlebell to the rack under control, and switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Arm Row
instructions: Stand in a split stance and rest your free hand on a bench or your front thigh.
Hold the kettlebell in your other hand, arm hanging straight below your shoulder.
Keep your back flat and your stomach braced.
Row the kettlebell to your hip, elbow brushing past your side.
Lower slowly to a full stretch, then switch sides after your set.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Carry
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and press it overhead until your arm is straight, with the bell resting on the back of your forearm.
Stand tall with your ribs down, stomach braced and wrist straight.
Walk forward with slow, even steps, keeping the kettlebell stacked over your shoulder.
Breathe steadily and keep your hips level.
After the set distance, lower the kettlebell with control and switch arms.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pirate Supper Legs
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width and hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands, arms straight down in front of you.
Brace your stomach and keep your knees slightly bent.
Swing the kettlebell up in an arc to one side until it reaches about head height, letting your body turn a little.
Let it swing back down past your hips and up to the other side.
Keep your arms straight and breathe steadily as you continue side to side.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out in front of you, just off the floor.
Push the kettlebell slightly forward and slowly squat down on the standing leg as low as you can control.
Keep your heel flat, your knee over your toes and the free leg off the floor.
Drive through the standing foot to rise back up, staying balanced.
Breathe out as you stand; use a box to limit depth until you can do the full range.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Plyo Push-Up
instructions: Set a kettlebell on the floor and get into a push-up position with one hand on its handle and the other on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body straight.
Push up explosively so both hands leave their spots, and move sideways over the kettlebell.
Land with the opposite hand on the handle and the other on the floor, absorbing the landing with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep in the other direction, breathing out on each push.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seated Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with feet flat and hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder.
Brace your stomach and keep your back straight.
Breathe out and press the kettlebell straight up until your arm is straight.
Keep your body from leaning to the side.
Breathe in and lower it to the rack slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seated Two Arm Military Press
aliases: kb seated two arm military press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with feet flat and hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and keep your back straight.
Breathe out and press both kettlebells straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid leaning back.
Breathe in and lower them slowly to the rack.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand, one in the rack position and the other pressed overhead.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and your stomach braced.
Lower the top kettlebell while pressing the bottom one up at the same time.
Pass the two at about head height and keep the movement smooth.
Keep alternating, breathing steadily and staying upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
instructions: Stand with your feet wide, toes turned out, and a kettlebell on the floor between them.
Squat down with a flat back and grab the handle with both hands.
Drive through your heels and stand up fast, pushing your hips forward.
As you rise, pull the kettlebell up close to your body, elbows high and out, until the handle is near your chest.
Lower it under control back to the floor along the same path.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and the kettlebell on the floor a step in front of you.
Hinge down, grip the handle with both hands and tilt the bell back toward you.
Hike it back between your legs, keeping your back flat and the bell high in your groin area.
Drive your hips forward hard and squeeze your glutes so the bell floats up to about chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again as your forearms meet your thighs, then go straight into the next swing.
Breathe out sharply at the top of each swing; your arms guide the bell, they do not lift it.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Two Arm Clean
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than hip-width and grip one kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and swing it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the kettlebell up close to your body, elbows high.
Turn your hands around the handle so it lands softly at your chest, held by the sides of the handle.
Lower it back between your legs with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Two Arm Military Press
instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes and lock your knees softly.
Breathe out and press both kettlebells straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists straight and the bells close to your head at the top.
Breathe in and lower them slowly to the rack.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Two Arm Row
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell on each side of your feet.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees and a flat back, and grab the handles.
Pull both kettlebells toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and breathe out.
Lower them slowly without letting your back round.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and turn your feet about 45 degrees away from it.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your overhead arm straight.
Shift your hips toward the bell side and hinge sideways, reaching your free hand down your front leg toward your foot.
Lower only as far as you can with a long, straight spine.
Rise back up by driving your hips forward, then switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: Kick Out Sit
instructions: Start on your hands and feet with your knees hovering a few centimeters off the floor, back flat.
Lift one hand and the opposite foot off the floor.
Rotate your hips and kick that leg through under your body toward the lifted hand's side, straightening it out in front.
Lower your hips toward the floor so you are briefly in a side sitting position, supported on one hand and one foot.
Pull the leg back through and return to the hands-and-feet start.
Repeat to the other side, breathing out as you kick through.

exercises.name: Kipping Muscle Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with a false or regular overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Build a controlled swing by pushing your chest forward, then kicking your legs forward.
At the front of the swing, snap your hips up and pull the bar hard toward your hips.
As your body rises, quickly lean your chest over the bar and turn your elbows up.
Press down until your arms are straight above the bar.
Lower back to a hang with control and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Knee Touch Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, palms resting on the front of your thighs.
Tighten your abs and tuck your chin slightly.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders off the floor, sliding your hands up until your fingertips touch your knees.
Hold the squeeze for a moment.
Breathe in and lower slowly, sliding your hands back down.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump Squat
instructions: Kneel on a soft mat with your knees hip-width apart and toes tucked under, a light barbell on your upper back.
Hold the bar tight to your back and sit your hips slightly back toward your heels.
Swing your hips forward explosively to jump up off your knees.
Pull your feet under you and land flat-footed in a squat, knees in line with your toes.
Stand up from the squat, then carefully return to kneeling for the next rep.
Breathe out as you jump; master it with no weight before using a bar.

exercises.name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel on all fours on a mat.
Walk your hands forward and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Keep your arms straight and press your palms into the floor.
Let your chest sink down until you feel the stretch along your sides.
Walk both hands to one side to deepen the stretch on the opposite side, then switch.
Hold each position for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: Kneeling Plank Tap Shoulder
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your hands under your shoulders, then walk your knees back until your body is straight from head to knees.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes so your hips do not sag.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, keeping your hips square to the floor.
Place the hand back down and tap with the other hand.
Keep alternating slowly, breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push-Up
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Tighten your stomach and glutes so your hips do not bend.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Korean Dips
instructions: Stand with your back to a straight bar at about hip height and grip it behind you with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Press up onto straight arms with your feet off the floor and the bar behind your hips.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, letting your body move forward and down while the bar stays behind you.
Lower until the bar is near your mid-back or you reach your comfortable shoulder range.
Breathe out and press back up and slightly backward to straight arms.
Build up slowly; stop at any pinching pain in the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: L-Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Lift your straight legs until they are level with the floor, making an L shape.
Keeping your legs up, breathe out and pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang while your legs stay level.
Bend your knees if you cannot keep your legs straight.

exercises.name: L-Sit
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight together and your hands flat beside your hips.
Lock your elbows and press down through your palms, pushing your shoulders down away from your ears.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips and legs off the floor, keeping your knees straight.
Hold your legs level with the floor and your toes pointed, breathing steadily.
Lower with control. If your hands are too low to lift off, use parallettes or yoga blocks, or bend your knees.

exercises.name: Landmine 180
instructions: Set one end of a barbell in a landmine holder or a corner and stand facing the other end.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands at chest height, arms nearly straight, feet wider than your shoulders.
Rotate your shoulders and hips together to bring the bar down in an arc toward your right hip, pivoting your left foot.
Brace and reverse the motion, swinging the bar up and over to your left hip.
Keep your arms long and let your trunk, not your arms, drive the arc.

exercises.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or a corner and stand side-on to it.
Bend down and grip the free end with the hand farther from the bar, holding it in front of your opposite hip.
Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbow and your stomach braced.
Breathe out and raise the bar end up and out to the side until your arm reaches shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly across your body, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine base or a corner and load the other end.
Hold the loaded end at shoulder height with one or both hands, standing in a split or square stance.
Press the bar up and forward along its arc until your arm is straight, letting your shoulder blade move with it.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs locked under the pads.
Take the long bar with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight and your lats stretch.
Breathe out as you pull and in as the bar goes up.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad so you are locked in and the handles are just within reach.
Grab the handles with your arms straight and your chest up.
Pull the handles down in front of you until they reach shoulder level.
Squeeze your lats and shoulder blades at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and take the handle in the hand farther from the machine.
Hold the machine with your other hand, stand tall and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and raise the handle out to the side until your arm reaches shoulder height.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow and avoid leaning away to swing it up.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and a slight bend in your elbows.
Brace your stomach and relax your neck.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders down.
Breathe in and lower slowly, taking about two seconds.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot points, then sit with your chest against the pad if there is one.
Place your arms against the pads with your elbows slightly bent and hold the handles lightly.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides by pushing through your elbows until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly without shrugging.
Breathe in and lower slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

exercises.name: Lean Planche
instructions: Get into a high plank with your hands about shoulder-width apart and fingers turned slightly out.
Lock your elbows and push the floor away so your upper back rounds slightly.
Shift your weight forward onto your toes until your shoulders are in front of your hands.
Keep your body straight with abs and glutes tight, holding as far forward as you can control while breathing steadily.
Shift back to a normal plank to rest, and lean a little farther as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Left Hook (boxing)
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your left foot forward, knees soft and both hands up guarding your face.
Bend your left elbow to about 90 degrees and lift it to shoulder height.
Turn your left foot, hips and shoulders together to swing the fist in a tight arc across your body.
Breathe out sharply as the punch lands, keeping your right hand by your chin.
Bring the left hand straight back to guard and reset your stance.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad rests on the front of your lower shins.
Sit back firmly and hold the side handles.
Straighten your legs until your knees are fully extended, squeezing your thighs.
Pause for a second at the top without locking your knees hard.
Lower the pad slowly to about a 90-degree knee bend.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back and hips flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Push the platform up, release the safety handles and hold the side grips.
Bend your knees and lower the platform until your knees are near your chest, without your lower back lifting off the pad.
Press through your whole foot to push the platform back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you press; lock the safeties when finished.

exercises.name: Leg Pull In Flat Bench
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench and hold its edges just behind your hips.
Lean back slightly and stretch your legs out straight, feet off the floor.
Breathe out and pull your knees in toward your chest while bringing your chest slightly forward.
Push your legs back out slowly without letting your feet touch the floor.

exercises.name: Leg Up Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight on the floor.
Lift your right leg toward the ceiling and hold the back of the thigh or calf with both hands.
Keep the left leg flat and the back of your head on the floor.
Gently pull the right leg toward you, keeping the knee as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Lever Alternate Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees are bent about 90 degrees with both feet on the platforms.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and hold the side handles.
Breathe out and press one foot forward until that leg is nearly straight.
Breathe in and let it return slowly under control.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Lever Alternating Narrow Grip Seated Row
aliases: machine alternating narrow grip seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and rest your chest on the pad.
Hold both narrow handles with straight arms.
Pull one handle back to your side, keeping your elbow close.
Return it slowly to straight, then pull with the other arm.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid twisting.
Breathe out on each pull and in as the arm extends.

exercises.name: Lever Bent-Over Row With V-Bar
instructions: Attach the V handle to the lever arm and stand over it with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees and a flat back, and grip the handle with palms facing each other.
Pull the handle toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Lower slowly to a full stretch while keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Lever Calf Press
instructions: Sit or lie in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the footplate.
Straighten your legs to take the weight, keeping a slight bend in the knees.
Let the footplate bring your toes back toward you until the calves stretch.
Press through the balls of your feet to push the plate as far as you can.
Hold the top briefly, return slowly, and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Lever Chest Press (Slow Negative)
instructions: Set the seat height so your hands meet the handles at mid-chest level and plant your feet on the floor.
Press your shoulder blades back into the pad and hold the handles firmly.
Drive the handles away from you in a smooth press, stopping just before your elbows lock.
Control the return for about two seconds until your hands are back beside your chest.
Exhale during the press and keep your head against the backrest.

exercises.name: Lever Deadlift
instructions: Load the machine and stand on the platform with your feet hip-width apart between the handles.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the handles, arms straight.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and brace your core.
Push through your feet and stand up, driving your hips forward at the top.
Lower the handles by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until the weight nearly touches down.
Breathe out as you stand and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Lever Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Step into the donkey calf machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform, heels off.
Lean forward, hold the handles and position the pad across your lower back or hips.
Straighten your legs to lift the weight off the stack, keeping knees soft.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly to the stretch.

exercises.name: Lever Gripless Shrug
instructions: Set the machine so the pads sit on top of your shoulders or under your arms when you stand or sit tall.
Let your arms hang relaxed and keep your back straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up against the pads as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your traps at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulders are fully down.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Lever Gripper Hands
instructions: Sit or stand at the gripper machine and set a light load to start.
Wrap one or both hands around the handles with your wrist straight.
Squeeze the handles together as hard as you can.
Hold the squeeze for a second or two.
Open your hand slowly against the resistance and repeat.

exercises.name: Lever Hammer Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat and rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other.
Breathe out and curl the handles up, keeping your thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Breathe in and lower slowly to an almost straight arm.

exercises.name: Lever Horizontal One Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee is bent about 90 degrees when your foot is on the plate.
Sit with your back flat on the pad and place one foot in the middle of the plate; rest the other on the floor or frame.
Hold the side handles and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and push the plate away until the leg is almost straight.
Breathe in and bend the knee to let the plate return slowly.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Lever Incline Chest Press (Wide Grip)
aliases: machine incline chest press wide grip
instructions: Adjust the seat and back pad so the handles start just above your shoulders.
Sit with your back and head against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Breathe out and press up and away until your arms are nearly straight, without locking your elbows.
Breathe in and lower the handles slowly back toward your upper chest.

exercises.name: Lever Kneeling Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so your knee lines up with its pivot point and the pad sits on the back of your lower calf.
Kneel on the knee pad with your forearms on the support and your hips square.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, squeezing the hamstring.
Keep your hips still and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower the pad slowly until your leg is almost straight.
Breathe out as you curl; finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Lever Kneeling Twist
instructions: Adjust the machine, kneel on the pad and hold the handles with your chest facing forward.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders square to the machine.
Breathe out and rotate your hips to one side as far as you can control.
Return slowly to the middle without letting the weight stack slam.
Finish your reps on that side, then switch the machine and work the other side.

exercises.name: Lever Lying Two-One Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels and your knees just off the bench edge.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed into the bench.
Breathe out and curl the pad up toward your glutes using both legs.
At the top, slide one leg out from under the pad.
Breathe in and lower the pad slowly with the remaining leg, taking three to four seconds.
Put both legs back under the pad and alternate the lowering leg each rep.

exercises.name: Lever Military Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height, and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Grip the handles with palms facing forward and plant your feet.
Breathe out and press the handles straight up until your arms are straight but not locked hard.
Keep your lower back on the pad.
Breathe in and lower the handles slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Lever Narrow Grip Seated Row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest and sit with your chest on the pad.
Hold the narrow handles with your palms facing each other and arms straight.
Pull the handles back, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without leaning back.
Return slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Lever Neck Extension (plate Loaded)
instructions: Sit in the machine facing forward and adjust the seat so the head pad sits against the back of your head.
Hold the handles and sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your chin slightly tucked toward your chest.
Push your head back slowly against the pad until you are looking slightly up.
Pause, then return slowly; use a light weight and never jerk the neck.
Breathe out as you press back and in as you return.

exercises.name: Lever Neck Left Side Flexion (plate Loaded)
aliases: neck left side flexion plate loaded
machine neck left side flexion plate loaded
instructions: Sit sideways in the neck machine so the head pad rests against the left side of your head.
Hold the handles and keep your torso upright and shoulders level.
Start with your head slightly tilted to the right.
Bend your neck slowly to the left, bringing your left ear toward your left shoulder against the pad.
Pause, then return slowly to the start; keep the weight light and the motion smooth.

exercises.name: Lever Neck Right Side Flexion (plate Loaded)
aliases: neck right side flexion plate loaded
machine neck right side flexion plate loaded
instructions: Sit sideways in the machine so the head pad rests against the right side of your head.
Hold the handles and keep your shoulders level and your back straight.
Start with your head slightly tilted to the left.
Bend your neck slowly to the right against the pad, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Pause, then return slowly; do not let your shoulder rise to meet your ear.

exercises.name: Lever One Arm Lateral High Row
aliases: machine one arm lateral high row
instructions: Sit on the machine facing the pad and take one handle with an overhand grip.
Start with your arm straight out in front of you at about shoulder height.
Pull the handle back with your elbow high and out to the side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back and breathe out.
Return slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Lever One Arm Lateral Wide Pulldown
aliases: machine one arm lateral wide pulldown
instructions: Sit on the machine, secure your thighs under the pad and take one handle with an overhand grip.
Start with the arm straight overhead and slightly out to the side.
Pull the handle down in a wide arc until your elbow is beside your ribs.
Breathe out and squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly to a full stretch.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Lever One Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handle is at shoulder height and sit with your back against the pad.
Hold one handle with palm facing forward and rest your free hand on the seat or your thigh.
Breathe out and press the handle up until your arm is straight.
Keep your body square and don't lean away from the working arm.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: Lever Overhand Triceps Dip
instructions: Sit in the dip machine with your back against the pad and adjust the seat so the handles are about at chest height.
Grip the handles with palms facing down and your elbows bent and pointing back.
Breathe out and push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.
Breathe in and let the handles rise slowly until your elbows are about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Lever Preacher Curl (to Shoulders)
instructions: Set the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad, then rest your upper arms on it.
Grip the handles underhand with your arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower the handles slowly until your arms are almost straight.

exercises.name: Lever Reverse Grip Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad so you are locked in with your arms reaching the handles.
Grip the handles with your palms facing you.
Pull the handles down to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and squeeze your shoulder blades down.
Let the handles rise slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Lever Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your upper arms flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms facing down.
Breathe out and curl the handles up, keeping your wrists straight.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Lever Reverse Grip Vertical Row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and rest your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms facing up.
Pull the handles back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Return slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your chest on the pad.

exercises.name: Lever Reverse T-Bar Row
instructions: Step onto the foot platform and lie with your chest on the angled pad.
Take the handles with a grip that feels natural and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the handles up toward your chest by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Lever Rotary Calf
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pad sits firmly on your hips or thighs and your knees are slightly bent.
Place the balls of your feet on the footplate with your heels hanging off, and hold the handles.
Lower your heels slowly for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes, pushing the lever arm through its arc as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control; breathe out on the way up.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Calf Press
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the knee pads so they rest snugly on your lower thighs.
Put the balls of your feet on the foot bar with your heels off the edge.
Lift slightly to release the safety lever, then lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise the pads as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second, lower slowly, and keep a steady breathing rhythm.
Put the safety lever back before you get up.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Crunch (Knees Up)
instructions: Set the weight, sit on the machine and place your shins or feet behind the lower pads, holding the handles by your head or chest.
Sit tall with your abs tight and your lower back against the pad if there is one.
Breathe out and curl your chest down while drawing your knees up, squeezing your abs at the middle.
Pause for a second without pulling with your arms.
Breathe in and return slowly to the start, keeping the weight from slamming down.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Crunch (chest Pad)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the chest pad sits on your upper chest and hook your feet under the rollers if there are any.
Hold the handles lightly; do not pull with your arms.
Breathe out and crunch forward, curling your ribs down toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom for a moment.
Return slowly until your back is upright, without letting the weights touch.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Good Morning
instructions: Adjust the seat and pads so the upper pad sits across your upper back and your hips are against the seat back.
Sit tall, hold the handles and keep your feet flat.
Breathe in and lean forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Go until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, without rounding your back.
Breathe out and squeeze your glutes to push the pad back and return to upright.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Leg Raise Crunch
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet or shins under the leg pads.
Hold the handles at your sides.
Breathe out and pull your knees up toward your chest while curling your upper body forward.
Squeeze for a second when your knees and chest are closest.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Reverse Fly (parallel Grip)
aliases: machine seated reverse fly parallel grip
instructions: Set the machine handles to the rear position and sit facing the pad with your chest against it.
Grab the vertical handles with palms facing each other and arms straight at shoulder height.
Breathe out and sweep your arms back in a wide arc until they line up with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades for a second.
Breathe in and let the handles return slowly to the front.

exercises.name: Lever Seated Squat Calf Raise On Leg Press Machine
aliases: seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
machine seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
instructions: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad and set the seat so your legs are almost straight.
Place only the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the footplate, heels off.
Press the plate out by straightening your legs, keeping a slight bend in the knees.
Let the plate bring your toes back toward you for a stretch.
Breathe out and push the plate away by pointing your toes, then pause.
Breathe in and return slowly, keeping your knees still the whole time.

exercises.name: Lever Shoulder Press (Converging Arc)
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with palms facing forward and plant your feet.
Breathe out and press up and in until your arms are straight and your hands come closer together.
Pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly along the same arc.

exercises.name: Lever Shoulder Press (Neutral Grip)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the neutral handles are at shoulder height and sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with palms facing each other and elbows slightly in front of your body.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Breathe in and lower the handles slowly.

exercises.name: Lever Sissy Squat With Dumbbell
instructions: Set the bench so your ankles fit snugly under the roller and your calves press against the pad.
Stand tall and hold a dumbbell upright against your chest.
Breathe in and bend your knees forward, letting your body lean back in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower until your thighs are close to parallel with the floor, keeping your stomach tight.
Breathe out and press your shins into the pad to straighten your knees and return to standing.

exercises.name: Lever Standing Chest Press
instructions: Stand facing away from the machine and adjust the handles to line up with your mid-chest.
Grip the handles, take a short staggered stance and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your torso upright; do not lean forward to finish the press.
Breathe in and let the handles return slowly to your chest.

exercises.name: Lever Standing Gripless Shrug
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pads sit on top of your shoulders while your knees are slightly bent.
Stand under the pads with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed.
Straighten your legs to take the weight, keeping your back tall.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second at the top, then lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Lever T-Bar Reverse Grip Row
instructions: Stand on the platform straddling the lever arm and bend your knees slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back and take the handles with your palms facing up.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Lower slowly to a full stretch while keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: London Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor under a hanging rope with your legs straight and heels on the ground.
Grab the rope above your head with both hands, one above the other.
Pull yourself up hand over hand, letting your heels stay put as your body rises.
Keep climbing until you are standing upright under the rope.
Reverse slowly, moving one hand down at a time until you are sitting again.
Keep your stomach tight and breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position, take a handle in each hand and stand in the middle with a staggered stance.
Let your arms hang down and slightly back with palms facing forward and elbows softly bent.
Sweep your hands up and inward until they meet in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top for a second without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower your arms slowly back to the start, breathing in, and breathe out as you lift.

exercises.name: Lower Back Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight and your arms by your sides, palms down.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips into the floor.
Breathe out and lift your chest and shoulders a few centimetres off the mat.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lunge (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back from a rack and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step forward with one foot.
Lower straight down until your back knee almost touches the floor and your front shin is roughly vertical.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through your front heel to step back to the start.
Alternate legs, breathing in as you lower and out as you push back.

exercises.name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell hanging at each side.
Step forward with one leg, landing heel first.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees and the back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your middle toes.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, breathing in as you lower and out as you push back.

exercises.name: Lunge With Jump
instructions: Start in a lunge with your right foot forward and both knees bent.
Swing your arms and jump straight up explosively.
Switch your legs in the air so the left foot lands in front.
Land softly in a lunge, letting the knees bend to absorb the impact.
Go straight into the next jump, breathing out on each jump, and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Lunge With Twist
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold your arms straight out in front of your chest, or clasp your hands.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about a right angle.
At the bottom, turn your chest and arms toward the side of the front leg, keeping your hips facing forward.
Turn back to the center, keeping your front knee in line with your foot.
Push through the front heel to return to standing, then lunge with the other leg.
Breathe out as you twist and keep your abs tight throughout.

exercises.name: Lying (side) Quads Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and rest your head on your lower arm.
Bend your top knee and hold that ankle or foot with your top hand.
Pull your heel gently toward your glutes, keeping your knees close together.
Push your hips slightly forward to feel the stretch along the front of the thigh.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release, roll onto your other side and stretch the other leg.

exercises.name: Lying Elbow To Knee
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat, and your hands lightly behind your head.
Tighten your abs and lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Breathe out as you draw one knee in and turn to meet it with the opposite elbow, straightening the other leg just above the floor.
Return to the start with control.
Repeat with the other elbow and knee, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Have a partner place a light dumbbell between your feet, or set it there yourself, then lie face down on a flat bench with your knees just off the end.
Squeeze the dumbbell handle firmly between your feet and hold the bench for support.
Bend your knees and curl the dumbbell up toward your glutes, keeping your hips on the bench.
Stop when your shins are about vertical so the dumbbell stays secure.
Lower it slowly until your legs are nearly straight.
Breathe out as you curl and in as you lower; use a light weight you can control.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the machine so your knees are just off the end of the bench and the pad sits just above your heels.
Lie face down and hold the handles, hips pressed into the pad.
Curl the pad up toward your glutes as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top and keep your hips down.
Lower the pad slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Breathe out as you curl and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your hips near the end and hold the bench behind your head.
Stretch your legs out straight, level with the bench.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly to just below bench level, keeping your lower back pressed into the pad.
Keep your knees straight or very slightly soft.

exercises.name: Lying Leg-Hip Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms flat beside you, palms down.
Tighten your abs and lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Press your palms into the floor and curl your hips up off the mat, pushing your feet straight up.
Breathe out as your hips rise and keep the movement slow, without swinging.
Lower your hips first, then bring your legs down slowly, stopping just above the floor.

exercises.name: Machine Inner Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest height and sit with your back flat on the pad.
Hold the handles with your elbows bent and slightly below shoulder level.
Breathe out and press forward, bringing the handles in toward each other in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest hard for a second where the handles come closest together.
Breathe in and let the handles travel back out slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: March Sit (wall)
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and walk your feet out about two foot-lengths.
Slide down until your knees are bent close to 90 degrees, with your knees over your ankles.
Press your back into the wall and tighten your core.
Lift one foot a few centimeters off the floor, hold for a moment and set it down.
Lift the other foot the same way, keeping your hips level and your thighs at the same height.
Keep marching for a set time, breathing steadily, then stand up by sliding back up the wall.

exercises.name: Meadows Row (Landmine)
aliases: lever one arm bent over row
machine one arm bent over row
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine base and load the other end.
Stand beside the loaded end, hinge forward with a flat back and rest your free hand on your knee.
Hold the bar just behind the plates with the hand nearest to it.
Row the bar up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower slowly to straight arm, finish your reps, then turn around for the other side.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.
shorthand: lever one arm bent over row

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Catch And Overhead Throw
instructions: Stand facing a partner or a solid wall a few metres away, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the medicine ball overhead with both hands and tighten your stomach.
Throw the ball forward hard from overhead, snapping your arms down and breathing out.
Catch the return with your arms overhead, letting them give slightly to absorb it.
Reset your stance and throw again right away.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
instructions: Stand facing a partner or a solid wall about 3 meters away, feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ball at your chest.
Keep your elbows out and your thumbs behind the ball.
Step forward slightly and throw the ball by straightening your arms quickly, finishing with your palms facing out.
Breathe out sharply as you release.
Catch the return with soft arms, bring the ball back to your chest and reset before the next throw.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Push From 3 Point Stance
instructions: Place the ball on the floor in front of you and crouch over it with feet shoulder-width apart, hips back and knees bent.
Hold the ball against your chest with one hand and put the other hand on the floor so you are in a three-point stance.
Bring the free hand up to the ball as you drive forward and up through your legs.
Push the ball out from your chest with both hands as hard as you can, aiming forward and slightly up.
Follow the throw with a few running steps, then walk back, pick up the ball and reset.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Push Multiple Response
instructions: Stand about an arm's length plus a step from a solid wall, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light medicine ball at your chest.
Push the ball into the wall by straightening your arms quickly.
Catch it as it bounces back, letting your elbows bend just enough to absorb it.
Push it back to the wall immediately with as little pause as possible.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe out on each push; stop when your speed drops.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Push Single Response
instructions: Stand facing a wall or open space with feet shoulder-width apart and the ball held at your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and set your stomach tight.
Throw the ball forward from your chest as hard as you can, fully straightening your arms.
Breathe out sharply on the throw.
Let the ball drop or roll, collect it and take a moment to reset fully before the next throw.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Push With Run Release
instructions: Stand in an open space with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ball at your chest.
Lean forward slightly and bend your knees as if about to sprint.
Drive off your legs and throw the ball forward from your chest with both hands.
Sprint after the ball as soon as it leaves your hands.
Pick up or catch the ball, walk back to the start and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Close Grip Push Up
instructions: Place a medicine ball under your chest and put both hands on it, fingers spread around the sides.
Step your feet back into a plank with your body in a straight line.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the ball, keeping your elbows close to your ribs.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your stomach tight so your hips don't drop or pike up.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a medicine ball with both hands above your chest, arms straight.
Tighten your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders off the floor while pushing the ball straight up toward the ceiling.
Pause at the top with your arms still straight.
Breathe in and lower your shoulders slowly, keeping the ball over your chest.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Slam
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Reach the ball overhead and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Breathe out and slam the ball straight down in front of you as hard as you can, bending your hips and knees.
Keep your back flat as you follow the ball down.
Pick up the ball, stand tall and repeat.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Throw
instructions: Stand facing a solid wall or a partner with your feet hip-width apart or in a short split stance.
Hold a medicine ball with both hands and raise it above and slightly behind your head.
Brace your stomach and throw the ball forward hard, snapping your arms straight as you release.
Breathe out sharply as you throw and follow through with your arms.
Catch the rebound or collect the ball, reset your stance and throw again.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Supine Chest Throw
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your stomach and keep your elbows slightly tucked.
Breathe out and push the ball straight up as fast as you can, letting it leave your hands.
Catch it with soft arms and let it come back down to your chest.
Reset for a moment before the next throw.

exercises.name: Mixed Grip Chin-Up
instructions: Grab the bar shoulder-width apart with one hand overhand and the other underhand.
Hang with straight arms and tighten your stomach and glutes.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, keeping your body from twisting.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Change which hand is underhand on your next set.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Modified Hindu Push-Up
instructions: Start in an upside-down V: hands and feet on the floor a bit wider than shoulder-width, hips high and arms straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, sweeping your chest down and forward so it skims just above the floor between your hands.
Keep moving forward and straighten your arms, letting your hips lower toward the floor and your chest lift.
Breathe out and push your hips back up and back to return to the upside-down V.
Move smoothly and keep your stomach tight throughout.

exercises.name: Modified Push Up To Lower Arms
instructions: Start in a push-up position on your knees, hands under your shoulders and body straight from head to knees.
Lower your right forearm to the floor, then your left, so you rest on both forearms.
Keep your hips level and your stomach tight; do not let your back sag.
Press through your right palm to come back up onto your hand, then do the same with the left.
Alternate which arm leads each rep and breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: Monster Walk
instructions: Place a mini band just above your knees or around your ankles.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, bend into a quarter squat and keep your chest up.
Step one foot forward and out at a diagonal, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the other foot forward and out the same way, never letting your feet come together.
Keep your knees pushed out and your hips level as you walk forward for 10 to 20 steps.
Walk backward the same way to return, breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Tighten your stomach and keep your hips level with your shoulders.
Drive your right knee toward your chest, then return it.
Switch legs quickly, bringing the left knee in as the right foot goes back.
Keep alternating at a steady pace, landing lightly on the balls of your feet.
Breathe rhythmically and keep your shoulders over your hands.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width, using a false grip if you can.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar down toward your lower chest rather than your chin.
As you reach the top of the pull, lean forward and rotate your wrists and elbows over the bar.
From the bottom of the dip position, press up until your arms are straight.
Lower back down under control to a full hang.
Breathe out on the pull and press, and take a breath at the hang.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up (on Vertical Bar)
instructions: Hang from the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, wrists set slightly over the bar.
Pull explosively, driving the bar toward your lower chest.
As your chest reaches the bar, lean forward and swing your elbows quickly over it.
Press down until your arms are straight and you are supported above the bar.
Lower back under the bar with control and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Narrow Push-Up On Exercise Ball
instructions: Kneel behind an exercise ball and place both hands on top of it close together, fingers pointing down the sides.
Step your feet back one at a time into a plank with your body straight.
Breathe in and lower your chest to the ball, keeping your elbows close to your ribs.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms.
Keep your stomach tight and the ball still under your hands.

exercises.name: Neck Bridge Prone
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place a thick, soft pad in front of you.
Put your hands on the floor beside the pad and rest your forehead on it.
Tuck your chin slightly and tighten your abs.
Lift your knees and shift a little weight forward onto your forehead, using your hands to control the load.
Hold for a few seconds while breathing steadily, then shift back to take weight off.
Keep the movement small and stop right away if you feel any pain.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.
Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, keeping your face looking forward.
For a deeper stretch, rest your right hand lightly on the left side of your head; do not pull hard.
Keep the left shoulder down and hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Bring your head back to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Negative Crunch
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and feet flat, arms crossed on your chest, as if at the top of a sit-up.
Brace your abs and round your lower back slightly.
Lower your back toward the floor very slowly, taking about four seconds.
Stop just before your shoulders touch down.
Use your hands or a small push to get back to the top, then lower again.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach the twin parallel handle to the high pulley and sit with your thighs secured.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other and arms straight.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, elbows close and driving down.
Squeeze your back, then let the handle rise slowly.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.
aliases: twin handle parallel grip lat pulldown
shorthand: twin handle parallel grip lat pulldown

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grab the parallel handles with your palms facing each other, about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with straight arms, shoulders slightly drawn down.
Pull up by driving your elbows down beside your body.
Rise until your chin is above the handles.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a bar, a partner's hands or a fixed object.
Keep a straight line from knees to head and cross your arms or hold them ready to catch yourself.
Lean forward as slowly as you can, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands when you can no longer hold it, then push back up and pull with your hamstrings to return.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunch (Alternating Twist)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, fingertips resting lightly behind your ears.
Tighten your abs and press your lower back into the floor.
Breathe out as you lift your shoulder blades and turn, aiming one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Hold the squeeze for a second, then lower slowly as you breathe in.
Turn toward the other side on the next rep, alternating throughout the set.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunches Floor
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and let both drop to your left side so they rest on the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat and place your fingertips by your ears.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders straight up toward the ceiling, feeling the right side of your waist work.
Lower slowly and keep a steady rhythm.
Finish your reps, then drop your knees to the right and repeat.

exercises.name: Olympic Barbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold the bar in front of your thighs with both palms facing each other, hands close together near the middle.
Keep the bar level and your elbows at your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest with your thumbs leading.
Squeeze at the top without swinging.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Olympic Barbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and press the bar overhead with a narrow overhand grip.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes to keep your back neutral.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, upper arms close to your ears.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to bring the bar back overhead.
Use a lighter weight than you would for presses and move slowly.

exercises.name: One Arm Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall about an arm's length away, feet hip-width apart.
Place one palm on the wall at about head height with your arm straight.
Without bending your elbow, press your hand down and into the wall as if pulling it toward your hip.
Feel the muscle under your armpit tighten and keep breathing.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds, relax and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: One Arm Chin-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with one hand, palm facing you, directly above your shoulder.
Hang with the arm straight and your body tight; you can hold your working wrist with the other hand at first.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip and drive your chest up to the bar.
Resist turning by squeezing your stomach and glutes.
Lower slowly to a full hang, then switch arms.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: One Arm Dip
instructions: Grip one dip handle and press up so that arm is straight, using your free hand on the other bar for balance at first.
Shift your body over the working hand and tighten your stomach.
Breathe in and bend the elbow to lower yourself a short distance, keeping the elbow close to your side.
Breathe out and press back up to a straight arm.
Increase the depth only as your strength and balance allow; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: One Arm Slam (with Medicine Ball)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding a non-bouncing medicine ball in one hand at your shoulder.
Reach the ball up overhead, rising onto the balls of your feet.
Brace your abs and slam the ball forcefully into the floor beside your foot, bending your hips and knees.
Breathe out sharply as you throw.
Pick the ball up with a flat back, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: One Arm Towel Row
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy post or the handle of a closed, locked door and hold both ends in one hand.
Step your feet close to the anchor and lean back until your arm is straight.
Keep your body straight from head to heels and your free arm by your side.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward your hand, driving your elbow back.
Lower yourself slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: One Leg Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on a step on one foot with your heel hanging off, the other foot hooked behind it.
Hinge at the hips and support your hands on a bench or rail in front of you.
Keep your back flat and your working knee nearly straight.
Let your heel drop for a full stretch.
Breathe out and drive up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: One Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Stand next to a wall and rest one hand on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor by bending that knee.
Breathe out and rise onto the ball of your standing foot as high as possible.
Pause at the top, keeping the ankle straight and the knee soft.
Breathe in and lower your heel slowly to the floor.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: One Leg Squat
instructions: Stand on your right leg and lift your left foot a little off the floor in front of you.
Reach your arms forward to help you balance.
Breathe in and slowly bend your right knee, pushing your hips back, as low as you can control.
Keep the right knee in line with your toes and the heel flat on the floor.
Breathe out and push through the whole foot to stand back up.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Otis Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet anchored, holding a weight plate against your chest.
Breathe out and sit up in one smooth movement.
As you reach the top, press the plate straight overhead.
Bring the plate back to your chest and lower your back slowly to the floor.
Choose a weight that lets you sit up without jerking.

exercises.name: Outside Leg Kick Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees, then press back up.
At the top, lift one straight leg off the floor and sweep it out to the side as far as you can without twisting your hips.
Bring the leg back in and set the foot down.
Do another push-up and sweep the other leg out.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you press; keep your core tight so your hips stay level.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable crossover with a single handle on each high pulley.
Take a handle in each hand, palms facing up, and raise your arms out to the sides at about shoulder height.
Breathe out and curl both handles toward the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps at the end of the curl.
Breathe in and straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at upper chest height and grip it just outside shoulder width.
Unrack it, step back and stand with feet hip-width apart, glutes squeezed and stomach braced.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it clears your chin.
Push your head through once the bar passes it, finishing with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip, arms straight and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out.
Push the bar up toward the ceiling and squeeze your shoulder blades so your arms stay locked.
Breathe in, brace and squat down slowly, keeping the bar directly over your feet.
Go only as deep as you can while the bar stays stable and your chest stays up, then stand.
Breathe out at the top; drop the bar behind you if you lose it.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley, grab the ends and turn away from the machine, bringing the rope over your head.
Take a staggered stance and lean forward slightly with your elbows pointing forward beside your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms forward and up, spreading the rope at the end.
Keep your upper arms still; only your forearms move.
Breathe in and let your hands return behind your head under control.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands under the top end.
Brace your stomach and keep your elbows close to your head.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.
Avoid arching your lower back as you press.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold an EZ bar overhead on the inner grips.
Keep your elbows close to your head and pointing forward.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.
Keep your back against the pad and your ribs down.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and raise your right arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your right hand reaches down toward the middle of your upper back.
Place your left hand on your right elbow and gently press it back and down.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly and keeping your head upright.
Release slowly and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Band)
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and kneel side-on to it, with the knee nearest the anchor down and the other foot forward.
Hold the band at your chest with both hands and move away until it is tight.
Tighten your abs and squeeze the glute of your down leg, keeping your torso tall.
Breathe out and press your hands straight forward, holding for two seconds without turning toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest slowly, and switch sides and legs after the set.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and stand side-on to the machine, holding the handle against your chest with both hands.
Step away until the cable is tight and set your feet hip-width apart, knees soft.
Press the handle straight out in front of your chest without letting your body twist toward the machine.
Hold for a breath, bring it back to your chest, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Pec Deck (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles or pads are at chest height, then sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows and your arms open to the sides.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a smooth arc.
Squeeze your chest for a moment when they meet.
Return slowly until you feel a light stretch, breathing in, and breathe out as you close.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms resting by your sides.
Notice the small gap between your lower back and the floor.
Breathe out and tighten your lower abs to tilt your pelvis back, pressing your lower back flat into the floor.
Hold for a few seconds without lifting your hips or pushing with your feet.
Breathe in and relax back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
Flatten your lower back into the floor by tilting your pelvis up slightly.
Keep that tilt and peel your hips off the floor one section of the spine at a time.
Stop when your knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in at the top, then breathe out as you roll back down, lower back touching last.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with the barbell over your mid-foot and grip it overhand a little wider than your shoulders.
Hinge until your back is about level with the floor, knees bent and back flat.
Breathe in, brace your stomach and pull the bar quickly to your lower chest.
Keep your back angle the same and do not let your body rise.
Lower the bar back to the floor, let it settle, and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
instructions: Step into the machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet in the middle of the platform about hip-width apart and release the safety.
Bend your knees and let the pad swing down and back until your thighs pass parallel, keeping your heels down.
Drive through the whole foot to swing back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.

exercises.name: Peroneals Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop a rope around the ball of that foot.
Hold both ends of the rope, with more of the pull coming from the hand on the inner side of the leg.
Pull gently so your toes come toward you and the sole turns inward.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the outside of your shin and ankle.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and breathe slowly.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips so your body forms an upside-down V.
Place your hands a little wider than your shoulders, head between your arms.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pike-To-Cobra Push-Up
instructions: Start in a pike: hands and feet on the floor, hips high, body in an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down close to the floor between your hands.
Keep moving forward, straightening your arms and lifting your chest into a cobra with your hips low.
Breathe in as you open the chest, then breathe out and push your hips back up to the pike.
Move smoothly and keep your stomach tight throughout.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on your right leg and lift your left leg straight out in front, heel just off the floor.
Reach both arms forward to counter your weight.
Breathe in and slowly sit down on the right leg, keeping the heel flat and the knee over the toes.
Lower until your hamstring rests on your calf while the left leg stays straight and off the floor.
Breathe out and push hard through the right foot to stand back up without bouncing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows directly under your shoulders, hands facing forward.
Step your feet back so you rest on your toes, feet about hip-width apart.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Look at the floor just ahead of your hands to keep your neck in line.
Hold without letting your hips sag or pike up, breathing slowly and steadily throughout.

exercises.name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate by the sides with both hands in front of your thighs.
Brace your stomach and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Breathe out and raise the plate in front of you to eye level.
Pause briefly without leaning back.
Breathe in and lower the plate slowly.

exercises.name: Plyo Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands just wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest quickly but under control until it is close to the floor.
Explode upward so your hands lift off the floor.
Land with your hands in the same spot and your elbows soft to absorb the impact.
Go straight into the next rep, keeping your hips in line with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Posterior Step To Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, landing on the ball of the back foot.
As you lower, sweep both arms up overhead and reach tall, keeping your ribs down and abs tight.
Hold for a breath, feeling the stretch in the front of the back hip.
Press through the front foot to step back to standing as you lower your arms, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop a rope around the ball of that foot.
Hold both ends, pulling a little more with the hand on the outer side of the leg.
Draw your toes toward you while letting the sole turn slightly outward.
Stop at a gentle stretch deep in the calf and along the inner ankle.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with slow breathing.
Release and switch legs.

exercises.name: Potty Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and your toes turned slightly out.
Tighten your abs and reach your arms forward for balance.
