Bend your knees and hips and sink as low as you can, keeping your heels down and your chest up.
Rest at the bottom for a few breaths, pressing your knees gently out with your elbows if that helps.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up, breathing out as you rise.

exercises.name: Potty Squat With Support
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy support such as a rack post or door frame and hold it with both hands.
Set your feet a little wider than your hips with toes turned slightly out.
Breathe in and sink down as low as you can, letting your hips drop between your heels.
Keep your heels down and use the support to keep your chest upright.
Hold the bottom for a few breaths, then breathe out and push up to standing.

exercises.name: Power Clean
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot, feet hip-width apart, and grip it just outside your knees with a hook or overhand grip.
Set your back flat, shoulders slightly in front of the bar and arms long.
Push the floor away and lift the bar steadily past your knees, keeping it close.
When it reaches mid-thigh, jump your hips forward hard, extend fully and shrug.
Pull yourself under and whip your elbows forward to catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat, then stand up.
Drop or lower the bar to the floor with control and reset; breathe and brace before every rep.

exercises.name: Power Point Plank
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your feet about hip-width apart.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body is straight.
Lower one forearm to the floor, then the other, until you are in a forearm plank.
Place one hand back under its shoulder, then the other, to push back up to the high plank.
Lead with the other arm on the next rep, keeping your hips as still as possible and breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Prancing
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Shift your weight to the right foot and rise high onto the ball of that foot, bending the right knee slightly.
Keep the left heel lightly on the floor as you rise on the right.
Lower the right heel as you shift your weight and rise onto the left forefoot.
Keep alternating in a smooth bouncing rhythm, with an upright chest and tight stomach.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad, armpits snug against its top.
Hold a barbell underhand at shoulder width with your arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Stop just before your forearms are vertical to keep tension on the biceps.
Breathe in and lower slowly, stopping just short of locking your elbows.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Cable)
instructions: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley and attach a straight or EZ-style bar.
Sit with the backs of your upper arms on the pad and take the bar underhand.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your face.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without lifting your arms off the pad.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Rest the back of one upper arm on a preacher pad, armpit snug against the top.
Hold a dumbbell underhand with the arm nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, stopping just short of a locked elbow; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
aliases: ez barbell close grip preacher curl
ez bb close grip preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar underhand on the inner angled grips with your arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chin.
Squeeze your biceps when your forearms are near vertical.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly, stopping just short of locking your elbows.
shorthand: ez barbell close grip preacher curl

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your armpits sit snugly against the top of the pad and your elbows line up with the pivot.
Grab the handles with an underhand grip and arms nearly straight.
Breathe out and curl the handles up toward your face.
Squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to almost straight arms.

exercises.name: Prisoner Half Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, and lace your fingers lightly behind your head.
Open your elbows wide and keep them there throughout.
Breathe out and curl up to about a 45-degree angle, leading with your chest, not your elbows.
Pause briefly without pulling your head forward.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your shoulders touch the floor.

exercises.name: Prone Twist On Stability Ball
instructions: Lie face down with your hips and stomach on a stability ball, toes on the floor and feet set wide for balance.
Place your fingertips lightly behind your ears.
Lift your chest off the ball until your body forms a straight line, without arching past that point.
Rotate your upper body to turn one shoulder up toward the ceiling, then come back to the center, breathing out as you turn.
Twist to the other side, and lower your chest back onto the ball at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Pull-In (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Get into a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your shins resting on a stability ball.
Brace your abs so your body forms a straight line.
Breathe out and pull your knees toward your chest, letting the ball roll forward under your feet.
Pause with your hips over your shoulders.
Push your legs back out slowly to the straight plank without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Pull-Through (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley, face away from the machine and hold one end of the rope in each hand between your legs.
Walk forward a few steps until the cable is tight and set your feet a little wider than hip-width.
With soft knees and a flat back, push your hips back and let the rope pull your hands back between your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall, keeping your arms straight.
Breathe in as you hinge back and out as you stand.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with your palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms and squeeze your legs together.
Pull your shoulders down first, then pull your chest up toward the bar.
Go up until your chin passes the bar without kicking or swinging.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Pull-Up (Assisted)
instructions: Choose the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the top handles a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Hang with straight arms and tighten your stomach.
Pull up until your chin passes the handles, thinking of bringing your elbows to your hips.
Come down slowly to a full hang without letting the platform drop you.
Use less assistance over time as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell with both hands cupped under the top plate, arms above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them at that angle.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until your upper arms are about in line with your body.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest along the same arc.
Breathe in deeply as you lower and out as you pull up; keep your ribs and hips down.

exercises.name: Pullover (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot and fasten the belt if there is one.
Reach up and place your hands or elbows on the bar or pads overhead.
Breathe out and pull the bar down in an arc toward your thighs, keeping your arms almost straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar return slowly overhead until you feel a stretch along your sides.

exercises.name: Push And Pull Bodyweight
instructions: Set up in a push-up position with your hands just wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Squeeze the floor with your hands and set your shoulder blades back and down.
Breathe in and pull yourself down toward the floor as if rowing your chest to your hands, keeping your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Stop with your chest just above the floor.
Breathe out and push the floor away to return to straight arms.

exercises.name: Push Press (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders with a grip just outside shoulder width, elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few centimetres by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive hard out of the dip and use that momentum to press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, absorbing it with your legs.

exercises.name: Push Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing in.
Brace your stomach and dip a few centimeters by bending your knees, chest up.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbells overhead in one smooth movement.
Finish with your arms and legs straight.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders under control and reset.

exercises.name: Push To Run
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows angled back, then press back up.
From the top, drive one knee toward your chest and switch legs quickly, as if running.
Do 4 to 6 fast knee drives while keeping your hips level.
Return to the plank and start the next push-up; breathe out as you press up.

exercises.name: Push Up On Bosu Ball
instructions: Flip the BOSU so the flat side faces up and grip the edges of the platform with both hands.
Walk your feet back into a push-up position with your body straight from head to heels.
Keep the platform level and your stomach tight.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the platform by bending your elbows.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms without letting the platform tip.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders and step your feet back into a high plank.
Tighten your stomach and glutes so your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is just above the floor, elbows angled back at about 45 degrees.
Push the floor away to return to straight arms.
Breathe in on the way down and out on the way up; drop to your knees if you cannot keep good form.

exercises.name: Push-Up (Wall, Close Grip)
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at about chest height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back a step so you are leaning into the wall with your body straight.
Bend your elbows close to your sides and bring your chest toward the wall.
Push the wall away until your arms are straight again.
Keep your heels down if you can and breathe out as you push.

exercises.name: Push-Up (bosu Ball)
instructions: Turn the half ball so its flat side faces up and grip the edges with your hands.
Step your feet back into a straight plank, balancing the platform level.
Lower your chest toward the platform with control.
Press back up while keeping the platform from tipping.
Brace your stomach the whole time and breathe out as you push.

exercises.name: Push-Up (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your hands on its sides, a little narrower than shoulder width.
Straighten your legs behind you so you balance on your toes with your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the top of the ball.
Push back up to straight arms, keeping the ball still.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes, and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Push-Up (on Stability Ball, Wide Feet)
instructions: Set the ball in front of you, place your palms on top of it and walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Spread your feet a little wider than usual for a steadier base.
Lower yourself slowly until your chest nearly touches the ball, elbows angled back.
Press up smoothly without letting the ball roll forward or sideways.
Hold your body rigid from head to heels and exhale on each press.

exercises.name: Push-Up (wall)
instructions: Stand about an arm's length from a wall and place your palms on it at shoulder height, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back slightly and tighten your stomach so your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the wall by bending your elbows.
Press back to the starting position.
Breathe in as you lean in and out as you push; step further back to make it harder.

exercises.name: Push-Up Close-Grip Off Dumbbell
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor parallel to each other, just under your chest and close together.
Grip the handles and set up in a push-up position with your body in a straight line.
Breathe in and lower your chest between your hands, elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Make sure the dumbbells are stable and won't roll before each set.

exercises.name: Push-Up Inside Leg Kick
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Do a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
At the top, lift one hand and rotate onto the outside edge of the opposite foot.
Kick the free leg through under your body toward the lifted hand, reaching it out straight.
Pull the leg back, place the hand down and return to plank.
Do another push-up and kick through with the other leg, breathing out on each press and kick.

exercises.name: Push-Up Medicine Ball
instructions: Get into a push-up position with one hand on a medicine ball and the other on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body straight and level.
Press back up to straight arms.
Roll the ball to your other hand and do the next rep with the hands switched.
Keep your stomach tight so your hips do not twist, and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Push-Up On Lower Arms
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your body in one straight line.
Brace your stomach and squeeze your glutes so your hips don't sag.
Press your palms into the floor and straighten your elbows to lift your forearms off the ground into a high plank.
Lower back down with control until your forearms rest on the floor again.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Push-Up Plus
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders and your body straight.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep pushing the floor away so your shoulder blades spread apart and your upper back rounds slightly.
Relax the shoulder blades back to neutral before starting the next rep.

exercises.name: Push-Up To Side Plank
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor and push back up.
At the top, rotate your body to the right, lift your right arm to the ceiling and stack your feet into a side plank.
Hold briefly with your hips high, then return to the plank.
Do another push-up and turn to the left side.

exercises.name: Quarter Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Rest your hands on the front of your thighs.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders up, sliding your hands until your fingertips reach your knees.
Hold briefly while keeping your lower back on the floor.
Breathe in and lower slowly to the floor.

exercises.name: Quick Feet Run
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees bent and chest slightly forward in an athletic stance.
Lift onto the balls of your feet.
Run in place with tiny, rapid steps, lifting the feet only a few centimeters.
Pump your arms quickly to match your feet and keep your core tight.
Breathe in a quick, steady rhythm and go for short bursts of 10 to 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Quick Feet Taps
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and chest a little forward.
Lift onto the balls of your feet.
Start tapping your feet up and down as fast as you can, lifting them only a few centimeters.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet and keep your body light.
Breathe steadily and keep going for the set time, then slow down to a stop.

exercises.name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar on rack pins or blocks just below or at knee level.
Stand close with the bar touching your legs and your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge to grip the bar just outside your legs, flatten your back and pull your shoulders down.
Breathe in, brace and drive your hips forward to stand up tall with the bar.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar back to the pins under control and breathe out after each rep.

exercises.name: Raise Single Arm Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your feet a little apart.
Do a full push-up, lowering your chest close to the floor and pressing back up.
At the top, lift one hand and reach that arm straight out to the side at shoulder height.
Hold for a second without letting your hips turn, then place the hand back down.
Do the next push-up and reach with the other arm, breathing out on each press.

exercises.name: Rear Axe Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with the right foot behind and your guard up.
Swing the straight right leg up in a small outward arc as high as you can control.
At the top, drive the heel straight down in front of you.
Keep your standing knee soft and your upper body upright for balance.
Land the foot back in stance under control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Rear Decline Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a bench or step and your knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Place your arms on the floor by your sides, palms down.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips slowly until they almost touch the floor.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to the seated row cable, sit down with your feet on the platform and hold the rope ends with palms facing down.
Sit tall with your arms straight and your stomach braced.
Breathe out and pull the rope toward your face, lifting your elbows out to the sides at shoulder height.
Pull the rope ends apart at the end and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Breathe in and let your arms straighten slowly without leaning back.

exercises.name: Rear Deltoid Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm straight across the front of your chest.
Hold it just above the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the arm closer to your chest until you feel a stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Keep your shoulder down and breathe slowly while you hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: Rear Leg Hook Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your left foot forward and your hands up to guard your face.
Pivot on the ball of your front foot so your heel turns toward the target.
Lift your right knee across your body and extend the leg slightly past the target.
Bend the knee sharply to sweep the heel back toward the target in a hooking path.
Bring the leg back in and set it down in your stance, keeping your hands up.
Repeat, then switch to the other stance.

exercises.name: Rear Pull-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Hang with straight arms and tilt your head slightly forward.
Pull up, keeping your elbows pointing down and slightly back, so the bar passes behind your head.
Stop when the bar reaches the base of your neck.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Reclining Big Toe Pose With Rope
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and loop a rope around the ball of your right foot.
Hold one end of the rope in each hand with your elbows relaxed on the floor.
Breathe out and raise the right leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Walk your hands up the rope to bring the leg closer, keeping your left leg pressed into the floor.
Hold for 30 seconds or more with slow, even breaths.
Lower the leg slowly and repeat on the left side.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Foot Eversion
instructions: Sit on the floor or a chair with your heel resting on the ground.
Loop a band around the outer edge of your foot and anchor it toward the inner side.
Keep the heel in place and your leg still.
Tilt the outer edge of your foot up and out so the sole turns outward.
Hold for a second, return slowly, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Foot External Rotation
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop a band around the front of one foot.
Anchor the other end to a sturdy object on the inner side of that foot, or hold it with the opposite foot.
Keep your knee and leg still, pointing straight up.
Rotate your foot outward, away from the other leg, against the band.
Hold for a moment, return slowly, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Foot Inversion
instructions: Sit with your leg straight or your heel on the floor, and loop a band around the inner edge of the foot.
Anchor the band toward the outer side so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your heel and knee still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward toward the other foot against the band.
Pause, return slowly, and switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Foot Plantar Flexion
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop a band around the ball of that foot.
Hold both ends of the band in your hands with a little tension.
Start with your foot relaxed and toes pointing up.
Push the ball of your foot away from you, pointing the toes down against the band.
Hold briefly, return slowly to the start, and switch feet after the set.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Hip Thrusts On Knees
instructions: Kneel on a mat with knees hip-width apart and place a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your body upright and your hands on your hips.
Breathe in and sit your hips back toward your heels, keeping your chest up.
Breathe out and drive your hips forward until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top while pressing your knees out against the band.
Sit back slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Leg Extension
instructions: Anchor a band low behind the chair or bench and loop the other end around one ankle.
Sit tall with your knees bent about 90 degrees and hold the sides of the seat.
Breathe out and straighten the knee, lifting the foot until the leg is straight.
Squeeze the front of the thigh for a second at the top.
Breathe in and bend the knee slowly back down, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Seated Biceps Curl
instructions: Sit on the floor or a chair and loop the middle of the band under your feet.
Hold an end of the band in each hand with your arms straight and palms facing up.
Sit tall and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Breathe out and curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Breathe in and lower slowly, keeping some tension in the band at the bottom.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Seated Chest Press
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench and wrap the band around your upper back, holding one end in each hand.
Bring your hands beside your chest with your elbows bent and slightly below shoulder level.
Breathe out and press your hands forward until your arms are straight in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end without letting your shoulders shrug up.
Breathe in and return slowly, controlling the band as it pulls back.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Place a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with feet flat and knees hip-width apart.
Sit tall or lean slightly forward with your hands on the bench.
Breathe out and press your knees out to the sides as far as you can against the band.
Hold for a second, then let the knees come back slowly without letting the band snap them in.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with the middle of a band under the seat or under your feet, holding an end in each hand at your shoulders.
Keep your palms forward and your stomach braced.
Breathe out and press your hands straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back straight and don't lean back.
Breathe in and lower your hands slowly to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Seated Straight Back Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the middle of the band around your feet.
Hold one end in each hand and sit tall with your chest up.
Breathe out and pull your elbows back past your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without leaning back.
Let your arms extend forward slowly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shuttle
instructions: Place a loop band around your ankles and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend into a quarter squat with your chest up and hands in front of you.
Step sideways with your right foot, keeping the band tight.
Follow with the left foot, but never let the feet come together.
Shuffle several steps to the right, then come back to the left, breathing steadily and staying low.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and lift your legs so your knees are bent at about a right angle over your hips.
Tighten your abs and press your palms lightly into the floor.
Breathe out and roll your hips off the mat, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lift with your abs rather than swinging your legs.
Breathe in and lower your hips slowly back to the floor, keeping your knees bent.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with palms facing down at shoulder width, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists flat in line with your forearms.
Breathe out and curl the bar up until your forearms point toward the ceiling.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the starting position without letting your shoulders roll forward.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Stand tall holding an EZ bar on the outer grips with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists firm.
Pause at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Dip
instructions: Stand with your back to a sturdy waist-high bar or ledge and grip it behind you with palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward so your weight is on your hands and your arms are straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your body, keeping your elbows pointing straight back.
Stop when your upper arms are about level with the floor or your shoulders feel tight.
Breathe out and press down through your hands to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly (Cable)
instructions: Set both pulleys to shoulder height with no handles, and hold the left cable end in your right hand and the right one in your left.
Step back to the middle so the cables cross in front of you and your arms are straight at chest height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and pull your arms apart and back until they line up with your body.
Breathe in and let your arms come back together slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back until your upper body is almost level with the floor, a dumbbell in each hand.
Turn your palms to face behind you and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly (Machine)
instructions: Set the handles to the rear position and adjust the seat so they are at shoulder height.
Sit facing the pad with your chest against it and grip the horizontal handles, palms facing down.
Breathe out and push the handles back with slightly bent elbows until your arms line up with your shoulders.
Keep your chest on the pad and your neck relaxed.
Breathe in and return slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Machine Lat Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then sit with your feet flat.
Grab the handles with your palms facing you.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom without leaning far back.
Let the handles rise slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you return.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hang with straight arms and a tight stomach.
Pull up, keeping your elbows in front of you and close.
Bring your chin above the bar and squeeze your back.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyper Extension (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Lie face down with your hips on top of the ball and your hands on the floor in front of it, arms straight.
Let your legs hang down behind the ball with your toes resting on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift both legs together until they line up with your body.
Keep your arms steady and avoid swinging or over-arching your back.
Lower your legs slowly until your toes nearly touch the floor.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyper On Flat Bench
instructions: Lie on your stomach along a flat bench so your hips sit at its end and your legs hang toward the floor.
Hold the sides or the front of the bench firmly.
Keep your legs straight and together, and breathe out as you raise them until they line up with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back hard.
Lower your legs slowly until your feet are just above the floor, breathing in.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension (Machine)
instructions: Lie face down on the pad with your hips at its edge and your legs hanging down, ankles under the roller or strap.
Hold the handles firmly to keep your upper body still.
Squeeze your glutes and raise your legs behind you until they are about level with your body.
Avoid swinging hard or over-arching your lower back at the top.
Lower your legs under control back to the hanging position.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
instructions: Take the bar on your upper back from a rack and stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot well back, landing on the ball of the foot.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Drive through the front heel and step the back foot forward to stand.
Alternate legs each rep, breathing in on the way down and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot back far enough that both knees can bend to about 90 degrees.
Lower straight down until the back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your weight in the front heel and your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back foot forward to stand.
Alternate legs, breathing out as you come up.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank With Leg Lift
instructions: Sit with your legs straight and your hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to heels.
Tighten your abs and glutes, then lift one straight leg as high as you can without letting your hips drop.
Lower the leg back down with control, breathing steadily.
Lift the other leg, alternating sides while keeping your hips up.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat and knees bent at about a right angle.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms down, and rest your forearms along your thighs.
Slide forward until your wrists are just past your knees.
Breathe out and raise your knuckles up as high as your wrists allow.
Pause briefly, then breathe in and let the bar sink back down under control.
Use a light weight; your forearms should not lift off your legs.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Bent Over Row (Barbell)
aliases: barbell reverse grip bent over row
bb reverse grip bent over row
instructions: Hold the bar with your palms facing forward, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward from the hips to about 45 degrees, knees soft and back flat.
Let the bar hang at arm's length in front of your knees.
Pull the bar to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows tucked by your sides.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly to straight arms.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.
shorthand: barbell reverse grip bent over row

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder-width.
Lift your chest and lean back only a little.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows in front of your body and close.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way up.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grab it with your palms facing up at about shoulder width.
Stand upright with your elbows tucked to your sides and forearms angled up.
Breathe out and push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Breathe in and let the bar rise slowly to about chest height.

exercises.name: Ring Dips
instructions: Set the rings at about hip height, grip them and jump or press up to a support position with straight arms at your sides.
Turn the rings slightly out and keep them close to your body.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower yourself until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Keep the rings tight to your sides so they don't drift apart.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms, turning the rings out at the top.

exercises.name: Rocking Frog Stretch
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then slide your knees out wide to the sides.
Keep your shins parallel to each other, ankles in line with your knees and feet flexed.
Lower onto your forearms if that is comfortable.
Breathe out and slowly rock your hips back toward your heels until you feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
Breathe in and rock forward again, continuing the gentle motion for 30 to 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Rocky Pull-Up Pulldown
instructions: Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Pull up in front until your upper chest is near the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
On the next rep, tilt your head forward and pull up so the bar passes behind your head.
Lower slowly again, and keep alternating front and back.
Breathe out on each pull and in on each lowering.

exercises.name: Roll Overs Into V Sits
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight together and your arms by your sides, palms down.
Breathe in, lift your legs to vertical, then use your abs to roll your hips up and take your legs back over your head, keeping the weight on your upper back, not your neck.
Roll back down slowly, lowering your spine to the mat one part at a time.
As your hips touch down, carry the momentum forward and sit up into a V, balancing just behind your sit bones with legs and arms reaching forward.
Breathe out as you rise, hold the V briefly, then round your back and roll down with control to start again.

exercises.name: Roller Back Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and place a foam roller across your back just below your shoulder blades.
Support your head with your hands and lift your hips slightly or keep them down.
Breathe out and let your upper back arch gently back over the roller.
Come back up, move the roller a little higher, and repeat.
Work along the upper back for about a minute, avoiding the lower back.

exercises.name: Roller Body Saw
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your shins resting on a foam roller.
Tighten your abs and glutes so your body is straight from head to heels.
Push through your forearms to slide your body back, letting the roller move toward your ankles.
Go only as far as you can without your lower back sagging, breathing steadily.
Pull yourself forward again with your shoulders and abs until your elbows are back under your shoulders.

exercises.name: Roller Hip Lat Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place a foam roller in front of you with both hands resting on it.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Roll the roller forward, letting your chest sink toward the floor and your arms stretch out.
Shift your hips slightly to the right to feel more stretch along the left side, then to the left.
Breathe deeply into the stretch, holding each side for 20 to 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Roller Hip Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and place a foam roller across the floor under your pelvis.
Hug both knees toward your chest to find your balance on the roller.
Keep holding your right knee and slowly lower your left leg straight toward the floor.
Let the left leg hang and relax until you feel the stretch at the front of the left hip.
Breathe slowly for 20 to 30 seconds, then bring the leg back up and switch.

exercises.name: Roller Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on a foam roller placed along your spine so your head and tailbone are supported, and rest your hands on the floor for balance.
Lift your feet with your knees bent at about a right angle over your hips.
Tighten your abs and breathe out as you curl your hips up, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Stay centered on the roller without tipping to either side.
Breathe in and lower your hips slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Roller Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with your legs straight out in front of you.
Hold a foam roller horizontally with both hands, arms straight in front of your chest.
Breathe in and slowly raise the roller overhead as far as you can without arching your lower back.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades down and back while keeping your arms long.
Breathe out and lower the roller back to chest height with control.

exercises.name: Roller Seated Single Leg Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor
aliases: seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Hold a foam roller horizontally in both hands with arms straight in front of you.
Breathe in and lift the roller overhead slowly, keeping your torso upright and your ribs down.
Draw your shoulder blades down and back at the top and hold for a breath.
Breathe out and lower the roller to the start.
Switch which leg is straight halfway through.

exercises.name: Roller Side Lat Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your armpit, roller across your body.
Reach your bottom arm straight overhead and bend your top leg to support yourself.
Roll slowly down a few centimetres toward your ribs and back up.
Pause on tender spots and breathe until they ease.
Roll for 30 to 60 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Unlock your knees slightly and keep that bend fixed.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees slightly and keep them at that angle for the whole set.
Breathe in and push your hips back, sliding the dumbbells down close to your legs.
Keep your back flat and your neck in line until you feel a strong stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Breathe out, squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Rope Climb
instructions: Grab the rope as high as you can with both hands and hang with straight arms.
Lift your knees and wrap the rope around one leg, pinching it between your feet.
Stand up on the rope with your feet while reaching higher with your hands.
Repeat: pull, lift your knees, lock your feet, stand and reach.
Climb down slowly hand under hand, using your feet to control speed.
Never slide down with your hands; keep a steady breath throughout.

exercises.name: Rope Hammer Curl (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold one end of the rope in each hand with thumbs up and arms straight.
Breathe out and curl the rope toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Pull the rope ends slightly apart at the top and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it with a slight forward lean.
Hold the rope ends with thumbs up and elbows pinned to your sides, forearms about level with the floor.
Breathe out and push the rope down until your arms are straight.
Pull the rope ends apart at the bottom and squeeze the triceps.
Breathe in and let the rope rise slowly back to the start without moving your elbows.

exercises.name: Roundhouse Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your guard up.
Lift your rear knee out to the side, raising it to the height you want to kick.
Pivot on your standing foot so your heel turns toward the target.
Rotate your hips over and snap the lower leg around, striking with the shin or top of the foot.
Bring the leg back the same way and land in your stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Strap your feet in and sit tall with your arms straight, holding the handle.
Push with your legs first, then swing your body back slightly, then pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse the order to return: arms out, lean forward from the hips, then bend your knees.
Keep a steady rhythm; the drive is quick and the return is slower.

exercises.name: Run (equipment)
instructions: Step onto the treadmill, clip on the safety key and start at a slow walk.
Raise the speed gradually over a few minutes until you reach an easy running pace.
Run tall with relaxed shoulders, eyes forward and arms swinging at your sides.
Land under your body with short, quick steps instead of long reaching strides.
Breathe steadily; you should be able to say a few words at a time.
Slow back to a walk for a few minutes before stopping.

exercises.name: Runners Stretch
instructions: Kneel on your left knee with your right foot flat in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor on either side of the right foot.
Shift your hips back toward your left heel and straighten your right leg, pulling the toes up.
Keep your back long and fold gently over the right leg until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Warm up with 5 minutes of brisk walking or light jogging.
Start running at a pace where you can still talk in short sentences.
Keep your posture tall, lean very slightly forward from the ankles and relax your hands.
Take light, quick steps and let your feet land under your hips.
Breathe in a steady rhythm through your nose and mouth.
Finish with a few minutes of easy walking to cool down.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back until your abs are tight.
Lift your feet a little off the floor and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your shoulders to the right and bring your hands beside your right hip.
Turn through the middle to the left side.
Keep your chest open and your back long, and breathe out on each turn.

exercises.name: Scapula Dips
instructions: Support yourself on dip bars with your arms straight.
Let your shoulders rise toward your ears so your body sinks slightly, without bending your elbows.
Breathe out and push your shoulders down away from your ears to lift your body.
Hold the top for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat with straight arms the whole time.

exercises.name: Scapula Push-Up
instructions: Get into a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keep your arms straight and your stomach tight for the whole set.
Breathe in and let your chest drop slightly so your shoulder blades pinch together.
Breathe out and push the floor away so your shoulder blades spread apart and your upper back rises.
Pause briefly at the top, then repeat slowly.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip at shoulder-width and straight arms.
Let your shoulders rise toward your ears in a relaxed hang.
Keeping your elbows straight, pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body lifts a few centimetres.
Hold the top position for a second or two.
Lower slowly back to the relaxed hang.
Breathe out as you pull down and in as you relax.

exercises.name: Scissor Jumps
instructions: Stand with one foot a step in front of the other, knees slightly bent.
Jump up and switch your legs in the air so the back foot lands in front.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees bent.
Spring straight into the next jump and switch again.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs, keep your chest up, and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench with the cambered bar on the floor or rack beneath you.
Grab the bar overhand at about shoulder-width and let it hang with straight arms.
Keep your chest on the bench and your legs still.
Row the bar up as high as you can, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower it slowly to a full stretch.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Seated Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with feet planted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang beside the bench with palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Keep your torso still and squeeze at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform, heels off.
Adjust the knee pads so they sit snugly on your lower thighs.
Lift your heels slightly and release the safety lever.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable for a full stretch.
Breathe out and press up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly; reset the safety lever after the set.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight in front of you and the other knee bent, foot flat.
Sit up tall and keep the knee of the straight leg pressed gently toward the floor.
Reach forward and hold the ball of the foot, then pull the toes back toward you.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly; do not bounce.
Let go, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Seated Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and rest your right ankle on your left thigh just above the knee.
Put your right hand on the floor behind you and sit up tall.
Use your left hand to gently press your right knee down until you feel the stretch in the right glute.
Breathe slowly and hold for about 30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit tall on the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Brace your stomach and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Keep your wrists level with your elbows at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the pivot and the lower pad sits just above your heels.
Sit with your back against the pad and lower the thigh pad until it holds your legs firmly.
Hold the handles and pull the pad down and back by bending your knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings when your knees are fully bent.
Let the pad return slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Breathe out as you curl and in as you return.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Raise
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands on the floor slightly behind your hips.
Lean back a little and brace your abs, keeping your chest lifted.
Breathe out and raise both straight legs a few centimeters to a comfortable height.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly until your heels nearly touch the floor.

exercises.name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
instructions: Sit near the front of a chair with your feet flat and a little wider than hip-width.
Sit tall, then slowly bend forward from your hips.
Let your chest move toward your thighs and your arms hang down toward the floor.
Relax your neck and breathe slowly, feeling the stretch in your back.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Roll back up slowly, one section of your spine at a time.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with back support and hold the bar at your upper chest, hands just outside shoulder width.
Plant your feet, brace your stomach and keep your back against the pad.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it passes your face.
Finish with your arms straight and the bar over the middle of your head.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the front half of a chair or bench with both feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee and let the right knee drop out to the side.
Place your hands lightly on your right shin and knee.
Keeping your back straight, lean forward from the hips until you feel the stretch deep in the right glute.
Breathe slowly and hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a close handle to the low pulley and sit with your feet on the platform.
Grab the handle and sit up tall with your arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your stomach, driving your elbows back past your body.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let the handle move forward slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your chest up.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest, and press your chest lightly against the pad.
Grab the handles with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows straight back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch down.

exercises.name: Seated Side Crunch (wall)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall, knees bent and feet flat.
Place your fingertips by your ears with your elbows wide.
Breathe out and bend sideways, bringing your right elbow down toward your right hip while your back slides along the wall.
Come back to upright with control.
Repeat to the left side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
instructions: Sit on the floor and open your legs as wide as is comfortable, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
Sit up tall, using your hands behind you if your lower back rounds.
Breathe out and walk your hands forward between your legs, folding from the hips with a long back.
Hold for a few breaths, then walk your hands back up.
Turn your chest toward the right leg and fold over it for a few breaths.
Come back to the middle and repeat over the left leg.

exercises.name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
instructions: Kneel on a soft mat and hook your heels under something heavy and stable, or have a partner hold your ankles.
Keep your body straight from knees to head and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and slowly lean forward from the knees, resisting with your hamstrings for as long as you can.
When you can no longer hold it, catch yourself with your hands like a push-up.
Give a small push off the floor and pull with your hamstrings to bring your body back up.
Breathe out as you return to the start.

exercises.name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (Hands on Bench)
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your heels anchored under a fixed object and place a bench or box in front of you.
Rest your hands on the bench and keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, letting your hamstrings take as much of your weight as they can.
Walk your hands forward along the bench or let your arms bend to control the lowering.
Pull back up with your hamstrings, pushing with your arms only as much as you need.
Breathe out as you pull back to upright; keep your hips from bending.

exercises.name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (on Floor)
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your heels hooked under a heavy, fixed object or held by a partner.
Keep a straight line from your knees to your head, glutes squeezed and arms ready in front of your chest.
Slowly lower your body forward, resisting with your hamstrings for as long as you can.
Catch yourself on your hands as you near the floor, landing in a push-up position.
Give a small push off the floor and pull with your hamstrings to return to tall kneeling.
Breathe out as you pull back up; use less hand push as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Semi Squat Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and lower into a half squat, arms back.
Swing your arms forward and jump straight up, pushing through your feet.
Straighten your body fully in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, rolling to the heels and sinking back into the half squat.
Reset your balance and jump again, breathing out on each jump.

exercises.name: Short Stride Run
instructions: Stand tall in an open space or on a treadmill, arms bent about 90 degrees.
Start jogging with short steps so each foot lands under your hips, not out in front.
Land lightly on the midfoot and keep your knees soft.
Increase your step rate while keeping the strides short.
Swing your arms in rhythm, stay relaxed through the shoulders, and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Shoulder Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip directly above your shoulders.
Squeeze your legs together and tighten your stomach to stop swinging.
Breathe out and pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Keep your elbows pointing down and slightly forward.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Plant your feet and keep your back against the pad.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your shoulders.
Don't bang the dumbbells together at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly until they are level with your ears or a little lower.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your shoulders, and sit with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles with an overhand grip just wider than your shoulders.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly without locking your elbows hard.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your hands are near shoulder height.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a bench with a backrest almost upright under the Smith bar.
Sit with your back against the pad, grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Breathe in and lower the bar until it is level with your chin.
Breathe out and press it up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back on the pad and rack the bar at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Shoulder Tap
instructions: Get into a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your feet a little wider than hip-width.
Tighten your abs and glutes so your body is straight from head to heels.
Shift your weight slightly and lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the floor and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips as still as possible, moving slowly and breathing steadily; widen your feet if your hips rock.

exercises.name: Shoulder Tap Push-Up
instructions: Set up in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet about hip-width apart.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press back up.
At the top, lift your right hand and tap your left shoulder, then put it back down.
Tap your right shoulder with your left hand, then go into the next push-up.
Keep your hips as still as possible during the taps and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Shrug (Barbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your hips.
Keep your arms straight and your chin level.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second and squeeze your traps.
Lower your shoulders all the way down slowly for a full stretch.
Avoid rolling your shoulders; move straight up and down.

exercises.name: Shrug (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and stand close, holding it in front of your thighs.
Stand tall with straight arms and your stomach tight.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulders are fully down.
Keep your arms straight; the movement comes only from the shoulders.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your arms straight and your neck relaxed.
Lift your shoulders straight up as high as you can.
Squeeze your traps at the top for a second.
Lower slowly all the way down.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Shrug (Machine)
instructions: Stand or sit in the machine and take the handles at your sides with straight arms.
Stand tall with your chest up and chin level.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the smith bar at mid-thigh height and stand facing it.
Grab it overhand just outside your thighs and unhook it.
Stand tall with straight arms and your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly, then lower slowly to a full stretch.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Shuffle
instructions: Stand with feet a bit wider than hips, knees bent, hips back and chest up.
Stay on the balls of your feet with your stomach tight.
Step sideways with the lead foot, then slide the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch or cross.
Keep your hips low and level and your knees in line with your toes.
After a few quick steps, plant the outside foot and shuffle back the other way, breathing in rhythm.

exercises.name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Rest your free hand on your hip or behind your head.
Slowly bend sideways toward the dumbbell, sliding it down the side of your leg.
Pull yourself back upright using the opposite side of your waist.
Keep your chest facing forward the whole time, then switch hands after your reps.

exercises.name: Side Bridge Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your right side and prop yourself on your right forearm, elbow under the shoulder.
Stack your legs and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep the hips high and lift your top leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Lower the leg with control without letting the hips drop.
Breathe steadily throughout, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: Side Hip (on Parallel Bars)
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms, shoulders pushed down and legs hanging.
Brace your abs and keep your upper body still.
Breathe out and raise your knees up and toward your right side, rotating your hips.
Lower your legs slowly to the center.
Repeat toward your left side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Side Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or chair and rest one hand on it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the leg nearest the support, keeping a soft knee.
Lift the outside leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Stop before your upper body starts to lean away; keep your hips level.
Lower the leg slowly without letting it rest on the floor between reps.
Breathe out as you lift; finish your reps, then turn around for the other leg.

exercises.name: Side Kick
instructions: Stand sideways to the target with your hands up.
Lift your lead knee up toward your chest, pointing it slightly across your body.
Turn your standing foot so the heel points toward the target.
Push the leg straight out, striking with the heel and the outer edge of the foot.
Breathe out on the kick, pull the knee back in and set the foot down.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Lying Floor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side on a mat with your legs straight and your bottom arm under your head.
Cross your top leg behind your bottom leg and rest the foot on the floor.
Reach your top arm long over your head along the floor.
Let your top side lengthen from your hip to your fingertips.
Breathe into the stretch and hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side with your head resting on your lower arm.
Bend your top knee and place that foot flat on the floor in front of your bottom knee.
Straighten the bottom leg and flex the foot.
Breathe out and lift the bottom leg as high as you can without rolling your hips.
Breathe in and lower it slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall and let both arms hang relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your right ear moves toward your right shoulder.
Keep your left shoulder down; do not lift the right shoulder to meet your ear.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and breathe slowly.
Return to center and repeat on the left side.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked, and your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, without letting your hips sink or roll backward.
Lower your hips, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your right side next to a bench and place your left foot on top of it.
Prop up on your right forearm with the elbow under your shoulder.
Squeeze the inner thigh of the top leg and lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your bottom right leg up to touch the underside of the bench.
Lower the bottom leg slowly while keeping the hips up, breathing steadily.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Push Neck Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and hold the edge of the seat with your left hand to anchor that shoulder.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Place your right hand lightly on the left side of your head.
Let the weight of your hand add a gentle stretch; do not pull hard.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with slow breathing.
Release slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side Push-Up
instructions: Lie on your right side with your legs stacked and wrap your right arm around your waist or across your body.
Place your left palm on the floor in front of your right shoulder, fingers pointing toward your head.
Breathe out and press through your left hand to straighten the arm and lift your upper body off the floor.
Keep your hips and legs on the ground.
Breathe in and lower slowly; switch sides after the set.

exercises.name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and hold one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Turn that palm to face away from you with the fingers pointing up.
With your other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Stop at a mild stretch along the inside of the forearm and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and keep your elbow straight but relaxed.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side-To-Side Chin
instructions: Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Pull up until your chin is level with the bar.
At the top, move your chin toward your right hand, bending that arm more as the left arm straightens slightly.
Slide across toward your left hand while staying high.
Return to the centre and lower slowly to a full hang.
Breathe out as you pull up and keep breathing steadily as you move side to side.

exercises.name: Side-To-Side Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet a bit wider than shoulder width and your arms out to the sides.
Keep your hips centered and your abs lightly braced.
Bend sideways, sliding one hand down the outside of that leg toward your foot as the other arm rises.
Go only as far as is comfortable without leaning forward or back, breathing out as you bend.
Return to standing and bend to the other side, alternating smoothly.

exercises.name: Single Arm Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your feet set wide and one hand placed under the centre of your chest.
Put your free hand behind your back or on your hip.
Lower your body slowly as far as you can control, keeping your hips and shoulders level.
Press back up through your working hand without twisting your torso.
Do all reps on one side before switching, and breathe out as you press; practise on an incline first if needed.

exercises.name: Single Leg Board Jump
instructions: Stand on your right leg facing a line or low board on the floor a short distance ahead.
Bend into a quarter squat on the standing leg and swing your arms back.
Swing your arms forward and hop forward off the right foot.
Land on the same foot with the knee bent, keeping it in line with your toes.
Hold the landing for two seconds before the next hop.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Bridge With Outstretched Leg
instructions: Lie on your back with your left knee bent and foot flat, and your right leg straight on the floor.
Lift the right leg until it lines up with the bent left thigh.
Breathe out and push through your left heel to raise your hips, keeping the right leg straight in the air.
Stop when your body is straight from shoulders to knee and squeeze the left glute.
Breathe in and lower your hips without letting them tilt to one side.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Calf Raise (on A Dumbbell)
aliases: single leg calf raise on a db
instructions: Place a heavy hex dumbbell on the floor next to a wall so it cannot roll.
Step the ball of one foot onto the dumbbell's head with your heel off the back.
Hold the wall for balance and lift your other foot.
Lower your heel toward the floor until the calf stretches.
Breathe out and rise as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, and switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Single Leg Platform Slide
instructions: Stand tall with one foot on a slider or folded towel on a smooth floor and the other foot flat.
Brace your core and put most of your weight on the flat foot.
Slide the foot on the slider straight back as you bend the front knee and hinge slightly forward.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel and you feel the glute and hamstring of the front leg working.
Pull the sliding foot back in by pushing through the front heel to stand.
Breathe out as you rise; finish one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Single Leg Vertical Jump
instructions: Stand on your right foot with the left knee lifted slightly.
Bend the right knee into a quarter squat and swing your arms down and back.
Swing your arms up hard and jump straight up off the right foot.
Land softly on the same foot, letting the ankle, knee and hip bend together.
Steady yourself before the next jump, then switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a single handle to the high pulley and kneel or sit facing it.
Grip the handle with one hand, arm straight overhead.
Pull your elbow down to your side, bringing the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom and breathe out.
Let the handle rise slowly to a full stretch.
Finish the set and switch arms.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grip it with one hand, palm facing down.
Stand close to the machine with your elbow pinned to your side and bent to about a right angle.
Breathe out and push the handle down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly back to the start without moving your elbow, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, with your other foot on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your arm straight below your shoulder.
Keep your back flat and parallel to the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then switch sides after your set.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Seated Row (Cable)
aliases: cable seated one arm alternate row
instructions: Set two single handles on low pulleys, or on a dual-cable row, and sit facing them with your feet braced.
Hold one handle in each hand with your arms straight and your back upright.
Pull one handle to the side of your stomach while the other arm stays straight.
Return it slowly, then pull with the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid twisting toward the working side.
Breathe out on each pull and in as the arm goes forward.
shorthand: cable seated one arm alternate row

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on a step on the same-side foot, heel hanging off.
Hook the other foot behind your ankle and hold a wall or rail with your free hand.
Lower your heel below the step for a full stretch.
Breathe out and push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Finish the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Press (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back and hips flat against the pad and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Press the platform up, release the safety handles and rest the other foot on the frame.
Breathe in and bend the working knee to lower the platform slowly toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back starts to lift off the pad.
Breathe out and push through the whole foot to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Finish your reps, lock the safeties back in, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand on your left leg with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Soften the left knee and brace your stomach.
Breathe in and tip forward from the hips, letting the dumbbells hang straight down as your right leg extends back.
Stop when your body is close to parallel to the floor or when your back starts to round.
Breathe out and squeeze the left glute to return to standing.
Complete the set, then work the other leg.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a sturdy support with one hand.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Breathe in and bend your knees forward while leaning your upper body back, keeping a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower as far as you can control, letting your knees move well past your toes.
Breathe out and squeeze the quads to bring your knees back and return to standing.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, anchoring your feet under something sturdy if needed.
Cross your arms over your chest with your hands on the opposite shoulders.
Breathe out and curl up, lifting your head, then shoulders, then lower back until you are sitting upright.
Keep your arms on your chest the whole time.
Breathe in and roll back down slowly to the floor.

exercises.name: Sit-Up (Slow Roll-Down)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and anchored, and your arms crossed on your chest.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders up first.
Keep rising until your torso is upright, leading with your chest.
Breathe in and roll down slowly, lowering your back one section at a time.

exercises.name: Skater Hops
instructions: Stand on your right leg with a slight bend in the knee and your left foot lifted behind you.
Push off the right foot and jump sideways to the left.
Land softly on the left foot, bending the knee and sweeping the right foot behind the left ankle.
Swing your arms across your body for balance and keep the landing knee over your toes.
Bound straight back to the right and keep alternating, breathing in rhythm.

exercises.name: Ski Erg
instructions: Stand facing the machine with feet hip-width apart and take a handle in each hand above your head.
Pull the handles down in front of you by driving your arms down and hinging at your hips, bending your knees slightly.
Finish with your hands beside your thighs and your arms straight.
Stand back up and let your arms rise with the handles to the start.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe out on each pull.

exercises.name: Ski Step
instructions: Stand with feet together, knees slightly bent, and arms bent in front of you.
Hop sideways to the right, landing on both feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees bent.
Immediately hop back to the left.
Keep your shoulders facing forward, hips loose, and breathe in rhythm as you hop quickly.

exercises.name: Skin The Cat
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings with a shoulder-width grip.
Tuck your knees to your chest and lift your hips up.
Keep rotating backward, passing your legs between your arms, until your feet point toward the floor behind you.
Lower only as far as your shoulders comfortably allow and breathe.
Reverse the movement slowly, tucking your knees to return to the hang.

exercises.name: Skips
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent about 90 degrees and your eyes forward.
Step forward onto your left foot and do a small hop on it while driving your right knee up to hip height.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee drive.
Land lightly on the ball of the foot and step straight into the next hop on the other side.
Keep your chest up, contacts quick and breathing rhythmic as you travel forward.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Barbell)
aliases: barbell lying triceps extension skull crusher
bb lying triceps extension skull crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell straight above your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up for the whole set.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly to just above your forehead.
Pause briefly without letting the bar touch your head.
Breathe out and straighten your arms by squeezing the triceps.
shorthand: barbell lying triceps extension skull crusher

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your ears.
Stop when your forearms are about level with the bench.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift the dumbbells back up.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest on the angled grips, arms straight.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Stop when your forearms are about level with the bench.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Sled 45° Leg Wide Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back and hips flat against the pad.
Place your feet wider than your shoulders on the platform, toes turned slightly out.
Push the platform up, release the safeties and hold the side grips.
Lower the platform, letting your knees travel out in line with your toes.
Stop before your lower back rounds off the pad, then press back up through your heels.
Breathe in on the way down and out as you push; re-engage the safeties at the end.

exercises.name: Sled Calf Press On Leg Press
aliases: machine calf press on leg press
instructions: Sit in the leg press with your back flat on the pad and the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, heels off.
Press the platform up until your legs are straight but not locked, then release the safety stops.
Let your heels travel toward you slowly so you feel a stretch in the calves.
Push through the balls of your feet to point your toes and drive the platform away as far as you can.
Squeeze for a second at the top, then lower under control; breathe out as you push.
Lock the safety stops before you take your feet off.

exercises.name: Sled Closer Hack Squat
instructions: Step into the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet close together, about hip-width or narrower, in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and stand tall.
Bend your knees and lower slowly, letting your knees travel forward over your toes.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down, then push back up through your whole foot.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you press; lock the safeties when done.

exercises.name: Sled Forward Angled Calf Raise
instructions: Step onto the angled calf sled and place the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Rest your shoulders under the pads and hold the handles.
Straighten your legs to free the sled, keeping knees soft.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Breathe out and push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Sled Lying Calf Press
instructions: Lie on the sled machine's pad with your back flat and the balls of your feet on the lower part of the footplate.
