Press the sled up until your legs are straight but not locked, then release the safety catch.
Let your heels move toward you slowly to stretch the calves.
Point your toes and push the sled as high as it will go.
Squeeze for a moment, lower slowly, and breathe out on each push.
Re-engage the safety catch before stepping off.

exercises.name: Sled Lying Squat
instructions: Lie back on the machine's pad with your shoulders snug under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate, toes slightly out, and hold the handles.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety stop.
Bend your knees and let the sled come down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees or a little deeper.
Press through your heels to straighten your legs without locking your knees hard.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you push; set the safety stop when finished.

exercises.name: Sled One Leg Calf Press On Leg Press
aliases: one leg calf press on leg press
machine one leg calf press on leg press
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the platform; rest the other foot on the floor or tuck it away.
Straighten the working leg to lift the platform, keep a slight bend in the knee, and release the safety stops.
Lower the heel slowly until the calf is fully stretched.
Press through the ball of the foot to push the platform as high as you can.
Pause at the top, lower with control, and breathe out on each push.
Finish your set, lock the stops, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled and grip the upright handles with your arms extended or bent.
Lean into the sled with a flat back, your body at about a 45-degree angle.
Drive it forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Count each length as one rep.

exercises.name: Sledge Hammer
instructions: Stand facing a large tire with your feet shoulder-width apart, far enough back to strike its center, and make sure the area around you is clear.
Hold the handle with one hand near the end and the other higher up near the head.
Raise the hammer up and over your shoulder, keeping your back straight.
Swing it down onto the tire, sliding your top hand down the handle and bending your knees as it lands, breathing out hard.
Let the hammer bounce up, reset your grip and switch sides every few strikes.

exercises.name: Smith Back Shrug
instructions: Set the smith bar at about mid-thigh height and stand in front of it with your back to the bar.
Reach back and grab it with an overhand grip at shoulder-width, then unhook it.
Stand tall with your arms straight and the bar resting just behind your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Smith Behind Neck Press
instructions: Place an upright bench under the Smith bar so the bar runs just behind your head.
Sit tall, grip the bar wider than your shoulders and unrack it with straight arms.
Breathe in and lower the bar behind your head to about ear level.
Breathe out and press it back up until your arms are straight.
Stop if you feel any pinching, and rack the bar by turning your wrists at the end.

exercises.name: Smith Bent Knee Good Morning
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height, step under and rest it on your upper back.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and unrack the bar.
Bend your knees noticeably and keep that bend throughout.
Push your hips back and lower your chest toward the floor with a flat back until your torso is near level.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Breathe in as you hinge and out as you rise; rack the bar by turning it into the hooks.

exercises.name: Smith Bent Over Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and stand close to it.
Grip the bar overhand a little wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees until your back is close to level, keeping it flat.
Pull the bar to your lower stomach and squeeze your shoulder blades together, breathing out.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Smith Chair Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it on your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart and a little in front of the bar.
Unrack the bar and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down as if into a chair, keeping your shins close to vertical.
Stop when your thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive up through your heels.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise; rack the bar when done.

exercises.name: Smith Deadlift
instructions: Set the Smith bar at its lowest safe position, around mid-shin, and stand close with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and brace.
Rotate the bar off the hooks and stand up by pushing through your feet and driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, then bending your knees, until it is back at the start height.
Breathe out as you stand and in as you lower; hook the bar when finished.

exercises.name: Smith Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar so the bar is over your lower chest, then secure your legs and lie back.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it.
Lower it under control to your lower chest.
Press back up to straight arms without bouncing.
Exhale as you press and re-hook the bar before sitting up.

exercises.name: Smith Decline Reverse-Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench under the Smith bar with your legs secured.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart, and unhook it.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press back up until your arms are extended.
Use a lighter weight than usual until you are comfortable with the grip, and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Smith Full Squat
instructions: Set the bar just below shoulder height, step under it and rest it across your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of the bar, and unhook it.
Breathe in, brace your stomach and lower yourself by bending your knees and hips together.
Go down until your hips are below your knees, keeping your heels flat and back straight.
Breathe out and push up through your whole foot to standing.
Rehook the bar after the last rep.

exercises.name: Smith Hack Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it on your upper back.
Place your feet close together, about hip-width, and a step in front of the bar.
Unrack the bar, brace your core and lean your upper back into it.
Bend your knees and lower deep, letting your knees move forward while your torso stays upright.
Push through your whole foot to return to standing.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise; rack the bar at the end.

exercises.name: Smith Incline Reverse-Grip Press
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with your feet flat.
Take an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart and unhook the bar.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press back up in a straight line.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and breathe out on each press.

exercises.name: Smith Incline Shoulder Raises
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back holding the bar with straight arms above your shoulders.
Lock your elbows and keep them locked for every rep.
Let your shoulder blades sink back so the bar lowers a short distance.
Push the bar up by spreading your shoulder blades and reaching your shoulders forward.
Pause at the top, lower slowly, and breathe out as you reach.

exercises.name: Smith Leg Press
instructions: Set the Smith bar low and lie on your back under it on a mat, hips roughly below the bar.
Place the middle of both feet on the bar, shoulder-width apart, with your knees bent toward your chest.
Press the bar up a little and rotate it off the hooks with your hands, then hold the frame or rest your arms by your sides.
Lower the bar by bending your knees until they are near your chest, keeping your lower back on the floor.
Press through your heels to straighten your legs without locking your knees.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you press; set the safety stops before starting.

exercises.name: Smith Low Bar Squat
instructions: Step under the bar and rest it across the back of your shoulders, just below the top of the traps.
Grip the bar wider than your shoulders and squeeze your shoulder blades together to make a shelf.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly forward, then unhook the bar.
Breathe in, brace, and push your hips back as you bend your knees, letting your chest tilt forward a little.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor while keeping your back flat.
Breathe out and drive your hips and shoulders up together to stand.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about mid-thigh height and grip it underhand at shoulder width.
Unhook the bar and stand tall, close to it, with your arms straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest, letting your elbows travel slightly forward so the bar can rise straight up.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly, then rehook the bar when done.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Decline Close Grip Bench Press
aliases: machine decline close grip bench press
smith decline close grip bench press
instructions: Set a decline bench under the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your lower chest, and lock your legs in.
Grip the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart or slightly closer.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your lower chest, elbows tucked close to your sides.
Breathe out and press it up until your arms are straight.
Rotate the bar to re-hook it when your set is done.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Tricep Extension
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith machine so the bar travels over your upper face.
Grip the bar with your hands a little narrower than shoulder-width and unhook it with arms straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows, letting them travel slightly forward, to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop a few centimeters above your head and keep your elbows narrow.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to press the bar back up.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Decline Close Grip Bench Press
aliases: machine reverse decline close grip bench press
smith reverse decline close grip bench press
instructions: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar so the bar lines up with your lower chest, then lie back with your feet hooked in.
Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands about shoulder-width or slightly narrower.
Unhook the bar and hold it over your lower chest with straight arms.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your body.
Breathe out and press back up without letting your wrists bend back.
Rack the bar when you finish.

exercises.name: Smith Narrow Row
instructions: Set the smith bar around knee height and stand close to it.
Grip the bar overhand with your hands a little narrower than your shoulders and unhook it.
Hinge forward with soft knees and a flat back until your chest is well forward.
Row the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly to straight arms without changing your back angle.
Breathe out as you row and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Smith One Arm Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and stand beside it.
Hinge forward with a flat back and place your free hand on your thigh or a bench.
Grip the middle of the bar with one hand and unrack it.
Pull the bar toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side, and breathe out.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish the set and switch sides.

exercises.name: Smith One Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height, step under it, and rest it across your upper back.
Unrack the bar and stand on one foot, hooking the other foot behind your ankle.
Keep your body tall and your standing knee straight but not locked.
Rise onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Hold for a second, then lower your heel slowly back to the floor.
Complete the set, rack the bar, and switch legs.

exercises.name: Smith Rear Delt Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and grip it with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and hinge forward with a flat back until your upper body is almost level with the floor.
Breathe out and pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows out wide.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders at the top.
Breathe in and lower the bar until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Smith Reverse Calf Raises
instructions: Lock the Smith bar at about chest height and place a step or plate just in front of it.
Face the bar, hold it with both hands, and put the balls of your feet on the edge of the step with your heels hanging off.
Let your heels sink below the step until you feel the calves stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible, using the bar only for balance, not to pull yourself up.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly; breathe out on the way up.

exercises.name: Smith Reverse Calf Raises (Bar on Front of Shoulders)
aliases: reverse calf raises bar on front of shoulders
instructions: Set the Smith bar at upper-chest height and place a low step under it.
Stand facing the bar and rest it across the front of your shoulders, hands holding it lightly.
Place the balls of your feet on the step with your heels hanging off.
Unhook the bar and let your heels drop for a stretch.
Breathe out and rise as high as you can onto your toes, then pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly; rehook the bar when you finish.

exercises.name: Smith Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and grip it with palms facing forward, shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hinge at the hips with soft knees and a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your belly button, elbows tucked in.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and breathe out.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Smith Reverse-Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your lower chest.
Grip the bar underhand, palms facing your face, about shoulder-width apart, and unhook it.
Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows tucked in.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Start light while you learn the grip, and breathe out as you press.

exercises.name: Smith Seated One Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Place a bench under the Smith machine and a low step or plate in front of it.
Sit down, put the ball of one foot on the step, and lower the bar onto a pad across that thigh just above the knee.
Unrack the bar and let the heel drop below the step for a stretch.
Push through the ball of the foot to lift the bar as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly, and keep breathing steadily.
Rack the bar after the set and switch legs.

exercises.name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Place a bench under the Smith bar so the bar comes down just in front of your face.
Sit tall, grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your upper chest or chin level.
Breathe out and press it straight up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back upright throughout and rack the bar when done.

exercises.name: Smith Seated Wrist Curl
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and place a bench in front of it.
Sit down and grab the bar with palms facing up, resting your forearms on your thighs and your wrists past your knees.
Unhook the bar and let it lower toward your fingertips.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can, keeping your forearms flat on your thighs.
Pause, then lower slowly; breathe out as you curl.
Rotate the bar to hook it back on the rack when the set is done.

exercises.name: Smith Sprint Lunge
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height, rest it on your upper back and unrack it.
Take a split stance with one foot forward and the other back on the ball of the foot.
Lower until your back knee is just above the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand and, in the same motion, bring the back knee forward and up to hip height.
Pause briefly balanced on one leg, then step the foot back into the split stance.
Breathe out as you drive up; finish one side before switching.

exercises.name: Smith Standing Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about mid-thigh height and stand with your back to it.
Reach behind you and grip the bar with palms facing backward, hands shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with your arms straight.
Let the bar roll toward your fingers so your wrists open.
Breathe out and curl the bar up by bending your wrists, keeping your arms still.
Lower slowly, then rehook the bar when the set is done.

exercises.name: Smith Standing Behind Head Military Press
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and stand with the bar behind your head, feet hip-width apart.
Grip the bar wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Brace your stomach and press the bar up until your arms are straight, breathing out.
Breathe in and lower it behind your head to about ear level.
Keep your head slightly forward and stop if your shoulders pinch.

exercises.name: Smith Standing Military Press
instructions: Set the Smith bar at upper chest height and stand facing it with feet hip-width apart.
Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it at your upper chest.
Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes and press up until your arms are straight, breathing out.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your upper chest.
Stand still without bending your knees to help.

exercises.name: Smith Sumo Squat
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height, step under it and rest it across your upper back.
Place your feet well wider than shoulder-width with toes turned out about 45 degrees.
Unhook the bar and brace your stomach.
Breathe in and lower straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, then breathe out and drive up through your heels.
Rehook the bar after your last rep.

exercises.name: Smith Toe Raise
instructions: Set the bar just below shoulder height, step under it, and rest it on your upper back.
Unrack the bar and stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Keep your knees straight but soft and your core tight.
Rise up onto your toes, pressing evenly through the big and little toe.
Hold briefly, then lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Breathe out as you rise and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Smith Upright Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at mid-thigh height and grip it with an overhand grip about shoulder width.
Unrack it and stand tall with the bar against your thighs.
Breathe out and lift your elbows up and out to bring the bar toward your chest.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly.

exercises.name: Smith Wide Grip Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so the bar lines up with your mid-chest, and lie back with your feet flat.
Grip the bar about one and a half times shoulder-width and pull your shoulder blades together.
Twist the bar to unhook it and hold it over your chest with straight arms.
Breathe in and lower the bar to your mid-chest under control.
Breathe out and press it back up, stopping just before your elbows lock.
Twist the bar back onto the hooks when the set is done.

exercises.name: Smith Wide Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar so the bar is over your lower chest, then lie back with your feet hooked in.
Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width and set your shoulder blades back and down.
Unhook the bar and hold it over your lower chest with straight arms.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until it lightly touches your lower chest.
Breathe out and press it back up, keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Rack the bar before sitting up.

exercises.name: Snatch (Barbell)
instructions: Set up over the bar with a wide grip, hips higher than your knees and your back flat.
Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips explosively as the bar reaches your upper thighs, then pull yourself under it.
Catch the bar overhead on straight arms in a squat, then stand up with it.

exercises.name: Snatch (Kettlebell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge at the hips and grip a kettlebell on the floor with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs with a flat back.
Snap your hips forward and pull the kettlebell up close to your body.
Punch your hand up so the kettlebell turns over softly onto your forearm as your arm locks overhead.
Bring it back down in front of you into the next swing, and switch hands after your set.

exercises.name: Snatch Pull
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip it wide, with hands far enough apart that the bar would sit in your hip crease when standing.
Set your hips lower than in a deadlift, chest up, back flat and arms straight.
Push the floor away and lift the bar smoothly past your knees, keeping it close.
As it reaches your upper thighs, extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively and shrug your shoulders up.
Keep your arms long; let the bar float, then lower it back to the floor with control.
Brace before each pull and breathe out after the finish.

exercises.name: Spell Caster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand beside your right hip.
Brace your abs and keep your knees soft.
Rotate to the left, sweeping both dumbbells up across your body to about shoulder height on the left side.
Let your right foot pivot as your hips turn.
Bring the dumbbells back to your left hip, then sweep them across to the right side.

exercises.name: Sphinx
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight and the tops of your feet on the floor.
Place your elbows under your shoulders and your forearms flat on the floor.
Press through your forearms to lift your chest, keeping your hips on the mat.
Draw your shoulders down away from your ears and relax your glutes.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20 to 40 seconds, then lower down.

exercises.name: Spider Crawl Push Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
As you bend your elbows to lower, lift one foot and bring that knee out to the side toward the same elbow.
Keep the knee off the floor and your hips low and level.
Press back up and return the foot to the plank.
Repeat with the other knee on the next push-up.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you press.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lie chest-down on the angled side of a preacher bench or an incline bench so your arms hang straight down.
Hold an EZ bar underhand on the grips.
Breathe out and curl the bar up toward your chest, keeping your upper arms vertical.
Squeeze hard at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Spin Back Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your left foot forward and guard up.
Turn on the front foot and spin backward, looking over your right shoulder at the target.
Bring your right knee up close to your chest as you turn.
Drive the heel straight back toward the target, keeping the foot flat and the toes pointing down.
Pull the leg back in, finish the turn and land facing forward in your stance.
Repeat, then practise on the other side.

exercises.name: Spin Hook Kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your left foot forward and hands up.
Turn on the ball of your front foot and spin your body backward, looking over your right shoulder.
As you turn, lift your right leg and extend it outward.
Keep spinning and bend the knee to whip the heel through the target.
Finish the turn and land back in your stance, facing forward.
Practise slowly first, then add speed.

exercises.name: Spine Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a mat with your legs straight and a little wider than hip-width.
Reach your arms forward at shoulder height.
Breathe out and roll forward one part of your spine at a time, starting with your head.
Reach toward your feet while pulling your stomach in.
Breathe in and roll back up slowly to sitting tall.

exercises.name: Spine Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, toes pointing up, a little wider than hip-width.
Sit up tall and stretch your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Breathe out and turn your upper body to one side, keeping your hips still and your arms in line with your shoulders.
Breathe in and come back to the center, growing taller.
Turn to the other side, alternating smoothly.

exercises.name: Split Squat
instructions: Stand tall and take a long step forward with your right foot, back heel lifted.
Put your hands on your hips and keep your chest up.
Breathe in and lower straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your weight in the front heel.
Breathe out and push up through the front foot without moving your feet.
Finish the set, then switch the front leg.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Barbell)
aliases: bb split squat bar on back
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back and step back from the rack.
Step one foot forward into a long stance, back heel lifted and feet about hip-width apart side to side.
Breathe in, brace and lower your back knee straight toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee in line with the toes.
Breathe out and push through the front heel to rise without stepping.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and take a long step forward into a staggered stance.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, front shin close to vertical.
Push through your front foot to rise, staying in the split stance.
Finish the set on one side before switching legs.

exercises.name: Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back from a rack and step out with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.
Grip the bar firmly and squeeze your shoulder blades together to make a shelf for it.
Breathe in, brace and sit straight down, letting your knees travel forward over your toes.
Keep going until your hips are as low as they can go with your heels down and back flat.
Drive up through your feet, keeping your chest up so your hips and shoulders rise together.
Breathe out near the top.

exercises.name: Squat (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the bar just below shoulder height and step under so it rests across your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of the bar, toes turned a little out.
Unrack the bar by rotating it off the hooks and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise; rotate the bar back onto the hooks when done.

exercises.name: Squat Jerk
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with a full grip, feet hip-width apart.
Take a breath, brace and dip a short distance straight down by bending your knees.
Drive up hard through your legs to launch the bar off your shoulders.
Push yourself down under the bar into a deep squat as your arms lock out overhead.
Stabilize with the bar over the middle of your feet, then stand up with it.
Lower the bar to your shoulders with control, breathing out once it is secured.

exercises.name: Squat On Bosu Ball
instructions: Place the BOSU flat side up and step onto it carefully, feet near the outer edges.
Find your balance with your arms reaching forward and your stomach tight.
Breathe in and sit your hips back and down into a squat, keeping the platform level.
Go only as low as you can stay steady, with knees in line with your toes.
Breathe out and push through your heels to stand, then step off carefully when finished.

exercises.name: Squat To Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out a little.
Sit down into a deep squat, keeping your heels down and your chest up.
At the bottom, place your elbows inside your knees for a moment to open the hips.
Breathe in and raise both arms overhead as you stay low, lifting your chest.
Breathe out and stand up while keeping the arms reaching high, then lower them and repeat.

exercises.name: Squat To Overhead Reach With Twist
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down as deep as you comfortably can.
Keep your heels flat and rest your left hand on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your chest to the right and reach your right arm up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes.
Bring the arm back down, then twist to the left and reach the left arm up.
Return to the middle and stand up with both arms reaching overhead, breathing out as you rise.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Crunch (full Range Hands Behind Head)
aliases: crunch full range hands behind head
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward until your lower and middle back rest on it, feet flat and wide apart.
Rest your fingertips behind your head with your elbows open.
Breathe in and let your upper back extend back over the ball for a gentle stretch.
Breathe out and curl your chest up toward your hips, squeezing your abs without pulling your neck.
Lower slowly back over the ball to the stretched position.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
instructions: Hold the side rails and step onto the stairs, then start at a slow speed.
Stand upright and place your whole foot on each step.
Push through the heel and midfoot to climb, letting your glutes and thighs do the work.
Use the rails only for light balance; do not lean on them or hang your weight off them.
Raise the speed gradually and keep your breathing steady.
Slow down for the last minutes before stopping and stepping off.

exercises.name: Stalder Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and wide apart, and place your palms on the floor between your legs.
Lean your shoulders forward over your hands and press down hard to lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your arms straight and keep shifting forward while lifting your hips higher than your shoulders.
Once your hips are over your hands, raise your straddled legs slowly up and bring them together into a handstand.
Lower back down the same way with control; practice the parts against a wall until you have the strength.

exercises.name: Standing Archer
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and knees soft.
Reach both arms straight forward at shoulder height.
Turn your upper body to one side while pulling that elbow back as if drawing a bow, the other arm staying straight.
Follow your back hand with your eyes and breathe out as you turn.
Return to the centre and repeat to the other side, alternating.

exercises.name: Standing Behind Neck Press
instructions: Take a barbell from a rack onto your upper back, gripping it wider than your shoulders.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your stomach.
Breathe out and press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Breathe in and lower it behind your head to about ear level.
Use a light weight and stop if you feel pinching in the shoulder.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart, toes on a low step.
Brace your stomach and keep your chest up.
Let your heels drop slightly below the step.
Breathe out and press through your big toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly without letting the bar shift.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand on the edge of a step with your heels off.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and knees slightly soft.
Lower your heels until your calves stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly; lightly touch a wall if you need balance.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
instructions: Set the shoulder pads so you have to bend your knees slightly to get under them.
Step in, place the balls of your feet on the platform and rest the pads on your shoulders.
Straighten your legs to lift the weight, keeping knees soft.
Lower your heels until the calves are fully stretched.
Breathe out and drive up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in and lower slowly without bouncing.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and place a low block or plate under it.
Step under the bar, rest it across your upper back and put the balls of your feet on the block.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with knees straight but soft.
Lower your heels until you feel a stretch in the calves.
Breathe out and push up onto your toes as high as you can, then pause.
Breathe in, lower slowly, and rehook the bar after the set.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (on A Staircase)
instructions: Stand on the bottom stair facing up, holding the rail for balance.
Slide back so only the balls of your feet are on the step.
Let your heels sink below the step until the calves stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then lower slowly through the full range; breathe out on the way up.

exercises.name: Standing Calves
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart; lightly touch a wall if you need balance.
Tighten your stomach and keep your knees straight but not locked.
Push through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as you can.
Hold the top for a second without letting your ankles roll outward.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Calves Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall about a foot away.
Place the ball of one foot up against the wall with the heel on the floor.
Keep that leg straight and slowly move your hips toward the wall.
Stop when you feel a clear pull in the calf and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Breathe slowly, step back, and switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring And Calf Stretch With Strap
instructions: Stand tall and place your right heel about half a step in front of you with the leg straight.
Loop a strap around the ball of your right foot and hold both ends.
Bend your left knee slightly and push your hips back.
Pull the strap gently so your right toes come up toward you.
Keep your back flat and hold for 20 to 30 seconds when you feel the stretch behind the thigh and in the calf.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Raise your right arm straight overhead and rest your left hand on your hip.
Lean slowly to the left, reaching your right arm up and over.
Keep your hips centred and avoid leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then return to standing.
Switch arms and stretch the other side.

exercises.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft and hands on your hips.
Tighten your stomach and tuck your tailbone under so your lower back flattens.
Then tip your pelvis the other way so your lower back arches slightly.
Move slowly and keep your chest and shoulders still.
Breathe steadily and repeat for 10 to 15 slow rocks.

exercises.name: Standing Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes and keep your knees soft.
Breathe out and press both dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight.
Don't lean back or push with your legs.
Breathe in and lower slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Standing Single Leg Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for balance, feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto one leg with a soft knee.
Keeping your thighs side by side, bend the other knee and bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top without letting the knee move forward.
Lower the foot slowly to just above the floor.
Breathe out as you curl; finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Wheel Rollerout
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart and hold the ab wheel with both hands.
Bend forward and place the wheel on the floor in front of your feet, keeping your knees straight or barely bent.
Brace hard and roll the wheel forward slowly, letting your body lengthen toward the floor.
Stop at the furthest point you can hold without your lower back sagging.
Pull the wheel back toward your feet using your abs, breathing out as you return.

exercises.name: Star Jump
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and drop into a quarter squat with your hands near your knees.
Jump up as high as you can.
In the air, spread your arms and legs wide so your body forms an X.
Bring your legs back together before landing and land softly with bent knees.
Reset into the squat and jump again; breathe out as you explode up.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike Walk
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee stays slightly bent when the pedal is at its lowest point.
Sit tall, hold the handlebars lightly and strap your feet in if the pedals have straps.
Set a low resistance and start pedaling at a relaxed, steady speed.
Push through the middle of your foot and keep your knees in line with your toes.
Breathe easily; you should be able to hold a normal conversation.
Keep going for the planned time, then slow down gradually.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Barbell)
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench about knee height with a light bar on your upper back.
Place one whole foot firmly on the top of the box.
Lean slightly forward and drive through that heel to stand up on the box.
Bring the trailing foot up only at the end, without pushing off with it.
Step down slowly with the trailing foot first, controlling the descent with the top leg.
Breathe out as you step up; alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Step-Up (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box about knee height with a dumbbell at each side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel to lift yourself up until the leg is straight.
Bring the other foot up to meet it, then stand tall at the top.
Step down slowly with the same foot you brought up last, keeping control with the working leg.
Breathe out as you step up; alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: Stepdown Squat
instructions: Stand on a low step on your right foot with the left foot hanging off the side.
Put your hands on your hips or reach them forward for balance.
Breathe in and bend the right knee slowly, pushing your hips back, until the left heel lightly touches the floor.
Keep the right knee in line with your toes; do not let it cave inward.
Breathe out and push through the right foot to straighten back up.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar at your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your legs nearly straight with just a slight softness in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs, keeping your back flat.
Go down until your hamstrings are fully stretched or the bar is near your feet, without rounding your back.
Pull back up by driving your hips forward and squeezing your glutes.
Breathe in on the way down and out on the way up.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Straighten your legs, leaving only a slight bend in the knees, and keep it fixed.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells in front of your legs toward your feet.
Keep your back flat and go only as low as your hamstring flexibility allows.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand up.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise.

exercises.name: Straddle Maltese
instructions: Place your hands on parallettes or hold rings, arms straight and set much wider than your shoulders.
Turn your hands slightly out, lock your elbows and tighten your whole body.
Lean forward and lift your legs, spreading them wide as your body lowers toward horizontal.
Hold your body flat and close to hand level, abs and glutes tight, breathing steadily.
Lower your feet with control. Only attempt this after mastering the straddle planche.

exercises.name: Straddle Planche
instructions: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes about shoulder-width apart, fingers turned slightly out.
Lock your elbows, push the floor away and round your upper back slightly.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands until your feet become light.
Lift your legs off the floor, spread them wide and straighten your body until it is level with the floor.
Tighten your abs and glutes to stop your hips from sagging, hold while breathing steadily, then lower your feet with control.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Hip Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight, heels on the floor and toes pointing up.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest them by your sides.
Tighten your stomach and breathe out as you dig your heels into the floor to lift your hips.
Rise until your body is straight from shoulders to heels, without bending your knees.
Hold for a second, then breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Outer Hip Abductor
instructions: Lie on your side with both legs straight and stacked, head resting on your lower arm.
Place your top hand on the floor in front of your chest for balance.
Point your top toes slightly forward and keep the leg straight.
Breathe out and raise the top leg toward the ceiling, leading with the heel, without rolling your hips back.
Lower it slowly to just above the bottom leg, then finish the set and switch sides.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar, a step or two back.
Hold the bar overhand at shoulder-width with your arms straight and slightly raised.
Brace your stomach and keep a small bend in your knees.
Push the bar down to your thighs in a wide arc without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second, then let the bar return slowly.
Breathe out on the way down and in on the way up.

exercises.name: Strongman Car Flip
instructions: Stand close to the edge of the frame with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down to grip under it.
Set your back flat, chest up, and take a big breath to brace.
Drive through your legs and hips to lift the edge off the ground.
As it rises, step in, switch to a pushing grip and keep driving it upward.
Push it past its balance point until it tips over, breathing out as you push.
Reset your feet and grip before the next flip.

exercises.name: Strongman Fingal's Fingers
instructions: Stand at the free end of the pole with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down to grip under it.
Brace your stomach and keep your back flat.
Drive up with your legs and hips to lift the end of the pole to chest height.
Quickly switch your hands under it and press it overhead.
Walk forward under the pole, pushing it higher until it passes upright and falls the other way.
Move to the other side, reset and repeat.

exercises.name: Strongman Keg Toss
instructions: Make sure the area behind you is completely clear, then stand with feet shoulder-width apart, the keg between your feet.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips with a flat back to grip the keg by its handles or rims.
Swing it back between your legs to load your hips.
Drive your hips forward and stand up explosively, pulling the keg up past your face with straight arms.
Let go when it is above your head so it flies up and back over you.
Breathe out hard on the throw, then turn to watch where it lands before the next rep.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out, and the bar over your mid-foot.
Push your knees out over your toes and grip the bar with your hands inside your legs, about shoulder-width apart.
Drop your hips, lift your chest and flatten your back; take a big breath and brace.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes, then lower the bar the same way.
Breathe out at the top or once the bar is back down.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its end between your legs.
Sit your hips down between your heels, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Go as low as you can with a flat back and the dumbbell hanging straight down.
Stand back up by squeezing your glutes and inner thighs.

exercises.name: Superman Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your body straight and stomach braced.
Lower your chest quickly toward the floor.
Push up explosively, driving through your hands and toes so your whole body leaves the ground.
While in the air, shoot your arms forward and your legs slightly back.
Bring your hands and feet back under you and land softly with bent elbows, breathing out on each push.

exercises.name: Suspended Abdominal Fallout
instructions: Set the suspension straps at about waist height and stand facing away from the anchor, holding the handles in front of you.
Step back so you lean slightly forward with your arms straight and your body in one line.
Brace your abs and let your arms rise overhead as your body leans further toward the floor.
Go only as far as you can keep your hips from sagging.
Press the straps down and back to pull yourself to the start, breathing out on the way up.

exercises.name: Suspended Push-Up
instructions: Set the straps to hang about knee to mid-shin height, grip the handles and walk your feet back into a leaning plank.
Hold your arms straight under your shoulders and brace your stomach.
Lower your chest between your hands, keeping the straps from flaring out to the sides.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body rigid and breathe out as you press; walk your feet forward to make it easier.

exercises.name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
instructions: Put your feet in the foot cradles of a suspension trainer and walk your hands out into a high plank.
Brace your abs so your body is straight from head to heels.
Breathe out and pull your knees in toward your chest, rounding your lower back slightly.
Extend your legs back slowly to the plank without letting your hips drop.
Keep your hands under your shoulders throughout.

exercises.name: Suspended Row
instructions: Set the rings or straps at about chest height and hold one in each hand.
Lean back with straight arms and walk your feet forward until your body is angled.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach so your body stays in a straight line.
Pull yourself up until your hands are beside your chest, elbows driving back.
Lower slowly to straight arms; lower the angle to make it harder.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Suspended Split Squat
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer so the foot cradle hangs about knee height and stand facing away from the anchor.
Place the top of one foot in the cradle behind you and hop the other foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your hands on your hips or in front for balance.
Bend the front knee and lower straight down while the back leg extends behind you.
Push through the front heel to rise, keeping the strap steady.
Breathe out as you rise; finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Swimmer Kicks (Face Down)
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your legs straight and kick them up and down in small, quick alternating movements.
Keep your neck long by looking at the floor just ahead of you.
Breathe steadily and continue for the set time, then lower everything to the floor and rest.

exercises.name: Swimming
instructions: Swim at a pace you can hold, with any stroke.
Log the distance and the time.

exercises.name: Swing 360
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Raise your arms in front of you at shoulder height.
Swing both arms in a wide circle to one side, letting your torso and hips turn with them.
Let your heels pivot naturally so your knees and lower back are not twisted.
Keep the motion smooth and continuous, breathing freely, then switch direction.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Landmine)
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine base and load the free end.
Straddle the bar facing the plates and hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Hold the bar just behind the plates with both hands, or use a V-handle under the bar.
Pull the bar end up toward your chest, driving your elbows back.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Machine)
instructions: Step onto the platform and rest your chest against the angled pad.
Grab the handles with the grip you prefer and lift the weight off its rest.
Let your arms hang straight with your shoulders reaching down.
Row the handles up toward your chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you pull and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Three Bench Dip
instructions: Place two benches side by side about shoulder-width apart and a third in front of them.
Put one hand on each of the side benches and your heels on the front bench with legs straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows straight back until they reach about a right angle.
Keep your torso upright and shoulders down.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell at the front of your shoulders with a grip just outside shoulder width, elbows up, feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace your stomach and squat down with your chest up until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Drive up hard through your whole foot.
As your hips straighten, carry that drive into pressing the bar overhead, breathing out.
Lower the bar to your shoulders as you sink into the next squat.

exercises.name: Thruster (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in and squat down with your chest up until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Drive up hard through your feet.
As you stand, use that momentum to press the kettlebells overhead, breathing out.
Lower the kettlebells to your shoulders as you go into the next squat.

exercises.name: Tire Flip
instructions: Stand close to the tire with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down to grip under the edge with palms up.
Put your chest against the tire, keep your back flat and brace your stomach.
Drive with your legs and hips to push the tire up and forward at an angle.
As it rises, step in and switch your hands to a palms-forward push position.
Push the tire over with your arms and body, breathing out hard.
Walk up to it and reset your stance for the next flip.

exercises.name: Toe Touch Sit (wall)
instructions: Stand with your back lightly touching a wall and your feet a short step in front of it.
Brace your abs, shift your weight onto one leg and lift the other straight out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and down on the standing leg while reaching both hands toward the toes of the lifted leg.
Keep your chest lifted and the standing knee pointing over your toes.
Push through the standing heel to rise, then finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and your legs together.
Brace your abs and press the bar down slightly with straight arms.
Lift your legs, keeping them as straight as you can, until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs under control, without swinging into the next rep.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Step into the middle of the trap bar with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to grab the center of each handle.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and take a big breath to brace.
Push the floor away with your legs and stand up tall, keeping your arms straight.
Lower the bar by sitting your hips back and bending your knees until the plates touch the floor.
Breathe out at the top or after setting the bar down.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Step on with your feet on the side rails, clip on the safety key, and start the belt slowly.
Walk for a few minutes, then raise the speed to a light jog.
Run tall in the middle of the belt with short, light steps landing under your hips.
Keep your arms bent and swinging, and do not hold the rails while running.
Set the speed to an effort you can sustain, breathing in a steady rhythm.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes before stopping the belt.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walk
instructions: Stand on the side rails, attach the safety key, and start the belt at a slow speed.
Step onto the belt and begin walking near the middle.
Increase the speed to a brisk walk that raises your breathing.
Stand tall, swing your arms naturally, and avoid leaning on the rails.
Lower the speed for the last few minutes, then stop the belt before stepping off.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and press up so your arms are straight and your body hangs between them.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows pointing back.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower yourself until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Breathe out and press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid swinging your legs.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (between Benches)
instructions: Place two benches parallel, about a leg's length apart.
Sit on the edge of one with your hands beside your hips and rest your heels on the other bench, legs straight.
Slide your hips forward off the bench so your arms hold your weight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor, back close to the bench.
Breathe out and push through your palms to straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Triceps Dips Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat and hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward you.
Press into your hands to lift your hips a little off the floor.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor without touching down.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to lift back up.
Keep your elbows pointing back rather than out to the sides.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad and your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Breathe out and straighten your arms to push the handles down or forward.
Squeeze the triceps when your arms are straight.
Breathe in and return slowly to the bent-elbow position.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley, take it in one hand and step back facing the machine.
Hinge forward with a flat back and lift your working elbow so the upper arm is beside your torso, forearm hanging down.
Breathe out and straighten the arm back until it is fully extended.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Breathe in and let the forearm return slowly; switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly level with the floor, knees slightly bent.
Lift your elbows so your upper arms are beside your torso and parallel to the floor, forearms hanging down.
Breathe out and straighten your arms back until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze the triceps for a second without letting your upper arms drop.
Breathe in and bend your elbows slowly to return.

exercises.name: Triceps Press
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the edge of a sturdy bench or a bar set at about hip height.
Walk your feet back into an inclined plank with your body straight.
Breathe in and bend only your elbows, letting your forehead travel down toward the edge between your hands.
Keep your elbows pointing down and your body rigid.
Breathe out and press through your palms to straighten your arms and return.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grab it overhand at about shoulder width.
Stand close with feet hip-width apart, knees soft and elbows tucked to your sides.
Breathe out and press the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Hold the bottom for a moment and squeeze.
Breathe in and let the bar come up to about chest height, keeping your elbows fixed.

exercises.name: Triceps Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or the side of a door frame, about a step away.
Raise one arm, bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head, and rest the elbow on the wall above you.
Lean your chest gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch along the back of the arm.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Ease off and repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: Tuck Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet just off the floor, hands resting lightly behind your ears.
Tighten your abs and press your lower back into the mat.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders while drawing your knees toward your chest so they meet in the middle.
Squeeze your abs for a second at the top without pulling on your neck.
Breathe in and lower your shoulders and push your feet back out with control, keeping your feet off the floor.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Kettlebell)
aliases: kb turkish get up squat style
instructions: Lie on your back holding the kettlebell straight up over your shoulder in one hand, with the same-side knee bent and foot flat.
Keeping your eyes on the bell, roll up onto the opposite elbow and then onto that hand.
Drive through your bent leg to lift your hips, then sweep the straight leg under you so both feet are flat on the floor in a low squat.
With the arm locked overhead, stand up out of the squat, pushing through both feet.
Reverse the steps slowly: squat down, place the free hand on the floor, extend the leg, lower to the elbow and then to your back.
Breathe steadily throughout; switch arms after each set.

exercises.name: Twist Hip Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms spread out on the floor.
Breathe out and lift your hips into a bridge so your knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Keeping the hips up, slowly rotate them toward the right so the left hip lifts higher.
Return to the middle, then rotate toward the left.
Keep your glutes squeezed so your hips do not sag while you twist.
Lower your hips to the floor at the end of the set.

exercises.name: Twisted Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms spread wide on the floor for support.
Lift your legs with your knees bent so your feet hover just above the floor.
Breathe out and pull your knees in while rotating your hips, aiming your knees at one shoulder.
Breathe in and extend your legs back out to the hovering position.
Pull in again toward the opposite shoulder, keeping your upper back flat on the floor throughout.

exercises.name: Twisted Leg Raise (Bent Knees)
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms out to the sides, palms pressing into the floor.
Tighten your abs and bend your knees as you lift your feet off the floor.
Breathe out and draw your knees up toward your chest while turning your hips so your knees angle toward one shoulder.
Lower your legs slowly back toward the floor without letting them touch down.
Lift again and turn the other way, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Two Toe Touch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Raise your arms overhead and breathe in.
Breathe out and fold forward from the hips, reaching both hands toward your toes.
Keep your knees soft if you need to and let your head hang.
Pause for a moment, then roll up slowly to standing.

exercises.name: Two-Arm Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, so the cables cross in front of you.
Stand tall, brace your stomach and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Breathe out and raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly across your body.

exercises.name: Upper Back Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Interlace your fingers and push your palms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and let your head drop gently between your arms.
Feel your shoulder blades spread apart and keep breathing slowly.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then relax.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip a little narrower than your shoulders.
Stand tall with your stomach tight.
Breathe out and raise your elbows up and out, pulling the bar up close to your body.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height and the bar is at your chest.
Breathe in and lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it at your thighs with an overhand grip at about shoulder width.
Stand close to the machine, tall, with your stomach braced.
Breathe out and pull the bar up close to your body by lifting your elbows out to the sides.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower the bar slowly.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Brace your stomach and keep your chest up.
Breathe out and lift your elbows up and out, pulling the dumbbells up close to your body.
Stop when your elbows are at shoulder height.
Breathe in and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Upward Facing Dog
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and the tops of your feet on the mat.
Place your hands on the floor beside your lower ribs.
Breathe in and press your arms straight, lifting your chest and thighs off the floor.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and look forward.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower down slowly.

exercises.name: V-Bar Pushdown (Cable)
instructions: Attach the V-bar to a high pulley and hold it with your thumbs on top.
Stand close with your elbows tucked against your sides and forearms about level with the floor.
Breathe out and push the bar down until your arms lock straight.
Pause and squeeze at the bottom.
Breathe in and let the bar rise slowly, keeping your upper arms still.

exercises.name: V-Sit On Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands planted beside or slightly behind your hips.
Press down hard through straight arms to lift your hips off the floor.
Lean your shoulders back a little and raise your straight legs as high as you can toward your face.
Keep your knees locked and your abs pulled in, holding while breathing steadily.
Lower your legs and hips with control. Work from a solid L-sit before trying this.

exercises.name: Vertical Leg Raise (on Parallel Bars)
instructions: Support yourself on the parallel bars or a captain's chair with your back against the pad and your legs hanging straight.
Push your shoulders down away from your ears and brace your abs.
Breathe out and raise your straight legs until they are level with your hips, or higher if you can curl your pelvis up.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Bend your knees to make it easier if needed.

exercises.name: Walk Wave Machine
instructions: Set a low resistance and a small stride on the console.
Step onto the pedals with feet centered and hold the handles lightly.
Start a smooth side-to-side stepping rhythm, pressing through your whole foot.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your hips facing forward.
Stand tall with relaxed shoulders and breathe in a steady rhythm.
Increase speed or resistance gradually, and slow down for the last minutes.

exercises.name: Walking (outdoor)
instructions: Wear supportive shoes and pick a safe route.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and eyes looking ahead.
Start at an easy pace for a few minutes to warm up.
Pick up to a brisk pace where you breathe faster but can still talk.
Swing your arms naturally and land heel first, rolling through to the toes.
Slow down for the last few minutes to cool down.

exercises.name: Walking High Knees Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or ready to swing.
Step forward with your right foot and lower into a lunge until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the right heel to stand up and drive your left knee up to hip height.
Pause briefly in balance, then step the left foot forward into the next lunge.
Keep your chest up and front knee over the ankle, and breathe out as you rise.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and hands on your hips or at your sides.
Take a long step forward with your right foot.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees and the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through the front heel and bring the back foot forward straight into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back leg straight through into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward; count each leg as one rep.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about two foot-lengths in front of it.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are over your ankles.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your weight in your heels.
Hold for time, then slide back up.

exercises.name: Weighted Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands beside your hips and walk your feet out, legs straight or slightly bent.
Have a partner place a weight plate on your thighs, or set it there before you slide off the bench.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips, keeping your back close to the bench.
Stop when your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight, keeping the plate steady.

exercises.name: Weighted Close Grip Chin-Up On Dip Cage
aliases: close grip chin-up on dip cage
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hang from the pull-up handles of the dip cage with your hands close together and palms facing you.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your stomach to keep the weight still.
Breathe out and pull until your chin is above the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang without letting the weight swing.

exercises.name: Weighted Cossack Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet very wide, toes slightly out, holding a weight against your chest.
Shift your weight to the right and bend the right knee, sitting your hips back and down.
Keep the left leg straight and let its toes point up as you go deeper.
Keep your right heel flat and your chest up at the bottom.
Breathe out and push through the right foot to come back to the middle.
Repeat to the left side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a weight plate or dumbbell on your chest.
Brace your abs and tuck your chin slightly.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Increase the weight only when you can keep the curl smooth.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch (behind Head)
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat or flat bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a light plate behind your head with both hands, elbows pointing slightly forward.
Tighten your abs and breathe out as you curl your shoulder blades off the surface, moving your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your chin slightly tucked and let your abs lift the weight, not your arms.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your shoulder blades touch down.

exercises.name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back, holding a plate flat against your chest.
Tighten your abs and tuck your chin slightly.
Breathe out and curl up until your chest is close to your thighs, keeping the plate pressed to your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without jerking.
Breathe in and lower slowly until your back is close to the bench, keeping tension in your abs.

exercises.name: Weighted Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Put on a dip belt with a plate attached, or have a partner place a weight on your lower back.
Stand on a step with the balls of your feet, heels hanging off.
Hinge forward and support your hands on a bench in front of you, back flat.
Lower your heels into a deep stretch.
Breathe out and rise onto your toes as high as you can, then squeeze.
Breathe in and lower slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Weighted Drop Push Up
instructions: Put on a weight vest and set two low steps or plates just wider than shoulder-width apart.
Start in a push-up position with your hands on the platforms and your body straight.
Lift your hands off the platforms and drop them to the floor between them.
Land with soft elbows and let your chest sink into a push-up to absorb the drop.
Push explosively so your hands rise high enough to land back on the platforms.
Rest between reps if needed to keep every rep fast and controlled.

exercises.name: Weighted Front Plank
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your feet about hip-width apart.
Have a partner place a plate across your upper back, between your shoulder blades.
Tighten your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise, breathing steadily.
When time is up, have the plate removed before you lower your knees to the floor.

exercises.name: Weighted Hanging Leg-Hip Raise
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell between your feet or wear ankle weights, then grab a pull-up bar with palms facing away, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms, draw your shoulders slightly down and stop any swinging.
Tighten your abs and raise your legs in front of you until they are at least level with the floor.
Keep going by tilting your hips up toward your chest, breathing out as you lift.
Lower your legs slowly under control so your body does not swing.

exercises.name: Weighted Hyperextension (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Lie face down over a stability ball with it under your hips and stomach.
Press your feet against a wall or spread them wide for balance.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Let your upper body curl down over the ball, then lift it until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you lift and in as you lower.

exercises.name: Weighted Kneeling Step With Swing
instructions: Kneel tall on a mat holding a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands in front of your hips.
Brace your stomach and keep your back straight.
Step one foot forward into a half kneel while swinging the weight up and overhead with straight arms.
Lower the weight back to your hips as you bring the foot back to kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot forward and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Weighted Lunge With Swing
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell or kettlebell with both hands at chest height.
Step forward into a lunge with your right foot.
As you lower, swing the weight down and across to the outside of your right knee, keeping your back straight.
Breathe out and push off the front foot to stand, swinging the weight back up to your chest.
Repeat on the other leg, swinging to the outside of the left knee.

exercises.name: Weighted Lying Neck Extension (with Head Harness)
aliases: lying neck extension with head harness
instructions: Put on a head harness with a light plate attached.
Lie face down on a flat bench with your head and neck past the end and your hands holding the bench.
Let your head lower slowly until your chin moves toward your chest.
Raise your head back up until you are looking forward, without arching the lower back.
Pause, then lower slowly; breathe out as you lift.
Start very light and stop if you feel any sharp pain.

exercises.name: Weighted Lying Neck Flexion (with Head Harness)
aliases: lying neck flexion with head harness
instructions: Fit the head harness and attach a light weight, then lie on your back on a flat bench with your head past the end.
Hold the weight or harness lightly with your hands to guide it as you settle in.
Let your head lower slowly back until it is in line with the bench.
Curl your chin toward your chest by lifting your head.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly; breathe out as you lift.
Keep your shoulders on the bench and use a very light load at first.

exercises.name: Weighted Lying Side Lifting Head (with Head Harness)
aliases: lying side lifting head with head harness
instructions: Attach a light plate to a head harness and fit it snugly on your head.
Lie on your side on a flat bench with your head just past the end and the weight hanging toward the floor.
Hold the bench with your hands and keep your shoulders and hips stacked.
Breathe out and lift your head sideways toward your top shoulder until it lines up with your body.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly without twisting your head.
Finish the set, then turn over and work the other side.

exercises.name: Weighted Muscle Up
instructions: Wear a dip belt or weighted vest with a light load you can control.
Hang from the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull explosively toward your lower chest, keeping your body tight.
As you reach the bar, lean forward and turn your elbows over it quickly.
Press up to straight arms above the bar and breathe out.
Lower under control back to a hang.

exercises.name: Weighted Muscle Up (on Bar)
instructions: Attach a light weight with a belt or vest and grip the bar overhand at shoulder width.
Start from a dead hang with your body tight.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your hips while your body leans back slightly.
Lean your chest over the bar and turn your elbows over quickly.
Press to straight arms above the bar and breathe out.
Lower under control to the hang.

exercises.name: Weighted One Hand Pull Up
instructions: Add a small weight with a belt or vest.
Hang from the bar with one hand, palm facing you or to the side, and your free arm by your side.
Pull your shoulder down and tighten your whole body to stop spinning.
Breathe out and pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

exercises.name: Weighted Overhead Crunch (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Lie back on a stability ball with it under your middle back and your feet planted wide.
Hold a light plate or dumbbell with both hands and stretch your arms straight above your head.
Breathe out and curl up, keeping your arms in line with your ears as your shoulders lift.
Pause when your abs are fully tight.
Lower slowly back over the ball, keeping your arms straight.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms and keep the weight still.
Pull up until your chin passes the bar, leading with your chest.
Lower slowly and with control to a full hang.
Breathe out on the way up and in on the way down.

exercises.name: Weighted Round Arm
instructions: Stand tall with a light weight in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with your elbows almost straight.
Draw small, controlled circles forward with your hands.
After your set time or count, reverse the direction of the circles.
Keep your shoulders down, breathe steadily, and lower your arms when finished.

exercises.name: Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels down, holding a weight at your chest.
Lean back until your abs engage, keeping your back straight.
Rotate your shoulders to one side and bring the weight toward the floor beside your hip.
Turn back through the middle to the other side.
Move at a controlled pace and breathe out on each turn.

exercises.name: Weighted Russian Twist (No Floor Touch)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your heels on the ground, holding a plate, dumbbell or medicine ball at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back until you feel your abs switch on.
Breathe out and turn your shoulders to one side, bringing the weight beside your hip.
Turn back through the center and over to the other side, moving the weight with your torso, not just your arms.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees still throughout the set.

exercises.name: Weighted Russian Twist (legs Up)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, holding a weight plate or dumbbell at your chest.
Lean back with a straight spine and lift your feet off the floor.
Rotate your shoulders to the right and bring the weight beside your right hip.
Rotate through the middle to your left hip.
Keep your feet up and your legs steady while only your torso turns.

exercises.name: Weighted Seated Bicep Curl (on Stability Ball)
aliases: seated bicep curl on stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet flat and wide for balance.
Hold a medicine ball in both hands with palms facing up, arms straight in front of your thighs.
Breathe out and curl the ball up toward your chest, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top while sitting tall.
Breathe in and lower the ball slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Weighted Seated Neck Extension (with Head Harness)
aliases: seated neck extension with head harness
instructions: Fit a head harness with a light plate attached and sit on the end of a bench.
Lean your torso forward slightly and rest your hands on your knees, keeping your back flat.
Let your chin drop toward your chest so the weight hangs in front of you.
Breathe out and raise your head back until you are looking straight ahead or slightly up.
Pause, then breathe in and lower your chin slowly.
Move smoothly; never jerk the weight.
