exercises.name: Weighted Seated Twist (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet flat and wide on the floor.
Hold a light plate or dumbbell in both hands at chest height, arms slightly bent.
Brace your abs and rotate your shoulders to one side while your hips stay still on the ball.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement slow so the ball stays steady under you.

exercises.name: Weighted Side Bend (on Stability Ball)
instructions: Lie on your side over a stability ball with the ball under your hip and your feet staggered against a wall or the floor for balance.
Hold a weight plate flat against your chest with both hands.
Let your upper body drape down over the ball until you feel a stretch along your side.
Squeeze your side muscles to lift your shoulder up toward your hip, breathing out as you rise.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back over the ball while breathing in.
Finish your set, then switch to the other side.

exercises.name: Weighted Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart next to a sturdy support, holding a plate against your chest with one arm and the support with the other hand.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Push your knees forward and lean your body back, keeping a straight line from your knees to your head.
Lower as far as you can control, until your knees are deeply bent and close to the floor.
Squeeze your quads to drive your knees back and return to standing on your toes.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you rise; start with body weight before adding a plate.

exercises.name: Weighted Squat
instructions: Put on a weighted vest and fasten it snugly so it does not bounce.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, arms out in front for balance.
Breathe in, brace and sit your hips back and down.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and heels flat.
Drive through your feet to stand up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Breathe out as you rise.

exercises.name: Weighted Standing Curl
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate at its sides with both hands, palms facing in or slightly up, arms straight.
Keep your elbows close to your ribs.
Breathe out and curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze the biceps at the top without leaning back.
Breathe in and lower the plate slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Weighted Standing Hand Squeeze
instructions: Stand tall and hold a hand gripper in one hand, arm relaxed at your side or bent in front of you.
Set the gripper deep in your palm with the handle across your fingers.
Breathe out and squeeze until the handles touch or as far as you can.
Hold the squeeze for 2 to 5 seconds.
Open your hand slowly under control.
Finish the set, then switch hands.

exercises.name: Weighted Standing Neck Extension (with Head Harness)
aliases: standing neck extension with head harness
instructions: Put on a head harness with a light weight attached.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bend forward at the hips, and rest your hands on your knees with a flat back.
Let your head drop slowly so your chin moves toward your chest.
Lift your head until it lines up with your spine or looks slightly ahead.
Pause, then lower slowly; keep your back still and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Weighted Straight Bar Dip
instructions: Attach a plate or dumbbell to a dip belt around your hips.
Grip the straight bar in front of you at shoulder-width and press up so you are supported on straight arms with the bar at your hips.
Lean your chest forward over the bar and bring your legs slightly forward for balance.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar under control.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms.
Step down carefully, and only add weight once bodyweight bar dips feel solid.

exercises.name: Weighted Stretch Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell or weight plate in each hand or at your chest.
Take a long step forward with your right foot.
Lower until your back knee is just above the floor and sink your hips slightly forward to feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold the bottom for two seconds, breathing steadily, with your chest up.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.name: Weighted Svend Press
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate between your flat palms in front of your chest, fingers pointing forward.
Squeeze your palms together as hard as you can.
Press the plate straight out in front of you until your arms are almost straight.
Bring it slowly back to your chest while keeping the squeeze.
Breathe out as you press and keep your shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Weighted Three Bench Dips
instructions: Set two benches side by side for your hands and a third in front for your heels.
Get into position with legs straight, then have a partner place a plate on your thighs, or set it there yourself.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower your body until your elbows reach about a right angle.
Keep the plate steady and your shoulders away from your ears.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Weighted Tricep Dips
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grab the bars and lift yourself up with your arms straight and your body upright.
Breathe in and sink down, bending at the elbows, until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your shoulders down.
Breathe out and press up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Weighted Triceps Dip On High Parallel Bars
aliases: triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Fasten a weight to a dip belt, step up and grab the high bars.
Support yourself with straight arms, legs hanging and knees slightly bent or crossed.
Breathe in and lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging the weight.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Wheel Run
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, bend down and place both hands on the ab wheel in front of your feet.
Tighten your stomach and glutes so your back stays flat.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, letting your body lower toward the floor as your arms reach out.
Go only as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull the wheel back toward your feet using your core, breathing out as you return.
Beginners can build up to this by starting from the knees.

exercises.name: Wide Grip Rear Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip well wider than your shoulders.
Lean your head slightly forward and set your shoulders down.
Pull yourself up until the bar is behind your head at about the base of your neck.
Breathe out at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Switch to front pull-ups if you feel any pinching in your shoulders.

exercises.name: Wide Hand Push Up
instructions: Place your hands on the floor about one and a half times shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward or slightly out.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor, letting your elbows travel out to the sides.
Stop when your chest is a few centimeters above the floor.
Breathe out and press back up, keeping your hips from sagging.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Chest Dip On High Parallel Bars
instructions: Grip high parallel bars that are wider than your shoulders and lift yourself to straight arms with your feet off the floor.
Bend your knees, let your feet drift back and lean your chest forward.
Breathe in and lower yourself by bending your elbows, letting them point out to the sides.
Go down until you feel a deep stretch in your chest, without letting your shoulders roll forward.
Breathe out and press back up to straight arms, keeping the forward lean.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip clearly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and pull your chest toward the bar until your chin is above it.
Think about driving your elbows down to your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Seated Row (Cable)
instructions: Attach a long bar to the low pulley and sit with your feet on the platform.
Grip the bar overhand, hands wider than your shoulders.
Sit upright with straight arms and a slight bend in your knees.
Row the bar to your lower chest with your elbows pointing out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.
Breathe out on the pull and in on the return.

exercises.name: Wind Sprints
instructions: Mark a straight stretch of about 30 to 50 meters on a track, field or other open space.
Warm up first with a few minutes of easy jogging.
Start with one foot in front of the other, lean forward slightly and drive off hard.
Run at full effort, pumping your arms and staying tall with your abs tight.
Slow down gradually after the line, then walk back to the start to recover.
Start the next sprint once your breathing has settled.

exercises.name: Woodchopper (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle on a low pulley and stand side-on to the machine, feet wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees a little and hold the handle with both hands near the hip closest to the machine.
Breathe out and drive the handle up and across your body to above the opposite shoulder, keeping your arms fairly straight.
Turn your hips and pivot your back foot as you finish high.
Lower the handle slowly along the same path, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: World Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step your right foot forward into a long lunge and put both hands on the floor inside the right foot.
Keep the back leg straight and drop your right elbow toward the inside of your right ankle.
Place the right hand back down, then rotate your chest open and reach your right arm to the ceiling.
Bring the hand down, shift your hips back and straighten the front leg, pulling the toes up.
Return to the lunge, step back to standing and repeat on the other side, breathing steadily.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Stand or sit and hold your arms out in front of you, elbows straight or slightly bent.
Make loose fists or keep your fingers relaxed.
Slowly turn your hands in large circles in one direction, moving only at the wrists.
After 10 to 15 circles, switch to the other direction.
Keep the movement smooth and stay inside a pain-free range.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench with your feet flat and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms up, so your wrists sit just past your knees.
Open your hands slightly and let the bar roll down toward your fingertips.
Close your fingers and breathe out as you curl your wrists up as high as possible.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower under control.
Keep your forearms flat on your legs the whole set.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lay both forearms across it, hands past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up.
Lower the dumbbells so your wrists bend back toward the floor.
Breathe out and curl both wrists up as far as you can.
Squeeze at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.
Move only at the wrists; keep the elbows down.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Stand tall holding the wrist roller with both hands, palms down, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Let the weight hang at the end of the cord near the floor.
Turn the handle by rolling one wrist forward, then the other, to wind the weight up.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders down while you roll.
When the weight reaches the handle, unwind it slowly the same way.
Breathe steadily; try palms-up rolling on another set.

exercises.name: Zigzag Hops
instructions: Set up a line or a row of cones and stand to one side of it with knees slightly bent.
Hop diagonally forward across the line, landing on the balls of both feet.
Land softly, bending the ankles, knees and hips, with knees over the toes.
Bounce straight into the next diagonal hop back across the line.
Swing your arms for rhythm, keep hops low and quick, and breathe steadily.
Walk back to the start and rest before the next round.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight and palms facing forward.
Breathe out and curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top, rotate your wrists so your palms face down.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly with palms down.
At the bottom, turn your palms forward again before the next rep.
